“My lady, I thank you very much for your affection and favor towards me, but I have given myself entirely to God to be His friend, and with that I hope to live and die,” rang the confident, faith-filled words of Jacques “zhahk” (a French form of the male name Jacob or James).

Persecution was fiercely raging in Europe in the year 1550. For their profession of faith in Jesus Christ, men, women, and even children were snatched from their homes and meeting places and thrown into the dark and cold dungeon cells of area castles. Among these captives, fifteen-year-old Jacques Dosie found himself imprisoned in Leeuwarden, Holland, for the truth of the Gospel. Even though he was only fifteen years old, he was known by his upright testimony and knowledge of the Scriptures, bringing glory to God through the power of the Spirit.

The Lord and Lady Friesland, with many nobles and ladies, were assembled in the royal halls in Leeuwarden. Their conversation turned to the “baptist heretics” that were filling the land.

“Let’s bring in that young lad, Jacques. Surely he has not been too contaminated with this heresy.”

So, he was brought in to be interrogated. Lord Friesland spoke only a few words and seemed in a hurry to finish. He had no time for this talk of religion, especially with guests waiting for a more enjoyable entertainment. Lady Friesland, however, seemed moved with compassion for this youth who was so cruelly bound in the dungeon.

“Why are you in prison? You are only a youth. What brought you here?” she asked.

Jacques answered, “I was captured and thrown into prison only because I believe in Jesus Christ. I abide by Him alone and will not forsake Him.”

The royal lady asked him, “Surely you are not one of those heretics who rebaptized themselves and have perpetrated so much evil in our country? They say they are dispersed on account of their faith and boast of being the church of God. But they are a wicked and rebellious people and cause great commotion in the land.”

“My lady, I do not know any rebellious people nor am I one of their number,” replied Jacques. “But we would much rather, according to the teachings of the Scriptures, assist our enemies. If they hunger and thirst, we bless them with food and drink. We never resist them with revenge or violence as we read in Matthew 5:39.”

“If you were in a position of power it would be seen whether you would assist your enemies,” sneered one of the nobles.

Jacques replied, “Oh, no, my lord, if it were permitted among us to resist the evil with the carnal sword, I would never do so.”

“I know there are sects among you who are very wicked and kill the people. They have their goods and wives in common,” said Lady Friesland.

“Oh, no,” replied Jacques. “We are unjustly charged with these wicked things. We are falsely accused of evil as a means to be persecuted. But as taught in Matthew 5:11, we must suffer and endure all this with patience.”

“Was it not your people who with great dishonor took up arms against the government at Amsterdam and Muenster?” asked Lady Friesland.

“No, my lady, we are not of them,” answered Jacques. “Those people erred greatly. We regard it as a doctrine of the devil to resist the authorities with the sword and violence. We would much rather suffer persecution and death from the authorities.”

“Nevertheless, you are considered to be one of them, because you too make an uproar in the land,” insisted the royal lady. “However, I believe what you say concerning those Muensterites.”

“But, my lady, don’t we read about this in Acts 24:5, how wicked men spoke evil of the apostles themselves as well as the whole band of Christians?” countered Jacques. “Did not wicked men seek to incite the authorities to vengeance against the Christians, though it was all falsehood?”

Lady Friesland didn’t answer but quickly diverted to another topic. “Do you believe that all are damned who are not baptized according to your way?” she asked.

“Oh, no, my lady,” answered Jacques. “Judgement concerning other men belongs to God alone, who shall reward everyone according to his works. This is clearly stated in many places of the Holy Scriptures. Moreover, the water does not have the power to cleanse us from sin, as 1 Peter 3:21 says, but is merely a sign of all obedience.”

“Can you still sin after you are baptized?” asked Lady Friesland.

“Yes, my lady, for this is clearly evident from the words of Paul in Romans 7:18,” replied Jacques. “We are still clothed in a weak and sinful body, and sin in many things. But we must constantly crucify and mortify the flesh, and not practice or fulfill the works of the flesh. If we fail to do this, the righteousness of God will condemn us to eternal death.”

Lady Friesland was becoming agitated. “Why don’t you listen to the church inquisitor?” she demanded.

Jacques replied, “My lady, because I will not accept his doctrine, unless he first can clearly prove to me that it agrees in all points with the Word of God. Otherwise he is laboring in vain. My faith is founded on the pure Word of God alone. As for the practice of infant baptism, I contradict his argument with reason since it is not a command of God Almighty but much rather the invention of men. Infants do not have the least bit of knowledge or discernment about what is required for baptism. But Christ in His love for such innocent ones has promised them the kingdom of God through grace, without requiring baptism.

“And further, my lady, I find that the Roman church is infected with many other errors besides this. They seek to make Christ come into the bread, or that the bread and wine should become changed into His flesh and blood. I do not believe this but regard it as an exceedingly gross error and absurdity. But I believe that Christ truly ascended to heaven and sits on the right hand of His Father as we find in Mark 16:19. There is no salvation in their flour, mass, purgatory, or any of their services for the dead. All of their human inventions, and there are many, are nowhere recognized in the Holy Scriptures. But on the contrary, we call upon God and seek our salvation in Him. Our salvation is not in any creation of man, that we may not corrupt God’s own glory and give it to any of His creatures.”

At this point the mayor, who was also present, interrupted, “So don’t you believe in the sacrament which Christ Himself instituted?”

“Sir, Paul says that the bread is broken in remembrance of Him, and that the cup of blessing is the communion of the blood of Christ,” replied Jacques.

The mayor had nothing to answer to this.

“I consider this the worst thing about you, that you will not have the children baptized,” stated Lady Friesland. “All Germany and every kingdom regard your doings as heresy.”

“It is indeed true we are despised everywhere even as the apostles were,” replied Jacques. “But we do not believe that unbaptized children shall perish at the judgment day.”

“My dear child,” said the lady pleadingly. “Come over to our side, and repent, and you shall get out of this trouble. I promise to secure your release.”

“My lady, I thank you very much for your affection and favor towards me,” answered Jacques boldly. “But I will not change my faith to please mortal man unless it be proven to me with the Scriptures. I have given myself entirely to God, to be His friend, and with that I hope to live and die.”

“My son, I have compassion for you,” she pleaded again. “Repent of your baptism and do not be so stubborn. It would be a heavy cross for my heart if you should die for this cause, being such a young child. If you repent, I will see that you are released and may go home.”

“I cannot see that there is any crime at all in my baptism. I have not followed my own cause but the Holy institution of our Lord Jesus Christ. I have not been able to find another better way to the kingdom of God except through baptism,” replied Jacques. “I am inclined to seek the Lord my God with my whole heart.”

“Look at all these men around you. Do you dare be so presumptuous to say all of them are in error?” asked Lady Friesland.

“My lady,” replied Jacques. “In Israel, four hundred prophets were against the prophet Micaiah, who alone spoke the truth. For speaking the truth, he was imprisoned on bread and water. Later in his distress, King Ahab realized prophet Micaiah spoke the truth, but it was too late. We read of this in 2 Chronicles 18.”

The lady finally said, “I find many good things in you; but your greatest error lies in your baptism. To me that does not seem to be of God.”

Lady Friesland had Jacques brought before her many times. Even though he was young in years, he was mature in the knowledge of Jesus Christ. He had built his foundation upon the Rock, Jesus Christ. With the sword of the Spirit, which is the Word of God, he valiantly repelled all the subtle devices of Satan, whether consisting in many severe threats, or in fair promises of the kingdom of this world. Nothing could move him to forsake Christ.

Jacques was condemned to death by the rulers of the darkness of this world. Consequently, he testified and confirmed the true faith with his death and blood and, through grace, obtained the crown of everlasting glory.

Now let us fast forward from this scene to 469 years later. Times have changed. Men, women, and children are no longer thrown into cold dungeons for their faith, at least not here in North America. But the enemy of our soul is the same. He may not go around as a roaring lion, but he surely comes around as an angel of light.

Dear youth, you may not realize it, but today you are on trial. Your faith and convictions are being challenged. Satan, in the form of the Lady Frieslands of today, is questioning you. In her audience are the worldly-wise men, the progressive Protestants, and even some contemporary folks bearing the Anabaptist name.

“Why are you looking so pious?” asks Lady Friesland. “In this day and age, you need to loosen up. How do you expect to win the world when you appear so somber?”

You are the Jacques of today, so what is your answer?

Lady Friesland continues, “You claim to be part of a separated people. Yet I see you immersing yourselves into sports, hunting, and fishing. I see you following fashions. How are you different from other Christians? Or even from the world for that matter?”

Jacques, do you have any convictions of your own? Do your choices make a difference in eternity for yourself or others? Are your lifestyle decisions a life-or-death matter to you?

Seductively, Lady Friesland leans in closer and whispers, “What does it matter? Your parents are old-fashioned. Everyone does it today. Just doing it once is harmless. Why are you such a prude?”

Jacques, is the Bible in your heart like it was with Jacques of old? Do you know and love the Word? Can you withstand temptation?

Now Lady Friesland comes from a different angle. “Why do you wear that small covering on your head? What does it mean to today’s culture? Nothing. Enlightened Christians are getting rid of it everywhere. And young Jacques, don’t you think that girl at your side who you are courting would look prettier with that covering gone? It’s just a symbol anyway.”

Jacques and Jacqueline, will you stand true to God? Do you have a ready answer?

It is time to take a serious reflection of your faith and convictions. Jacques, in his youth, was standing to become the church of tomorrow in his day. Today you are Jacques. Tomorrow the church will consist of you and all the Jacqueses and Jacquelines who are around you today. Is this a church you want to be a part of? Are you satisfied with what you see? Are you satisfied with your own lifestyle convictions and faith? Will they carry you through when the raging battles of life hit?

So, dear youth of today, will you take some time to honestly consider your personal life in the mirror of God’s Word? If God’s Spirit gives you an answer of peace and rest, praise the Lord. If in any way your heart is troubled, or convicted, don’t become discouraged. Remember it is …the goodness of God [that] leadeth thee to repentance –Rom 2:4.

“Nyonya, saya sangat berterima kasih atas kasih sayang dan kebaikan hati Nyonya kepada saya, tetapi saya telah menyerahkan diri sepenuhnya kepada Allah untuk menjadi sahabat-Nya, dan dengan itu saya berharap untuk hidup dan mati,” demikianlah kata-kata Jacques yang penuh keyakinan dan iman. Jacques “zhahk” adalah bentuk bahasa Prancis dari nama laki-laki Jacob atau James.

Penganiayaan berkecamuk dengan hebat di Eropa pada tahun 1550. Karena mengaku beriman kepada Yesus Kristus, pria, wanita, bahkan anak-anak diseret dari rumah dan tempat pertemuan mereka lalu dilemparkan ke dalam sel-sel penjara bawah tanah yang gelap dan dingin di kastil-kastil setempat. Di antara para tawanan ini, Jacques Dosie yang berusia lima belas tahun mendapati dirinya dipenjarakan di Leeuwarden, Holland, demi kebenaran Injil. Meskipun baru berusia lima belas tahun, ia dikenal karena kesaksian hidupnya yang lurus dan pengetahuannya akan Kitab Suci, sehingga membawa kemuliaan bagi Allah melalui kuasa Roh.

Tuan dan Nyonya Friesland, bersama banyak bangsawan pria dan wanita, berkumpul di aula kerajaan di Leeuwarden. Percakapan mereka beralih pada “bidat-bidat baptis” yang memenuhi negeri itu.

“Mari kita panggil anak muda itu, Jacques. Tentu saja ia belum terlalu tercemar oleh ajaran sesat ini.”

Maka, ia dibawa masuk untuk diinterogasi. Tuan Friesland hanya mengucapkan beberapa patah kata dan tampak terburu-buru mengakhiri pembicaraan. Ia tidak punya waktu untuk urusan agama ini, terutama karena para tamu sedang menunggu hiburan yang lebih menyenangkan. Namun, Nyonya Friesland tampak tergerak oleh belas kasihan kepada pemuda yang diikat dengan begitu kejam di penjara bawah tanah itu.

“Mengapa kamu dipenjara? Kamu masih sangat muda. Apa yang membawamu ke sini?” tanyanya.

Jacques menjawab, “Saya ditangkap dan dilemparkan ke penjara hanya karena saya percaya kepada Yesus Kristus. Saya berpegang hanya kepada-Nya dan tidak akan meninggalkan-Nya.”

Nyonya kerajaan itu bertanya kepadanya, “Tentu kamu bukan salah seorang dari bidat-bidat yang membaptis ulang diri mereka dan telah melakukan begitu banyak kejahatan di negeri kita? Kata orang, mereka tercerai-berai karena iman mereka dan membanggakan diri sebagai gereja Allah. Tetapi mereka adalah bangsa yang jahat dan memberontak serta menimbulkan banyak keributan di negeri ini.”

“Nyonya, saya tidak mengenal orang-orang pemberontak, dan saya juga bukan salah seorang dari mereka,” jawab Jacques. “Namun, sesuai dengan ajaran Kitab Suci, kami justru lebih suka menolong musuh-musuh kami. Jika mereka lapar dan haus, kami memberkati mereka dengan makanan dan minuman. Kami tidak pernah membalas mereka dengan dendam atau kekerasan, seperti yang kita baca dalam Matius 5:39.”

“Jika kamu berada dalam posisi berkuasa, akan terlihat apakah kamu mau menolong musuh-musuhmu,” ejek salah seorang bangsawan.

Jacques menjawab, “Oh, tidak, Tuan. Sekalipun di antara kami diperbolehkan melawan kejahatan dengan pedang duniawi, saya tidak akan pernah melakukannya.”

“Saya tahu ada sekte-sekte di antara kalian yang sangat jahat dan membunuh orang. Mereka memiliki harta dan istri bersama-sama,” kata Nyonya Friesland.

“Oh, tidak,” jawab Jacques. “Kami dituduh secara tidak adil melakukan hal-hal jahat ini. Kami difitnah melakukan kejahatan sebagai dalih untuk menganiaya kami. Namun, seperti yang diajarkan dalam Matius 5:11, kami harus menanggung dan bersabar menghadapi semua ini.”

“Bukankah orang-orangmu yang dengan sangat tidak hormat mengangkat senjata melawan pemerintah di Amsterdam dan Muenster?” tanya Nyonya Friesland.

“Tidak, Nyonya, kami bukan bagian dari mereka,” jawab Jacques. “Orang-orang itu sangat sesat. Kami menganggap melawan para penguasa dengan pedang dan kekerasan sebagai ajaran iblis. Kami jauh lebih rela menderita penganiayaan dan kematian di tangan para penguasa.”

“Meskipun demikian, kamu dianggap salah seorang dari mereka, karena kamu juga menimbulkan keributan di negeri ini,” desak nyonya kerajaan itu. “Namun, saya percaya apa yang kamu katakan tentang orang-orang Muenster itu.”

“Tetapi, Nyonya, bukankah kita membaca tentang hal ini dalam Kisah Para Rasul 24:5, bagaimana orang-orang jahat menjelek-jelekkan para rasul sendiri maupun seluruh golongan orang Kristen?” sanggah Jacques. “Bukankah orang-orang jahat berusaha menghasut para penguasa untuk membalas dendam terhadap orang-orang Kristen, padahal semua itu adalah dusta?”

Nyonya Friesland tidak menjawab, tetapi segera mengalihkan pembicaraan ke topik lain. “Apakah kamu percaya bahwa semua orang yang tidak dibaptis menurut cara kalian akan binasa?” tanyanya.

“Oh, tidak, Nyonya,” jawab Jacques. “Penghakiman atas orang lain hanya milik Allah, yang akan membalas setiap orang menurut perbuatannya. Hal ini dinyatakan dengan jelas di banyak bagian Kitab Suci. Selain itu, air tidak berkuasa menyucikan kita dari dosa, seperti yang dikatakan dalam 1 Petrus 3:21, melainkan hanya merupakan tanda dari seluruh ketaatan.”

“Apakah kamu masih bisa berbuat dosa setelah dibaptis?” tanya Nyonya Friesland.

“Ya, Nyonya, sebab hal ini jelas terlihat dari perkataan Paulus dalam Roma 7:18,” jawab Jacques. “Kita masih mengenakan tubuh yang lemah dan berdosa, dan dalam banyak hal kita berbuat dosa. Tetapi kita harus terus-menerus menyalibkan dan mematikan keinginan daging, serta tidak melakukan atau memenuhi perbuatan-perbuatan daging. Jika kita tidak melakukannya, kebenaran Allah akan menghukum kita dengan kematian kekal.”

Nyonya Friesland mulai gelisah. “Mengapa kamu tidak mendengarkan inkuisitor gereja?” desaknya.

Jacques menjawab, “Nyonya, karena saya tidak akan menerima ajarannya kecuali ia terlebih dahulu dapat membuktikan dengan jelas kepada saya bahwa ajaran itu sesuai dalam segala hal dengan Firman Allah. Jika tidak, jerih payahnya sia-sia. Iman saya hanya didasarkan pada Firman Allah yang murni. Mengenai praktik baptisan bayi, saya membantah alasannya dengan nalar, sebab hal itu bukan perintah Allah Yang Mahakuasa, melainkan lebih merupakan ciptaan manusia. Bayi sama sekali tidak memiliki pengetahuan atau pengertian tentang apa yang dituntut dalam baptisan. Namun, Kristus dalam kasih-Nya kepada anak-anak yang tidak bersalah itu telah menjanjikan kerajaan Allah kepada mereka melalui kasih karunia, tanpa menuntut baptisan.

“Lagipula, Nyonya, saya mendapati bahwa gereja Roma tercemar oleh banyak kesalahan lain selain hal ini. Mereka berusaha menghadirkan Kristus ke dalam roti, atau mengubah roti dan anggur menjadi daging dan darah-Nya. Saya tidak percaya akan hal ini, melainkan menganggapnya sebagai kesalahan dan kemustahilan yang sangat besar. Tetapi saya percaya bahwa Kristus sungguh-sungguh naik ke surga dan duduk di sebelah kanan Bapa-Nya, seperti yang kita dapati dalam Markus 16:19. Tidak ada keselamatan dalam tepung, misa, api penyucian, ataupun segala pelayanan mereka bagi orang mati. Semua ciptaan manusia itu, dan jumlahnya banyak, sama sekali tidak diakui dalam Kitab Suci. Sebaliknya, kita berseru kepada Allah dan mencari keselamatan kita di dalam Dia. Keselamatan kita bukan berasal dari ciptaan manusia mana pun, agar kita tidak merusak kemuliaan Allah sendiri dan memberikannya kepada salah satu ciptaan-Nya.”

Pada saat itu wali kota, yang juga hadir, menyela, “Jadi, apakah kamu tidak percaya pada sakramen yang ditetapkan sendiri oleh Kristus?”

“Tuan, Paulus berkata bahwa roti dipecah-pecahkan untuk mengenang Dia, dan bahwa cawan berkat adalah persekutuan dalam darah Kristus,” jawab Jacques.

Wali kota itu tidak dapat menjawab apa pun.

“Menurut saya, hal terburuk tentang kalian adalah kalian tidak mau membaptis anak-anak,” kata Nyonya Friesland. “Seluruh Jerman dan setiap kerajaan menganggap perbuatan kalian sebagai bidah.”

“Memang benar kami dihina di mana-mana, sama seperti para rasul,” jawab Jacques. “Tetapi kami tidak percaya bahwa anak-anak yang belum dibaptis akan binasa pada hari penghakiman.”

“Anakku sayang,” kata sang nyonya memohon. “Berpihaklah kepada kami, bertobatlah, dan kamu akan terbebas dari masalah ini. Saya berjanji akan mengusahakan pembebasanmu.”

“Nyonya, saya sangat berterima kasih atas kasih sayang dan kebaikan hati Nyonya kepada saya,” jawab Jacques dengan berani. “Tetapi saya tidak akan mengubah iman saya demi menyenangkan manusia fana, kecuali hal itu dibuktikan kepada saya melalui Kitab Suci. Saya telah menyerahkan diri sepenuhnya kepada Allah untuk menjadi sahabat-Nya, dan dengan itu saya berharap untuk hidup dan mati.”

“Anakku, aku merasa kasihan kepadamu,” ia kembali memohon. “Bertobatlah dari baptisanmu dan jangan begitu keras kepala. Hatiku akan sangat berat jika kamu mati demi perkara ini, padahal kamu masih anak yang begitu muda. Jika kamu bertobat, aku akan memastikan kamu dibebaskan dan boleh pulang.”

“Saya tidak melihat bahwa ada kejahatan apa pun dalam baptisan saya. Saya tidak mengikuti perkara saya sendiri, melainkan ketetapan kudus Tuhan kita Yesus Kristus. Saya tidak dapat menemukan jalan yang lebih baik menuju kerajaan Allah selain melalui baptisan,” jawab Jacques. “Saya bertekad mencari Tuhan, Allah saya, dengan segenap hati.”

“Lihatlah semua orang di sekelilingmu. Apakah kamu berani begitu lancang mengatakan bahwa mereka semua sesat?” tanya Nyonya Friesland.

“Nyonya,” jawab Jacques. “Di Israel, empat ratus nabi menentang nabi Mikha, yang seorang diri mengatakan kebenaran. Karena mengatakan kebenaran, ia dipenjarakan dan hanya diberi roti serta air. Belakangan, dalam kesusahannya, Raja Ahab menyadari bahwa nabi Mikha telah mengatakan kebenaran, tetapi semuanya sudah terlambat. Kita membaca tentang hal ini dalam 2 Tawarikh 18.”

Akhirnya sang nyonya berkata, “Saya melihat banyak hal baik dalam dirimu; tetapi kesalahan terbesarmu terletak pada baptisanmu. Menurut saya, hal itu tidak berasal dari Allah.”

Nyonya Friesland berkali-kali menyuruh Jacques menghadapnya. Meskipun masih muda, ia matang dalam pengetahuan tentang Yesus Kristus. Ia telah membangun dasarnya di atas Batu Karang, Yesus Kristus. Dengan pedang Roh, yaitu Firman Allah, ia dengan gagah berani menangkis segala tipu daya Iblis yang licik, baik berupa berbagai ancaman keras maupun janji-janji manis tentang kerajaan dunia ini. Tidak ada yang dapat membuatnya meninggalkan Kristus.

Jacques dijatuhi hukuman mati oleh para penguasa kegelapan dunia ini. Karena itu, melalui kematian dan darahnya ia memberi kesaksian dan meneguhkan iman yang sejati, dan melalui kasih karunia memperoleh mahkota kemuliaan kekal.

Sekarang mari kita melompat dari peristiwa ini ke 469 tahun kemudian. Zaman telah berubah. Pria, wanita, dan anak-anak tidak lagi dilemparkan ke dalam penjara bawah tanah yang dingin karena iman mereka, setidaknya tidak di sini, di Amerika Utara. Namun, musuh jiwa kita tetap sama. Ia mungkin tidak berkeliaran seperti singa yang mengaum, tetapi ia pasti datang seperti malaikat terang.

Anak-anak muda yang terkasih, mungkin kalian tidak menyadarinya, tetapi hari ini kalian sedang diuji. Iman dan keyakinan kalian sedang ditantang. Setan, dalam wujud Nyonya Friesland masa kini, sedang mempertanyakan kalian. Di antara para pendengarnya ada orang-orang bijak menurut dunia, kaum Protestan progresif, dan bahkan beberapa orang masa kini yang menyandang nama Anabaptis.

“Mengapa kamu tampak begitu saleh?” tanya Nyonya Friesland. “Di zaman sekarang ini, kamu perlu lebih santai. Bagaimana kamu berharap memenangkan dunia kalau kamu tampak begitu muram?”

Kamulah Jacques masa kini, jadi apa jawabanmu?

Nyonya Friesland melanjutkan, “Kamu mengaku sebagai bagian dari umat yang terpisah. Namun, aku melihat kalian melibatkan diri dalam olahraga, berburu, dan memancing. Aku melihat kalian mengikuti mode. Apa bedanya kalian dengan orang Kristen lainnya? Atau bahkan dengan dunia?”

Jacques, apakah kamu memiliki keyakinanmu sendiri? Apakah pilihan-pilihanmu membawa perbedaan bagi kekekalanmu sendiri atau orang lain? Apakah keputusan-keputusan gaya hidupmu merupakan perkara hidup atau mati bagimu?

Dengan menggoda, Nyonya Friesland mendekat dan berbisik, “Apa bedanya? Orang tuamu ketinggalan zaman. Sekarang semua orang melakukannya. Melakukannya sekali saja tidak berbahaya. Mengapa kamu begitu kolot?”

Jacques, apakah Firman Allah ada di dalam hatimu seperti pada Jacques zaman dahulu? Apakah kamu mengenal dan mengasihi Firman itu? Dapatkah kamu bertahan menghadapi pencobaan?

Sekarang Nyonya Friesland datang dari sudut pandang yang berbeda. “Mengapa kamu mengenakan penutup kepala kecil itu? Apa artinya bagi budaya masa kini? Tidak ada artinya. Orang-orang Kristen yang tercerahkan di mana-mana menanggalkannya. Dan Jacques muda, tidakkah menurutmu gadis di sisimu yang sedang kamu pacari akan tampak lebih cantik jika penutup kepala itu dilepas? Itu hanya lambang, toh.”

Jacques dan Jacqueline, maukah kalian tetap setia kepada Allah? Apakah kalian memiliki jawaban yang siap diberikan?

Inilah waktunya untuk merenungkan dengan sungguh-sungguh iman dan keyakinan kalian. Pada masa mudanya, Jacques sedang dipersiapkan untuk menjadi bagian dari gereja masa depan pada zamannya. Hari ini kalianlah Jacques. Esok hari gereja akan terdiri atas kalian dan semua Jacques serta Jacqueline yang ada di sekitar kalian hari ini. Apakah ini gereja yang ingin kalian ikuti? Apakah kalian puas dengan apa yang kalian lihat? Apakah kalian puas dengan keyakinan iman dan gaya hidup kalian sendiri? Akankah semua itu menopang kalian ketika pergumulan hidup yang dahsyat datang?

Jadi, anak-anak muda masa kini yang terkasih, maukah kalian meluangkan waktu untuk dengan jujur memeriksa kehidupan pribadi kalian dalam cermin Firman Allah? Jika Roh Allah memberi kalian jawaban yang membawa damai dan ketenteraman, pujilah Tuhan. Jika hati kalian merasa gelisah atau tertempelak dalam hal apa pun, jangan berkecil hati. Ingatlah, …kebaikan Allah [yang] menuntun engkau kepada pertobatan –Rm. 2:4.

Today, I’d like to continue and possibly complete our discussion of Regenerative Medicine. I want to consider where it stands today, and how Christians can navigate the complex maze of treatments. As you may recall, in the previous issue of this magazine we discussed that Regenerative Medicine is man’s attempt to re-create organ systems. We described how fetal tissue was attempted to be used, due to its low rate of rejection by the people receiving it. Medically speaking, it was problematic in that, if used on a large scale, it would require large amounts of aborted fetuses. Later, embryonic stem cells were studied in depth. Here, embryos, which are newly conceived humans in their earliest stages, are dissected (cut apart) and stem cells are taken.

Think of stem cells as indolent, immature adults, who live in their parents’ basements, without direction, not knowing what they want to do with their lives. With a little encouragement and direction, they can finally find their way, finding a specialized skill and important role in life. In like manner, scientists have discovered ways to “program” these stem cells, “encouraging” them to become specialized into types of cells, such as nerve, heart, blood, and insulin producing. These cells would then be grown in a lab, then used to repair or replace the diseased or injured tissue.

However, “taking” stem cells from embryos results in his or her (the embryo’s) destruction. This is obviously problematic for Christians, knowing that one of the seven things that the Lord says is an abomination is …hands that shed innocent blood –Pro 6:17. Additionally, the sixth commandment directs, Thou shalt not kill –Exo 20:13. Because these objections were recognized by the scientific community, there was pressure to find an alternative.

The Apostle Paul states, There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it –1Co 10:13. His words are as true today as they were 2000 years ago. While Christians suffer from disease just as commonly as non-Christians do, modern medicine can present the “temptation” of a treatment and relief from disease or injury that is actually immoral. But God is faithful, and his escape is twofold. First and foremost, He gave His son to bear our burdens. It is to this Great Physician that we should always turn to first.

In the case of stem cell treatments, it so happens that it was discovered that these immature stem cells are not only found in human embryos, but they are also found in all people, from infants to grown-ups as well. This may be the physical “escape” for His faithful children. These immature stem cells (usually obtained from a patient’s fat tissue or bone marrow) can be grown, cultured, and used just as well as embryonic stem cells. It turns out that “Adult Stem Cells” have actually been more clinically effective, since they are “custom designed” for each individual, and since they come from that person’s own body; therefore, there is very little problem with rejection.

Umbilical cord stem cells have also been shown to be useful, particularly in bone and cartilage treatments. Just as there have been obstacles to overcome when using embryonic stem cells, so too there are problems with developing treatments using adult or umbilical cord stem cells. Think again of a stem cell as an immature, indolent adult. Just having him “hang out” with a master carpenter will not make him a master carpenter if all he does is find entertainment on his cell phone. Stem cells, like an apprentice, need intense, focused training and direction to become specialists in their chosen field of expertise. Learning how to turn these “switches” on is perhaps one of the greatest challenges. The main idea here is that just injecting stem cells that have not been “programmed” or “trained” into damaged or diseased tissue will not automatically make them “know” what to become or how to function.

Similarly, just putting a young electronics apprentice on a bus that is traveling into a city that just had a power grid failure will not result in restoring the power. Here the parallel is placing stem cells into the brain of a stroke victim or a paraplegic accident victim, hoping that the stem cells will “know” what to do, and which specific connections to repair in order to restore function. This may not work as hoped. It would be fruitless to expect success unless and until these problems are also addressed.

Then there is the lingering problem of these eager youngsters (stem cells) knowing when to stop. The problem with fetal tissue turning into cancerous tumors is also a problem to be dealt with in stem cells. Considering this, there is one exception: umbilical cord stem cells are generally not known to turn malignant.1

Here is a short list of treatments that are in development that would use stem cells:

  • Macular Degeneration—Repair a damaged retina.
  • Spinal Cord Injury/Stroke—Repair nerve tissue.
  • Burns—Repair skin tissue.
  • Congestive Heart Failure—Repair damaged heart tissue.
  • Diabetes—Replace or increase the pancreatic tissue that makes insulin.
  • Arthritis—Repair damaged cartilage.
  • Autoimmune diseases (Lupus, Multiple Sclerosis) —Destroy the immune system that is attacking its own body and replace or “reset” it with a new immune system derived from one’s own stem cells.
  • Leukemias—Destroy the cancerous blood cells and replace them with new stem cell derived blood cells.
  • New organs—Replace diseased, damaged, or cancer-ridden organs, such as the kidney, liver, or pancreas, with organs derived from the patient’s own stem cells, grown in a lab, and transplanted surgically, without the need of anti-rejection drugs.

As you can see, there is a very long list of diseases and ailments that may result in effective treatments with stem cells. I am very optimistic that within a decade, remedies for many of these ailments will be commonly available. However, learning how to make stem cells that are expertly specialized into specific tissue types, learning how to turn stems cells on and then turning them off at the necessary time (once the job is finished), and learning how to “teach” the stem cells where and how to make repairs will take time.

I am not the only one who is excited about the possibilities. That is why hundreds of stem cell clinics have sprung up across the country, trying to get in on the excitement. But do the claims of any of these clinics align with reality? Which ones are legitimate? I know that there are many clinics offering stem cell treatments for various ailments, so let’s now look at some of the treatments that are available today—ones that have evidence of actually helping, as well as realistic expectations. Let’s also look at some of the possible complications, to help us make informed decisions.

First, the risks and complications

  • Introduction of infection—For example, bacteria living on the skin can enter a joint space from a simple injection, resulting in destruction of the joint, even under the cleanest of conditions.
  • Stems cells moving from their introduction site and not going where they are intended or not staying contained to the specific area of treatment—One study involving pigs treated with stem cells injected into areas of a damaged heart after a heart attack showed near complete return of function, but then the new heart tissue kept growing, eventually filling the heart’s pumping chamber, which caused all the pigs to die.
  • Stem cells changing into unexpected or inappropriate cell types—Stem cells used for a facial cosmetic effect have actually turned to bone.2
  • Growth of tumors—There are documented cases of different tumors, including brain and kidney tumors that have developed after patients were treated for stroke and kidney failure using stem cells.
  • Failure to work as expected—There are documented cases of people with macular degeneration, who were treated with stem cells injected into the eye, that have resulted in blindness.
  • Stem cells can’t be withdrawn—Unlike medicines such as a pill or an injection, if something goes wrong, one can’t just withhold the next dose. Once stem cells are introduced, they can’t be taken back. The course that has been set will continue.

The rates of complications are hard to know, since there are no reporting requirements when performed outside of formal clinical investigations.

Next, the known benefits

The FDA (the governmental Food and Drug Administration that is tasked with health safety) has approved stem cell treatments for dozens of blood cancers (leukemias) and blood diseases using umbilical cord stem cells. Though not FDA approved, studies have shown some benefit for using stem cells for orthopedic applications, particularly arthritis of the knees. (Using stem cells for such orthopedic uses, without the need to stimulate them to become cartilage cells beforehand, appears to be the exception to the rule. Remember most stem cells need to be specialized before being used.) That’s it! Aside from this, most other uses for stem cells should only be considered either highly experimental or highly suspect of exaggerated benefits. Could there be other beneficial treatments that are not FDA approved? Perhaps, but it’s important to realize that the claims have often far outpaced the science.

So how is one to know? Here are some things to consider when choosing providers of stem cell treatments, as well as red flags, to tell you if there are better places to go for your health care. (These points are also true for just about any other treatment):

  1. Informed consent—Every medical treatment has risks and benefits. These should be routinely discussed with you beforehand, without you needing to ask. Any practitioner who claims there are no risks, only benefits, either is not sufficiently knowledgeable or is not sufficiently honest!
  2. Can they handle the complications? —Joint injections can sometimes result in infection. These can be severe infections that can potentially destroy the joint. Such complications are not just simply treated with antibiotics, but with surgery. These stem cell treatments are better handled by an orthopedic surgeon or practitioner that has a close relationship with one, if complications should arise. Likewise, treatments involving nerves should be done by neurologists or neurosurgeons.
  3. Is the clinic adequately equipped? —Stem cells need to be handled appropriately. The transport of umbilical stem cells and improper thawing from the supplier can drastically reduce numbers, which may have a great deal to do with determining the success of the procedure. Additionally, these cells may be in a state of “shock,” unless they are appropriately re-cultured after being thawed. This allows them to re-enter a desirable growth phase again.3 This may mean having a specialized lab and microbiologist on staff to properly grow and care for the stem cells, ensuring good quality control. This usually requires a university setting, not just a small clinic or office that has a nurse to thaw the stem cells after receiving them from an overnight delivery service. Glitzy web sites, colorful brochures, and informational dinners are not enough.
  4. Guinea pigs and rats are “experimented on,” people go through “clinical trials.” —Please avoid any practitioner who says they are doing experiments. Clinical trials involving people, which have the oversight of ethics boards, only occur after experiments on animals have shown low risk of harm, and a good chance of success. If a treatment is very effective, the FDA has suggested that as few as 42 participants can demonstrate adequate safety to grant approval. This is not an outrageously high threshold to overcome. Additionally, patients involved in clinical trials are usually only expected to cover minimal costs, if any. Practitioners who “experiment” on people rarely do it for free.4
  5. Realistic claims. —Does your practitioner claim 100 percent success? If so, it is better to run away (if your knees will allow you to) than to simply walk away! Knee treatments, for example, may only delay knee replacements for many people. Some may avoid surgery, but certainly not all. Do not expect a cure. Also, do they make claims well outside of what is commonly recognized? “Cures” claimed for Alzheimers, Parkinson’s, or other ailments that are not FDA approved? I cannot totally exclude the possibility that such treatments may exist at some future time. However, these practitioners should be able to point to (and provide to you) published studies. If there is a miraculous cure, the world should be able to benefit from it, and he or she should be able to patent it, so as to reap the financial benefits of sharing their techniques and discoveries with the rest of the world. By doing so, it is independently tested and verified. Anyone who has a “secret” cure, that they alone possess, should be avoided.
  1. Does it make sense? —By simply injecting stem cells (that have not been induced by a lab into their specialty state such as nerve cells, heart cells, etc.) into the bloodstream to treat things like nerve disorders, for example, does not make sense. Clinical trials of legitimate treatments first specialize the stem cells, then directly apply them to the affected area. For example, specific types of nerve cells are injected directly into specific locations of the brain, and heart cells are injected directly into the scarred tissue of the heart. Remember the indolent adult (the unspecialized stem cell)? You can’t expect to put them on a bus (inject them into a vein), send them into the big city (the body), without instructions on what to do (leaving them unspecialized), not knowing where to go (to somehow find the diseased part of the body) and then magically expect success.
  2. The hard sell. —Are you being told that or are you made to feel that you are “missing out” if you decline? Do the clinic advertisements have testimonial bylines, something to the effect of “Individual results may vary, and testimonials are not claimed to represent typical results and are not intended to represent or guarantee that anyone will achieve the same or similar results…”? As the old adage goes, if it’s too good to be true (especially if they actually tell you so), then it probably is. In these cases, consider the claims to be most likely somewhat exaggerated, and also consider working with someone who can give a more honest set of expectations.

I pray that God may grant you wisdom: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him –Jas 1:5.

오늘은 재생의학에 관한 논의를 이어가고, 어쩌면 마무리하고자 합니다. 재생의학이 현재 어떤 단계에 있는지, 그리고 그리스도인들이 복잡한 치료의 미로를 어떻게 헤쳐 나갈 수 있는지 살펴보고자 합니다. 기억하시겠지만, 이 잡지의 지난 호에서 재생의학은 장기 체계를 다시 만들어 내려는 인간의 시도라고 논의했습니다. 이식받는 사람에게 거부 반응이 나타날 가능성이 낮다는 이유로 태아 조직을 사용하려 했던 일에 관해서도 설명했습니다. 의학적으로 볼 때, 이를 대규모로 사용하려면 낙태된 태아가 대량으로 필요하다는 점에서 문제가 있었습니다. 이후 배아 줄기세포가 깊이 연구되었습니다. 이 경우, 막 수정되어 가장 초기 단계에 있는 인간인 배아를 해부하여(잘라내어) 줄기세포를 채취합니다.

줄기세포를 게으르고 미성숙한 성인에 비유해 보십시오. 부모의 지하실에 살면서 방향도 없이 인생에서 무엇을 하고 싶은지 모르는 사람 말입니다. 약간의 격려와 방향 제시를 받으면 마침내 길을 찾고, 전문 기술과 인생에서 중요한 역할을 발견할 수 있습니다. 마찬가지로 과학자들은 줄기세포를 “프로그래밍”하는 방법을 발견하여, 신경세포, 심장세포, 혈액세포, 인슐린 생성 세포와 같은 특정 세포 유형으로 분화하도록 “격려”하고 있습니다. 그런 다음 이 세포들을 실험실에서 배양하여 병들거나 손상된 조직을 복구하거나 대체하는 데 사용합니다.

그러나 배아에서 줄기세포를 “채취”하면 그 배아가 파괴됩니다. 주님께서 가증한 일이라고 말씀하신 일곱 가지 중 하나가 …무죄한 피를 흘리는 손이니라 –잠 6:17.라는 것을 아는 그리스도인에게 이는 명백히 문제가 됩니다. 또한 여섯째 계명은 살인하지 말지니라 –출 20:13.라고 명합니다. 이러한 반대가 과학계에서 인정되었기 때문에 대안을 찾으려는 압력이 있었습니다.

사도 바울은 이렇게 말합니다. 사람이 감당할 시험밖에는 너희가 당한 것이 없나니 오직 하나님은 미쁘사 너희가 감당하지 못할 시험 당함을 허락하지 아니하시고 시험 당할 즈음에 또한 피할 길을 내사 너희로 능히 감당하게 하시느니라 –고전 10:13. 그의 말은 2,000년 전이나 오늘이나 참됩니다. 그리스도인들도 비그리스도인들만큼 흔히 질병을 앓지만, 현대 의학은 실제로 부도덕한 치료와 질병이나 부상으로부터의 구제를 “유혹”으로 내세울 수 있습니다. 그러나 하나님은 신실하시며, 그분이 마련하시는 피할 길은 두 가지입니다. 무엇보다 먼저, 그분은 우리의 짐을 지도록 자신의 아들을 보내셨습니다. 우리는 언제나 먼저 이 위대한 의사께로 나아가야 합니다.

줄기세포 치료의 경우, 이 미성숙한 줄기세포가 인간 배아에서만 발견되는 것이 아니라 유아부터 성인까지 모든 사람에게서도 발견된다는 사실이 밝혀졌습니다. 이것이 그분께 신실한 자녀들을 위한 육체적인 “피할 길”일 수 있습니다. 이러한 미성숙 줄기세포(대개 환자의 지방 조직이나 골수에서 채취)는 배양하고 증식시켜 배아 줄기세포와 마찬가지로 사용할 수 있습니다. “성체 줄기세포”는 실제 임상에서 더 효과적이었던 것으로 밝혀졌습니다. 각 개인에게 “맞춤 설계”되어 있고 그 사람 자신의 몸에서 나오기 때문에 거부 반응 문제가 거의 없기 때문입니다.

제대혈 줄기세포도 유용한 것으로 입증되었으며, 특히 뼈와 연골 치료에 쓰입니다. 배아 줄기세포를 사용할 때 극복해야 할 장애물이 있었던 것처럼 성체 줄기세포나 제대혈 줄기세포를 이용한 치료법을 개발할 때도 문제가 있습니다. 줄기세포를 다시 미성숙하고 게으른 성인에 비유해 보십시오. 그를 뛰어난 목수 곁에 “붙여 놓기”만 한다고 해서 뛰어난 목수가 되는 것은 아닙니다. 휴대전화로 오락을 즐기는 것만 한다면 말입니다. 도제와 마찬가지로 줄기세포가 선택한 전문 분야의 전문가가 되려면 강도 높고 집중적인 훈련과 지도가 필요합니다. 이러한 “스위치”를 켜는 법을 배우는 것은 아마도 가장 큰 과제 중 하나일 것입니다. 여기서 핵심은 “프로그래밍”되거나 “훈련”되지 않은 줄기세포를 손상되거나 병든 조직에 주입한다고 해서 줄기세포가 무엇이 되어야 하는지, 또는 어떻게 기능해야 하는지 저절로 “알게” 되는 것은 아니라는 점입니다.

마찬가지로, 전력망이 막 고장 난 도시로 가는 버스에 젊은 전자 기술 도제를 태워 보낸다고 해서 전기가 복구되는 것은 아닙니다. 여기서 비유하는 상황은 뇌졸중 환자나 사고로 하반신이 마비된 환자의 뇌에 줄기세포를 넣고, 줄기세포가 무엇을 해야 할지 “알아서” 기능을 회복하기 위해 어떤 특정 연결을 복구해야 하는지 알기를 바라는 것입니다. 기대하는 대로 되지 않을 수 있습니다. 이러한 문제들도 해결하지 않는 한 성공을 기대하는 것은 헛된 일입니다.

그다음에는 이 의욕 넘치는 젊은이들(줄기세포)이 언제 멈춰야 하는지 안다는 문제가 여전히 남아 있습니다. 태아 조직이 암성 종양으로 변하는 문제는 줄기세포에서도 다뤄야 할 문제입니다. 이를 고려할 때 한 가지 예외가 있습니다. 제대혈 줄기세포는 일반적으로 악성으로 변하는 것으로 알려져 있지 않습니다.1

다음은 줄기세포를 사용하는 치료법 중 개발 중인 것들의 간략한 목록입니다.

  • 황반변성—손상된 망막을 복구합니다.
  • 척수 손상/뇌졸중—신경 조직을 복구합니다.
  • 화상—피부 조직을 복구합니다.
  • 울혈성 심부전—손상된 심장 조직을 복구합니다.
  • 당뇨병—인슐린을 만드는 췌장 조직을 대체하거나 증식시킵니다.
  • 관절염—손상된 연골을 복구합니다.
  • 자가면역 질환(루푸스, 다발성 경화증)—자기 몸을 공격하는 면역 체계를 파괴하고, 자신의 줄기세포에서 얻은 새로운 면역 체계로 대체하거나 “재설정”합니다.
  • 백혈병—암성 혈액세포를 파괴하고 줄기세포에서 유래한 새로운 혈액세포로 대체합니다.
  • 새 장기—신장, 간, 췌장과 같이 병들거나 손상되었거나 암에 걸린 장기를 환자 자신의 줄기세포에서 유래한 장기로 대체합니다. 이 장기는 실험실에서 배양해 수술로 이식하며, 거부 반응 억제 약물이 필요하지 않습니다.

보시다시피 줄기세포를 이용한 효과적인 치료로 이어질 수 있는 질병과 질환은 매우 많습니다. 10년 안에 이러한 질환 중 상당수의 치료법이 널리 이용될 수 있으리라 매우 낙관합니다. 그러나 줄기세포를 특정 조직 유형으로 능숙하게 분화시키는 방법, 줄기세포를 활성화하고 필요한 시점(일이 끝났을 때)에 비활성화하는 방법, 그리고 어디에서 어떻게 복구해야 하는지 줄기세포에 “가르치는” 방법을 익히려면 시간이 걸릴 것입니다.

가능성에 기대를 품은 사람은 저뿐만이 아닙니다. 그래서 전국에 수백 개의 줄기세포 클리닉이 생겨나 이 기대에 편승하려 하고 있습니다. 하지만 이들 클리닉의 주장은 현실과 부합할까요? 어느 곳이 믿을 만할까요? 여러 질환에 줄기세포 치료를 제공하는 클리닉이 많다는 것을 알고 있으니, 이제 실제로 도움이 된다는 근거가 있고 현실적인 기대를 제시하는, 오늘날 이용 가능한 치료법을 살펴보겠습니다. 또한 현명한 결정을 내리는 데 도움이 되도록 가능한 합병증도 살펴보겠습니다.

먼저, 위험과 합병증

  • 감염의 유입—예를 들어, 피부에 살고 있는 세균은 단순한 주사만으로도 관절강에 들어가 관절을 파괴할 수 있습니다. 가장 깨끗한 환경에서도 발생할 수 있습니다.
  • 줄기세포가 주입 부위에서 이동해 의도한 곳으로 가지 않거나 특정 치료 부위 안에 머물지 않는 경우—심장마비 후 손상된 심장 부위에 줄기세포를 주입한 돼지를 대상으로 한 연구에서는 기능이 거의 완전히 회복되었지만, 새 심장 조직이 계속 자라 결국 심장의 펌프실을 가득 채웠고, 그 결과 돼지들이 모두 죽었습니다.
  • 줄기세포가 예상치 못하거나 부적절한 세포 유형으로 변하는 경우—얼굴 미용 효과를 위해 사용한 줄기세포가 실제로 뼈로 변한 사례가 있습니다.2
  • 종양의 성장—줄기세포를 이용해 뇌졸중과 신부전 치료를 받은 환자에게서 뇌종양과 신장 종양을 비롯한 여러 종양이 발생한 사례가 기록되어 있습니다.
  • 예상대로 효과가 나타나지 않는 경우—황반변성 환자의 눈에 줄기세포를 주입해 치료한 결과 실명에 이른 사례가 기록되어 있습니다.
  • 줄기세포는 회수할 수 없음—알약이나 주사 같은 약물과 달리, 문제가 생기면 다음 투여분만 보류할 수 있는 것이 아닙니다. 일단 줄기세포를 투입하면 되돌릴 수 없습니다. 이미 시작된 과정은 계속 진행됩니다.

공식 임상시험 외에서 시행될 경우 보고 의무가 없기 때문에 합병증 발생률을 알기는 어렵습니다.

다음으로, 알려진 이점

FDA(보건 안전을 담당하는 정부 기관인 식품의약국)는 제대혈 줄기세포를 이용해 수십 가지 혈액암(백혈병)과 혈액 질환을 치료하는 줄기세포 치료를 승인했습니다. FDA 승인을 받은 것은 아니지만, 연구에서는 줄기세포를 정형외과 분야, 특히 무릎 관절염에 사용하는 데 일부 이점이 있음을 보여 주었습니다. (미리 연골세포로 분화시키지 않고 이러한 정형외과적 용도로 줄기세포를 사용하는 것은 규칙의 예외인 듯합니다. 대부분의 줄기세포는 사용 전에 전문화되어야 한다는 점을 기억하십시오.) 그게 전부입니다! 그 외의 대부분의 줄기세포 사용은 고도로 실험적이거나 이점이 과장되었을 가능성이 매우 큰 것으로만 여겨야 합니다. FDA 승인을 받지 않은 다른 유익한 치료법이 있을 수도 있을까요? 그럴 수도 있지만, 그 주장이 과학적 근거를 훨씬 앞서 나간 경우가 많다는 점을 깨닫는 것이 중요합니다.

그렇다면 어떻게 판단해야 할까요? 줄기세포 치료 제공자를 선택할 때 고려할 점과, 건강 관리를 위해 더 나은 곳을 찾아야 한다는 경고 신호를 몇 가지 소개합니다. (이 점들은 거의 모든 다른 치료에도 해당됩니다.)

  1. 충분한 설명에 근거한 동의—모든 의료 치료에는 위험과 이점이 있습니다. 환자가 물어보지 않아도 사전에 통상적으로 설명해야 합니다. 위험은 없고 이점만 있다고 주장하는 의료인은 지식이 충분하지 않거나 정직하지 않은 것입니다!
  2. 합병증에 대처할 수 있는가?—관절 주사는 때때로 감염을 일으킬 수 있습니다. 관절을 파괴할 수도 있는 심각한 감염일 수 있습니다. 이러한 합병증은 항생제만으로 간단히 치료할 수 있는 것이 아니라 수술이 필요합니다. 합병증이 생길 경우를 고려하면, 이런 줄기세포 치료는 정형외과 의사나 정형외과 의사와 긴밀한 관계를 맺고 있는 의료인이 맡는 편이 낫습니다. 마찬가지로 신경과 관련된 치료는 신경과 전문의나 신경외과 전문의가 해야 합니다.
  3. 클리닉의 장비와 시설은 충분한가?—줄기세포는 적절히 다뤄야 합니다. 제대혈 줄기세포를 운송하거나 공급업체에서 부적절하게 해동하면 세포 수가 크게 줄어들 수 있으며, 이는 시술의 성공 여부를 결정하는 데 상당한 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다. 또한 해동 후 적절하게 다시 배양하지 않으면 세포가 “충격” 상태일 수 있습니다. 재배양을 하면 세포가 다시 바람직한 증식 단계로 들어갈 수 있습니다.3 이는 줄기세포를 적절히 증식시키고 관리하여 품질을 잘 통제할 전문 실험실과 전담 미생물학자가 필요하다는 뜻일 수 있습니다. 대개 대학 환경이 필요합니다. 줄기세포를 밤샘 배송으로 받은 뒤 간호사가 해동하는 소규모 클리닉이나 진료실만으로는 충분하지 않습니다. 화려한 웹사이트와 다채로운 안내 책자, 설명회 만찬만으로는 충분하지 않습니다.
  4. 기니피그와 쥐는 “실험 대상”이고 사람은 “임상시험”에 참여합니다.—실험을 하고 있다고 말하는 의료인은 피하십시오. 윤리심의위원회의 감독을 받는 사람 대상 임상시험은 동물 실험에서 위해 위험이 낮고 성공 가능성이 높다는 사실이 확인된 뒤에만 이루어집니다. 치료 효과가 매우 높다면 FDA는 승인에 필요한 안전성을 입증하는 데 참가자가 42명만 있어도 될 수 있다고 제안한 바 있습니다. 이는 극복하기 터무니없이 높은 기준이 아닙니다. 또한 임상시험에 참여하는 환자는 대개 비용을 거의 부담하지 않거나 전혀 부담하지 않습니다. 사람을 대상으로 “실험”하는 의료인들이 무료로 하는 경우는 드뭅니다.4
  5. 현실적인 주장인가?—의료인이 성공률이 100퍼센트라고 주장합니까? 그렇다면 단순히 걸어서 떠나는 것보다 도망치는 편이 낫습니다(무릎이 허락한다면요)! 예를 들어 무릎 치료는 많은 사람에게 무릎 인공관절 치환술을 미루게 할 뿐일 수 있습니다. 수술을 피하는 사람도 있겠지만, 물론 모두가 그런 것은 아닙니다. 완치를 기대하지 마십시오. 또 일반적으로 인정되는 범위를 크게 벗어난 주장을 합니까? FDA 승인을 받지 않은 알츠하이머병, 파킨슨병 또는 다른 질환의 “완치”를 주장합니까? 그런 치료가 미래 어느 시점에 존재할 가능성을 완전히 배제할 수는 없습니다. 하지만 이런 의료인들은 발표된 연구를 제시하고(환자에게 제공하고) 그 근거를 보여 줄 수 있어야 합니다. 기적적인 치료법이 있다면 세상 사람들이 혜택을 누릴 수 있어야 하고, 그 기술과 발견을 세상과 공유하여 재정적 이익을 얻을 수 있도록 특허를 받을 수도 있어야 합니다. 그렇게 하면 독립적인 검증과 확인을 받을 수 있습니다. 자신만이 보유한 “비밀” 치료법이 있다고 하는 사람은 피해야 합니다.
  1. 말이 되는가?—예를 들어 신경 질환을 치료하기 위해 실험실에서 신경세포, 심장세포 등 특정 세포 상태로 유도하지 않은 줄기세포를 혈류에 주입하는 것은 이치에 맞지 않습니다. 정당한 치료법의 임상시험에서는 먼저 줄기세포를 특정 세포로 분화시킨 뒤 환부에 직접 적용합니다. 예를 들어 특정 유형의 신경세포를 뇌의 특정 위치에 직접 주입하고, 심장세포는 심장의 흉터 조직에 직접 주입합니다. 게으르고 미성숙한 성인(분화되지 않은 줄기세포)을 기억하십시오. 그들에게 무엇을 할지 지시도 하지 않고(미분화 상태로 둔 채), 어디로 가야 할지도 모르게 한 다음(몸의 병든 부위를 어떻게든 찾아가도록), 버스에 태워 대도시로 보내는 것(정맥에 주사하는 것)만으로 성공을 마법처럼 기대할 수는 없습니다.
  2. 강압적인 판매 방식—거절하면 “기회를 놓친다”고 듣거나 그렇게 느끼게 됩니까? 클리닉 광고에 “개인별 결과는 다를 수 있으며, 사용 후기는 전형적인 결과를 나타낸다고 주장하지 않으며 누구나 동일하거나 비슷한 결과를 얻으리라고 나타내거나 보장하려는 것이 아닙니다…”와 같은 문구가 있습니까? 오래된 격언처럼, 사실이라기엔 너무 좋게 들린다면(특히 그들이 실제로 그렇게 말한다면) 아마 사실이 아닐 것입니다. 이런 경우에는 주장이 상당히 과장되었을 가능성이 높다고 여기고, 더 정직한 기대치를 제시할 수 있는 의료인과 함께하는 것도 고려하십시오.

하나님께서 여러분에게 지혜를 허락하시기를 기도합니다. 너희 중에 누구든지 지혜가 부족하거든 모든 사람에게 후히 주시고 꾸짖지 아니하시는 하나님께 구하라 그리하면 주시리라 –약 1:5.

특별 안내:

미국으로 백신을 배송받을 수 없을 경우 자녀를 일본에 데려가 그곳에서 접종시키려는 부모들로부터 관심을 표명받았습니다. 이와 마찬가지로 관심이 있는 이 잡지의 독자께서는 베뢰아의 소리(The Berean Voice)에 연락해 주십시오. 계획을 세우고 필요한 조정을 할 수 있습니다. 연락처는 《남은 자의 심장박동》(The Heartbeat of the Remnant) 잡지의 어느 호든 앞표지 안쪽에서 확인하실 수 있습니다.

My Help and My Deliverer

Psalm 40:1 I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry. 2 He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings. 3 And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD. 4 Blessed is that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies. 5 Many, O LORD my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered. 6 Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required. 7 Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me, 8 I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart. 9 I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest. 10 I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation. 11 Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me. 12 For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me. 13 Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me. 14 Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil. 15 Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha. 16 Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified. 17 But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

A glorious morning unfolds before me, perfect and peaceful, unmarred by failure. The sky is clear and blue. The horizon is a soft, blushing pink, enhanced by a misty fog. The distant hills and trees are shaded a dusky blue in the misty morning coolness. The morning is ringing with the warbling, twittering, chirping of birds. The grass glows with millions of dew droplets sparkling in the morning light. The pink horizon above the distant, dusky hills gradually fades into a glowing orange sphere that becomes brighter and brighter.

I stand in awe of God. My heart is thrilled at the beauty spread out before me. I am also thrilled at what God has done in my life, and the beauty He has created out of ashes.

I waited patiently for the Lord; and He inclined unto me, and heard my cry. He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings. God has brought me up out of the pit of despair and discouragement. He has set my feet upon the Rock, Jesus Christ, and He has established my goings. He knows the plans He has for me. His thoughts and His ways are much higher than mine.

He hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the Lord. I desire that God will be glorified through the work He has done and is continuing to do in my life. Many, O Lord, are Thy wonderful works which Thou hast done, and Thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto Thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.

I delight to do Thy will, O God: yea, Thy law is within my heart. It is truly my delight to do the will of God; to love Him with my whole heart, soul, strength, and mind; to obey His commandments from my heart.

I have not hid Thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared Thy faithfulness and Thy salvation: I have not concealed Thy lovingkindness and Thy truth from the great congregation. It is such a blessing to have deep and edifying conversations with my brothers and sisters in the Lord, and to share together what the Lord is doing in our lives. It is a great strengthening to my faith.

Withhold not Thy tender mercies from me, O Lord: let Thy lovingkindness and Thy truth continually preserve me. Temptations and hard tests are a very real thing in life; the struggle to keep my heart with a diligence, the battle against stubborn pride, and the urge to utter hasty words of frustration. Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me: O Lord, make haste to help me. Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

The sun has risen above the distant hills and the countryside is now glowing gloriously. The mist has faded into the woods and the distant dusky blue hills and trees have exchanged their robes for vivid shades of green intermixed with hints of red and brown. The sparkling droplets of dew are dazzling in the brilliant sunlight.

Let those that seek Thee rejoice and be glad in Thee: let such as love Thy salvation say continually, The Lord be magnified. I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: Thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

My Hulp en my Redder

Psalm 40:1 Ek het geduldig op die HERE gewag; en Hy het na my toe neergebuig en my geroep gehoor. 2 Hy het my ook uit ’n verskriklike kuil opgehaal, uit die modderige klei, en my voete op ’n rots gesit en my voetstappe vasgemaak. 3 En Hy het ’n nuwe lied in my mond gelê, ’n loflied tot eer van onse God: baie sal dit sien en vrees, en op die HERE vertrou. 4 Geseënd is die man wat die HERE sy vertroue maak en hom nie wend tot die hoogmoediges of tot dié wat hulle tot leuens wend nie. 5 Baie is u wonderlike dade, HERE my God, wat U gedoen het, en u gedagtes oor ons; dit kan nie in volgorde aan U opgenoem word nie. As ek dit wou verkondig en daaroor praat, is hulle meer as wat getel kan word. 6 Slagoffer en spysoffer het U nie begeer nie; my ore het U geopen; brandoffer en sondoffer het U nie vereis nie. 7 Toe het ek gesê: Kyk, ek kom; in die boekrol is daar oor my geskryf. 8 Ek verlustig my daarin om u wil te doen, o my God; ja, u wet is binne-in my hart. 9 Ek het geregtigheid verkondig in die groot vergadering; kyk, ek het my lippe nie teruggehou nie, HERE, U weet dit. 10 Ek het u geregtigheid nie in my hart verberg nie; ek het u trou en u redding verkondig; ek het u goedertierenheid en u waarheid nie vir die groot vergadering verberg nie. 11 HERE, weerhou u ontferming nie van my nie; laat u goedertierenheid en u waarheid my voortdurend bewaar. 12 Want ontelbare euwels het my omring; my ongeregtighede het my ingehaal, sodat ek nie kan opkyk nie; hulle is meer as die hare op my kop; daarom begewe my hart my. 13 Wees behaaglik, HERE, om my te red; HERE, maak gou om my te help. 14 Laat hulle almal beskaamd en in die war raak wat my lewe soek om dit te vernietig; laat hulle teruggedryf en beskaamd staan wat my kwaad toewens. 15 Laat hulle verlate wees as beloning vir hulle skande, dié wat vir my sê: Aha, aha! 16 Laat almal wat U soek, juig en bly wees in U; laat dié wat u redding liefhet, voortdurend sê: Die HERE word groot gemaak! 17 Maar ek is arm en behoeftig; tog dink die Here aan my; U is my hulp en my Redder; moenie talm nie, o my God.

’n Heerlike oggend ontvou voor my, volmaak en vreedsaam, ongeskend deur mislukking. Die lug is helder en blou. Die horison is sagte, bloosende pienk, versag deur ’n mistige newel. Die veraf heuwels en bome is in die mistige oggendkoelte donkerblou geskakeer. Die oggend weerklink van die warrelende, kwetterende en tjilpende voëls. Die gras gloei van miljoene dou druppels wat in die oggendlig skitter. Die pienk horison bo die veraf, donkerblou heuwels vervaag geleidelik tot ’n gloeiende oranje sfeer wat al hoe helderder word.

Ek staan in verwondering oor God. My hart is verheug oor die skoonheid wat voor my uitgestrek lê. Ek is ook verheug oor wat God in my lewe gedoen het, en oor die skoonheid wat Hy uit as geskep het.

Ek het geduldig op die Here gewag; en Hy het na my toe neergebuig en my geroep gehoor. Hy het my ook uit ’n verskriklike kuil opgehaal, uit die modderige klei, en my voete op ’n rots gesit en my voetstappe vasgemaak. God het my uit die kuil van wanhoop en ontmoediging opgehaal. Hy het my voete op die Rots, Jesus Christus, gesit, en Hy het my voetstappe vasgemaak. Hy weet watter planne Hy vir my het. Sy gedagtes en sy weë is baie hoër as myne.

Hy het ’n nuwe lied in my mond gelê, ’n loflied tot eer van onse God: baie sal dit sien en vrees, en op die Here vertrou. Ek begeer dat God verheerlik sal word deur die werk wat Hy in my lewe gedoen het en steeds doen. Baie is u wonderlike dade, Here, wat U gedoen het, en u gedagtes oor ons; dit kan nie in volgorde aan U opgenoem word nie. As ek dit wou verkondig en daaroor praat, is hulle meer as wat getel kan word.

Ek verlustig my daarin om u wil te doen, o God; ja, u wet is binne-in my hart. Dit is waarlik my verlustiging om die wil van God te doen; om Hom lief te hê met my hele hart, siel, krag en verstand; om sy gebooie uit my hart te gehoorsaam.

Ek het u geregtigheid nie in my hart verberg nie; ek het u trou en u redding verkondig; ek het u goedertierenheid en u waarheid nie vir die groot vergadering verberg nie. Dit is so ’n seën om diepgaande en opbouende gesprekke met my broers en susters in die Here te hê, en saam te deel wat die Here in ons lewens doen. Dit versterk my geloof grootliks.

Weerhou u ontferming nie van my nie, o Here; laat u goedertierenheid en u waarheid my voortdurend bewaar. Versoekings en moeilike beproewings is ’n baie werklike deel van die lewe; die stryd om my hart ywerig te bewaak, die stryd teen hardnekkige trots, en die drang om oorhaastige woorde van frustrasie te uiter. Wees behaaglik, Here, om my te red; Here, maak gou om my te help. Laat hulle almal beskaamd en in die war raak wat my lewe soek om dit te vernietig; laat hulle teruggedryf en beskaamd staan wat my kwaad toewens.

Die son het bo die veraf heuwels opgekom en die platteland gloei nou heerlik. Die mis het in die bosse verdwyn, en die veraf donkerblou heuwels en bome het hul gewade verruil vir helder skakerings groen, vermeng met hier en daar ’n tikkie rooi en bruin. Die sprankelende dou druppels verblind in die helder sonlig.

Laat dié wat U soek, juig en bly wees in U; laat dié wat u redding liefhet, voortdurend sê: Die Here word groot gemaak! Ek is arm en behoeftig; tog dink die Here aan my; U is my hulp en my Redder; moenie talm nie, o my God.

And he [Jesus] spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees; When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand. So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand –Luk 21:29-31.

Summer truly is upon us; and the trees have shot forth. What an interesting term for our modern-day English language, yet we still understand its meaning and have a mental picture of what is happening—the leaves pushing out from places that over winter were bare. For me, I think it is easier to have this mental picture since I have seen time-lapse videos of plants growing or sprouting to life.

Anyway, so much for that. What about the rest of this verse? (…when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.) Surely most of us continue to see the end of time approaching—the wars and rumors of wars, the earthquakes, the political upheaval in nation after nation, societies moving further and further away from God, and churches and families being ravished by sin and scandal.

We have God’s own promise that what we know and experience here on this earth was designed, created, and expected by Him to be only a temporary reality. And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands: They shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment; And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail –Heb 1:10-12.

The Prevailing Menace of Doubt & Fear

As we, as a church (FCF) and as a ministry (TBV), interact with numerous challenging situations (broken homes, struggling marriages, adopted children, faltering youth, immoral addictions, emotional struggles, and mental health issues) we repeatedly run into questions of doubt. “Why did this happen to me?” “Why doesn’t God change my circumstances?” “How can I trust God when all these painful things have happened to me?” “How can I surrender my life to God when He isn’t trustworthy?”

Most believers claim to trust God and believe His Word. The challenge that seems to come for each of us is two-fold. First, many of us tend to think that believing is primarily “feeling” instead of “choosing.” Secondly, many of us find it easy to believe what God says when it agrees with our experience, our thoughts, and our feelings; the problem arises when what the Scriptures say pushes on my will, my view, my belief, my experience, etc.

On the first point (believing=feeling) we have God’s clear answer from the Apostle Paul, for we walk by faith, not by sight: –2Co 5:7. On the second point the reality is that each of these struggles are a clear test of whether we will obey God rather than man (including ourselves), whether we will let God be true and every man a liar (including ourselves), and whether we will allow God to be the authority on all things or if we will still insist on our own will. Many of us claim (give lip service) to trust and believe God in all things, yet when we are faced with our own time of testing, we fail miserably (I know I have).

Additionally, many of us define our lifestyle of doubts and worry as being something normal, yet the Bible tells us to be anxious for nothing and to cast all our cares upon our Lord. Here the world has slowly deadened our senses to the clear teaching of the Scriptures, in that we have come to accept as normal that which God would have us to rise above. If we step back and consider the definition of “fear” as being on a spectrum, with some fear being quite minor and some being quite severe, we will see that many of our accepted patterns of behavior are outside of God’s perfect will for our lives. Doubt would be on the lesser end of the spectrum, with worry having a slightly stronger presence and effect, while panicking or being frantic would obviously cause much greater interference in our normal lives. Yet the truth is that each one of these is still in the family of “fear,” with the outcome being that we are allowing fear to control us and dictate our thoughts and behaviors. God’s will is that all His children would walk by faith instead of by fear.

God never gives us grace for any of our worries, nor for any future possible “what ifs”. God only gives us grace to go through what He is placing in front of us moment by moment. In the same way that a woman with child must go through the scary possibilities of the pain of childbirth, so likewise, all human beings must go through each circumstance that God decides is our lot in life. Nothing that we try to think or do (fear, worry, move, change our location, spend money, or ask others to intervene, etc.) will stop or change what God wills for our life. It is our choice to either accept or resist the inevitable in our lives.

The reality is this—each of us will either yield [our] members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin by believing the lies of Satan and continuing to allow fear to motivate and direct our thoughts and actions, OR we will yield [ourself] unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and our members as instruments of righteousness unto God (Rom 6:13), by choosing to believe what God says in His Word and allowing faith to motivate and direct our thoughts and actions.

Here a balancing perspective needs to be brought in. This does not mean that we never wrestle with difficult situations—Jesus did in the Garden of Gethsemane. It also doesn’t mean that we never appeal to God or our authorities to consider changing our current painful situation—again, Jesus did. Rather, we are to be honest with God (like Jesus was) about the struggle of our heart, but then we need to eventually walk forward in obedience, by faith, with courage (like Jesus did).

Ongoing Support Needed

A big thank you to all who so faithfully continue to support the work of The Berean Voice. It is through the many prayers, emails and phone calls of encouragement and suggestions, and the financial contributions of many believers that we can continue to minister to the needs of others. As a non-profit ministry of the church, we do not charge for our material or services, therefore we rely entirely on the ongoing freewill offerings of God’s people. Please prayerfully consider how God would have you to partner with us in this work.

If you believe that God would have you support us financially, monthly support makes our work easier since most of our bills are monthly. However, if this doesn’t work as well for you that is fine. For your convenience there is a remittance envelope in the center of each copy of the magazine or you can go to our website www.bereanvoice.org and use the “donate” feature there for online donations. और उसने [यीशु ने] उनसे एक दृष्टान्त कहा; “अंजीर के पेड़ और सब पेड़ों को देखो; जब वे कोंपलें निकालने लगते हैं, तो तुम देखकर अपने आप जान लेते हो कि ग्रीष्मकाल निकट है। इसी प्रकार जब तुम इन बातों को होते देखो, तो जान लेना कि परमेश्वर का राज्य निकट है” –लूका 21:29-31.

सचमुच गर्मी आ चुकी है; और पेड़ों में कोंपलें निकल आई हैं। हमारी आधुनिक अंग्रेज़ी भाषा के लिए यह कितना दिलचस्प शब्द है, फिर भी हम इसका अर्थ समझते हैं और मन में यह तस्वीर बना लेते हैं कि क्या हो रहा है—वे पत्तियाँ बाहर निकल रही हैं, जहाँ सर्दियों में पेड़ नंगे थे। मुझे लगता है कि मेरे लिए यह तस्वीर मन में बनाना आसान है, क्योंकि मैंने पौधों को बढ़ते या अंकुरित होकर जीवित होते हुए दिखाने वाले समय-अंतराल वीडियो देखे हैं।

खैर, इतना ही। इस वचन के बाकी हिस्से के बारे में क्या? (…जब तुम इन बातों को होते देखो, तो जान लेना कि परमेश्वर का राज्य निकट है।) निश्चय ही, हममें से अधिकांश लोग समय के अंत को निकट आते देखते रहते हैं—युद्ध और युद्धों की अफ़वाहें, भूकम्प, एक के बाद एक राष्ट्र में राजनीतिक उथल-पुथल, समाजों का परमेश्वर से और दूर होते जाना, और पाप तथा घोटालों से कलीसियाओं और परिवारों का उजड़ना।

परमेश्वर ने स्वयं हमें यह प्रतिज्ञा दी है कि इस पृथ्वी पर हम जो जानते और अनुभव करते हैं, उसे उसने केवल एक अस्थायी वास्तविकता के रूप में ही रचा, बनाया और अपेक्षित किया था। और हे प्रभु, तूने आदि में पृथ्वी की नींव डाली, और आकाश तेरे हाथों की कारीगरी है: वे नाश हो जाएंगे, परन्तु तू बना रहता है; और वे सब वस्त्र के समान पुराने हो जाएंगे; और तू उन्हें चादर के समान लपेटेगा, और वे बदल जाएंगे: परन्तु तू वही है, और तेरे वर्ष कभी समाप्त न होंगे –इब्रानियों 1:10-12.

संदेह और भय का व्यापक संकट

जब हम, एक कलीसिया (FCF) के रूप में और एक सेवकाई (TBV) के रूप में, अनेक कठिन परिस्थितियों (टूटे हुए घर, संघर्षरत वैवाहिक जीवन, गोद लिए हुए बच्चे, लड़खड़ाते युवा, अनैतिक लतें, भावनात्मक संघर्ष और मानसिक स्वास्थ्य की समस्याएँ) से जूझते लोगों के संपर्क में आते हैं, तो हमें बार-बार संदेह से जुड़े सवालों का सामना करना पड़ता है। “मेरे साथ ऐसा क्यों हुआ?” “परमेश्वर मेरी परिस्थितियाँ क्यों नहीं बदलता?” “जब मेरे साथ ये सब दर्दनाक बातें हुई हैं, तो मैं परमेश्वर पर भरोसा कैसे कर सकता हूँ?” “जब वह भरोसे के योग्य नहीं है, तो मैं अपना जीवन परमेश्वर को कैसे सौंप सकता हूँ?”

अधिकांश विश्वासी दावा करते हैं कि वे परमेश्वर पर भरोसा करते हैं और उसके वचन पर विश्वास करते हैं। हममें से हर एक के सामने जो चुनौती आती दिखती है, वह दोहरी है। पहली बात, हममें से कई लोग यह सोचते हैं कि विश्वास करना मुख्यतः “महसूस करना” है, न कि “चुनना।” दूसरी बात, हममें से कई लोगों के लिए परमेश्वर की कही बात पर विश्वास करना आसान होता है, जब वह हमारे अनुभव, विचारों और भावनाओं से मेल खाती है; समस्या तब आती है जब पवित्रशास्त्र की बातें मेरी इच्छा, मेरे दृष्टिकोण, मेरे विश्वास, मेरे अनुभव आदि को चुनौती देती हैं।

पहली बात (विश्वास करना=महसूस करना) पर प्रेरित पौलुस के माध्यम से परमेश्वर का स्पष्ट उत्तर है: क्योंकि हम विश्वास से चलते हैं, न कि देखने से: –2 कुरिन्थियों 5:7. दूसरी बात पर वास्तविकता यह है कि इनमें से हर संघर्ष इस बात की स्पष्ट परीक्षा है कि क्या हम मनुष्य की (जिसमें हम स्वयं भी शामिल हैं) आज्ञा मानने के बजाय परमेश्वर की आज्ञा मानेंगे, क्या हम परमेश्वर को सच्चा और हर मनुष्य को झूठा ठहरने देंगे (जिसमें हम स्वयं भी शामिल हैं), और क्या हम सभी बातों में परमेश्वर को अधिकारी मानेंगे या फिर अपनी ही इच्छा पर अड़े रहेंगे। हममें से कई लोग सभी बातों में परमेश्वर पर भरोसा करने और विश्वास करने का दावा करते हैं (केवल मुँह से कहते हैं), फिर भी जब हमारी अपनी परीक्षा की घड़ी आती है, तो हम बुरी तरह असफल होते हैं (मैं जानता हूँ कि मैं हुआ हूँ)।

इसके अलावा, हममें से कई लोग संदेह और चिंता से भरी अपनी जीवनशैली को सामान्य मानते हैं, जबकि बाइबल हमें बताती है कि किसी बात की चिन्ता न करो और अपनी सारी चिन्ता अपने प्रभु पर डाल दो। यहाँ दुनिया ने धीरे-धीरे पवित्रशास्त्र की स्पष्ट शिक्षा के प्रति हमारी संवेदनाओं को कुंद कर दिया है, इसलिए हम उस बात को सामान्य मानने लगे हैं जिससे परमेश्वर चाहता है कि हम ऊपर उठें। यदि हम पीछे हटकर “भय” की परिभाषा को एक दायरे के रूप में देखें, जिसमें कुछ भय बहुत हल्का और कुछ बहुत गंभीर होता है, तो हम देखेंगे कि हमारे व्यवहार के कई स्वीकृत तौर-तरीके हमारे जीवन के लिए परमेश्वर की सिद्ध इच्छा से बाहर हैं। संदेह इस दायरे के हल्के छोर पर होगा, चिंता का प्रभाव और असर उससे कुछ अधिक होगा, जबकि घबराना या व्याकुल हो जाना स्पष्ट रूप से हमारे सामान्य जीवन में कहीं अधिक बाधा डालेगा। फिर भी सच्चाई यह है कि इनमें से हर एक “भय” के ही परिवार में आता है, और इसका परिणाम यह होता है कि हम भय को स्वयं पर नियंत्रण करने और अपने विचारों तथा व्यवहारों को निर्देशित करने दे रहे हैं। परमेश्वर की इच्छा है कि उसकी सारी संतान भय के बजाय विश्वास से चले।

परमेश्वर हमारी किसी भी चिंता के लिए, न ही भविष्य के किसी संभावित “अगर ऐसा हुआ तो” के लिए, हमें अनुग्रह नहीं देता। परमेश्वर हमें केवल उस परिस्थिति से गुज़रने का अनुग्रह देता है जिसे वह पल-पल हमारे सामने रखता है। जिस प्रकार गर्भवती स्त्री को प्रसव-पीड़ा की भयावह संभावनाओं से होकर गुजरना पड़ता है, उसी प्रकार सभी मनुष्यों को हर उस परिस्थिति से गुजरना पड़ता है जिसे परमेश्वर हमारे जीवन का हिस्सा ठहराता है। हम जो कुछ सोचने या करने की कोशिश करते हैं (भय करना, चिंता करना, कहीं जाना, अपना ठिकाना बदलना, पैसे खर्च करना या दूसरों से हस्तक्षेप करने को कहना आदि), उससे परमेश्वर की हमारे जीवन के लिए इच्छा रुकेगी या बदलेगी नहीं। हमारे जीवन में अपरिहार्य बात को स्वीकार करना या उसका विरोध करना हमारी पसंद है।

वास्तविकता यह है—हममें से हर एक या तो शैतान के झूठों पर विश्वास करके और भय को अपने विचारों तथा कार्यों को प्रेरित और निर्देशित करने देते हुए अपने अंगों को अधर्म के हथियार बनाकर पाप के हवाले करेगा, या फिर परमेश्वर के वचन में उसकी कही बात पर विश्वास करना चुनकर और विश्वास को अपने विचारों तथा कार्यों को प्रेरित और निर्देशित करने देते हुए अपने आप को मरे हुओं में से जीवित हुए लोगों के समान परमेश्वर के हवाले करेगा, और अपने अंगों को धार्मिकता के हथियार बनाकर परमेश्वर के हवाले करेगा (रोमियों 6:13)।

यहाँ एक संतुलित दृष्टिकोण प्रस्तुत करना आवश्यक है। इसका अर्थ यह नहीं कि हम कठिन परिस्थितियों से कभी संघर्ष नहीं करते—यीशु ने गतसमनी के बगीचे में ऐसा किया था। इसका यह अर्थ भी नहीं कि हम अपनी मौजूदा दर्दनाक परिस्थिति को बदलने पर विचार करने के लिए परमेश्वर या अपने अधिकारियों से कभी विनती नहीं करते—यीशु ने ऐसा भी किया था। बल्कि, हमें अपने हृदय के संघर्ष के बारे में परमेश्वर से ईमानदार होना चाहिए (जैसे यीशु थे), लेकिन फिर हमें अंततः विश्वास और साहस के साथ आज्ञाकारिता में आगे बढ़ना चाहिए (जैसे यीशु बढ़े)।

“My lady, I thank you very much for your affection and favor towards me, but I have given myself entirely to God to be His friend, and with that I hope to live and die,” rang the confident, faith-filled words of Jacques “zhahk” (a French form of the male name Jacob or James).

Persecution was fiercely raging in Europe in the year 1550. For their profession of faith in Jesus Christ, men, women, and even children were snatched from their homes and meeting places and thrown into the dark and cold dungeon cells of area castles. Among these captives, fifteen-year-old Jacques Dosie found himself imprisoned in Leeuwarden, Holland, for the truth of the Gospel. Even though he was only fifteen years old, he was known by his upright testimony and knowledge of the Scriptures, bringing glory to God through the power of the Spirit.

The Lord and Lady Friesland, with many nobles and ladies, were assembled in the royal halls in Leeuwarden. Their conversation turned to the “baptist heretics” that were filling the land.

“Let’s bring in that young lad, Jacques. Surely he has not been too contaminated with this heresy.”

So, he was brought in to be interrogated. Lord Friesland spoke only a few words and seemed in a hurry to finish. He had no time for this talk of religion, especially with guests waiting for a more enjoyable entertainment. Lady Friesland, however, seemed moved with compassion for this youth who was so cruelly bound in the dungeon.

“Why are you in prison? You are only a youth. What brought you here?” she asked.

Jacques answered, “I was captured and thrown into prison only because I believe in Jesus Christ. I abide by Him alone and will not forsake Him.”

The royal lady asked him, “Surely you are not one of those heretics who rebaptized themselves and have perpetrated so much evil in our country? They say they are dispersed on account of their faith and boast of being the church of God. But they are a wicked and rebellious people and cause great commotion in the land.”

“My lady, I do not know any rebellious people nor am I one of their number,” replied Jacques. “But we would much rather, according to the teachings of the Scriptures, assist our enemies. If they hunger and thirst, we bless them with food and drink. We never resist them with revenge or violence as we read in Matthew 5:39.”

“If you were in a position of power it would be seen whether you would assist your enemies,” sneered one of the nobles.

Jacques replied, “Oh, no, my lord, if it were permitted among us to resist the evil with the carnal sword, I would never do so.”

“I know there are sects among you who are very wicked and kill the people. They have their goods and wives in common,” said Lady Friesland.

“Oh, no,” replied Jacques. “We are unjustly charged with these wicked things. We are falsely accused of evil as a means to be persecuted. But as taught in Matthew 5:11, we must suffer and endure all this with patience.”

“No, my lady, we are not of them,” answered Jacques. “Those people erred greatly. We regard it as a doctrine of the devil to resist the authorities with the sword and violence. We would much rather suffer persecution and death from the authorities.”

“Nevertheless, you are considered to be one of them, because you too make an uproar in the land,” insisted the royal lady. “However, I believe what you say concerning those Muensterites.”

“But, my lady, don’t we read about this in Acts 24:5, how wicked men spoke evil of the apostles themselves as well as the whole band of Christians?” countered Jacques. “Did not wicked men seek to incite the authorities to vengeance against the Christians, though it was all falsehood?”
