Tazama, utukufu wa BWANA ukaonekana katika wingu –Kut 16:10.

Ni jambo la ajabu jinsi gani mkusanyiko huu mnene wa mvuke unavyosafiri katika anga lililo juu yetu. Katika tukio moja, wingu linaweza kuleta baraka na tumaini kubwa sana, ilhali katika jingine linaweza kuwa chanzo cha mashaka yanayosumbua na hata kuchochea hofu kali. Bila shaka, mara nyingi mawingu yalikuwa kivuli kilichokaribishwa na vichwa vya wavuvi waliochoka kwenye Galilaya na chanzo cha tumaini kwa mkulima mwenye taabu. Mara nyingi jinsi gani mawingu haya hutengana adhuhuri na kuruhusu miale inayong’aa ya jua kuifikia dunia. Kisha jioni, yanatoa mandhari tulivu ambamo uzuri wa ajabu wa mstari wa fedha hung’aa.

Tunaweza kushangaa kuona ndege yenye uzito wa zaidi ya pauni 700,000 ikipaa kwa mabawa na kuruka juu angani, ilhali wingu linaweza kubeba mamilioni ya tani za maji bila nguvu zozote za binadamu kuingilia kati. Mawingu hutokea wakati hewa yenye unyevunyevu na joto inapoinuka hadi kwenye kimo chenye baridi zaidi, na maji huganda juu ya “mbegu” ndogo sana kama vile vumbi, majivu au bakteria. Ikiwa kuna mvuke wa maji mwingi kuliko sehemu zinazoweza kugandia, basi fuwele za barafu pia zinaweza kutumika kama mbegu na kuvuta unyevunyevu—Huyafunga maji katika mawingu yake mazito; wala wingu halipasuki kwa uzito wake –Ayu 26:8. Hatimaye, mbegu hizi huwa nzito sana hivi kwamba mikondo ya hewa inayopaa haiwezi kuzishikilia, kisha, tazama, wakati wa mwavuli huwa umefika.

Kwa nchi iliyokauka sana katika siku za Eliya, wingu dogo kabisa (kama mkono wa mtu katika 1 Wafalme 18:44) lilikuwa jibu kutoka kwa Mwenyezi kwamba alikuwa tayari tena kuwabariki watu wake kwa mvua. Hata hivyo, kwa wengine kama Ayubu na Yeremia, wingu liliwakilisha ishara kuu ya mashaka, kukata tamaa na kuvunjika moyo. Vitisho vimenigeukia; vinaifuatilia nafsi yangu kama upepo; na heri yangu hupita kama wingu –Ayu 30:15, na Umejifunika kwa wingu, ili maombi yetu yasipite –Omb 3:44. Mara nyingi ni katika hali hizo zenye msongo ambapo Mungu huchagua kujificha katika wingu. Nyakati hizo, tunapapasa-papasa katika ukungu mzito na wa kuogofya tukitafuta njia ya nuru, lakini hatuipati. Tunapovunjika moyo, huenda tukatamani miale ya siku isiyo na mawingu, lakini hutukwepa. Tunajua kwamba Mungu yumo katikati ya ukungu, lakini hatuwezi kumtambua wala kuuona wema wake. Hufunika nuru kwa mawingu; wala haiamuru iangaze kwa sababu ya wingu lililo katikati –Ayu 36:32.

Kwa nini Mungu wetu, anayependa kushirikiana nasi, viumbe alivyoviumba mwenyewe, achague kujificha katika wingu? Kwa nini mara nyingi huficha mapenzi yake yasifikiwe na mioyo yetu inayotafuta na kuumia? Akili zetu zenye mipaka mara nyingi hujiuliza ni utukufu gani ambao ungeweza kutokana na Mungu aliye mbali kiasi hicho, na …upotevu huu ni wa nini? –Mt 26:8. Ingawa hatutarajii kamwe kwamba mpango wa Mungu ni kutuacha katika hali ya kuchanganyikiwa na ukungu milele, huenda hilo likawa mapenzi yake kwa muda fulani. Kama matembezi katika bonde la uvuli wa mauti, nafsi iliyopitia kipindi cha kutokuwa na uwazi kuhusu njia yake inaweza kukuza tabia ya milele. Tunafahamu vyema kwamba njia ya wenye haki ni kama nuru ing’aayo, ikizidi kung’aa hata mchana mkamilifu –Mit 4:18. Hata hivyo, wengi wetu tumepitia nyakati fulani ukungu usio na tumaini unaozingira wakati wetu wa sasa na wa baadaye. Nyakati hizo, hukutana na giza wakati wa mchana, na kupapasa-papasa adhuhuri kama wakati wa usiku –Ayu 5:14. Katika kuvunjika moyo kwetu, ni rahisi kupoteza mtazamo wa wema wa Mungu. Ukosefu wetu wa shukrani unaotokana na hali hiyo ni njia ya hakika ya kutupeleka kwenye majaribu mengine mengi, huku jitu la kukata tamaa likiinuka juu yetu likijaribu kudhoofisha upinzani wetu dhidi ya dhambi.

Tunajua kwamba Eliya alikuwa mwanadamu mwenye tabia moja na sisi –Yak 5:17. Hata hivyo, ni wachache wetu ambao wamewahi kupata ushindi wa kusisimua kama ule alioupata alipowashinda manabii wa Baali kwenye Mlima Karmeli. Lakini wengi wetu tunaweza kuelewa vyema kuvunjika moyo kulikofuata alipofika Horebu na kukaa katika pango. Hapa ni mahali pale pale pa Mlima Sinai ambapo tukio kuu la kwanza la mlimani lilianza mbele yetu katika Maandiko. Wakati huo Musa ndiye aliyekutana na Mungu katika wingu. Sheria ilitolewa, na utukufu wa Mungu ulidhihirishwa kwa namna ya ajabu sana, hata huo ulikuwa ni wa kutisha sana, hata Musa akasema, Naogopa mno na kutetemeka –Ebr 12:21. Huu mlima ulioweza kuguswa ulikuwa mlima wa kutisha na wa kuogofya, uliopakana na vilele vya granite nyeusi vilivyopasuka na miinuko mikali yenye fahari isiyoelezeka. Uso wa Horebu wenye ujasiri na wa kutisha huinuka kwa fahari ya kuogofya, kutoka urefu wa futi mia moja na ishirini hadi mia moja na hamsini kwa wima.

Maono ya Eliya yalipofunikwa na wingu na roho yake ikazidi kudhoofika mpaka kufikia hali ya chini kabisa, Mungu alimjibu kwa njia ya kushangaza—…Na tazama, BWANA akapita; upepo mkubwa wenye nguvu ukapasua milima na kuvunja-vunja miamba mbele za BWANA; lakini BWANA hakuwamo katika upepo ule; na baada ya upepo tetemeko la nchi; lakini BWANA hakuwamo katika lile tetemeko la nchi; na baada ya tetemeko la nchi kukawa na moto; lakini BWANA hakuwamo katika moto ule; na baada ya moto sauti ndogo, tulivu. Ikawa, Eliya alipoisikia, akajifunika uso wake kwa vazi lake, akatoka nje… –1 Fal 19:11-13.

Kwa namna fulani, tumefikia kuamini kwamba tukio linalotikisa dunia ndilo kilele cha uwepo wa Mungu unaodhihirika. Tunadhani Mungu alikuwa karibu zaidi na Eliya kwenye Mlima Karmeli kuliko alivyokuwa kwenye Mlima Horebu. Ilikuwa “siku yake ya kung’aa” Eliya alipohubiri kwenye Mlima Karmeli. Aliwakemea watu na kuwadhihaki manabii. Alihubiri kwa ujasiri kwa jina la Bwana na kuwaamuru watu watubu kwa sababu ya unafiki wao. Lakini sasa sauti yake imenyamazishwa, naye anasikiliza … akisikiliza sauti ndogo, tulivu inayomwita awajibike kwa matendo na matamanio yake mwenyewe. Hivyo basi, tukisimama tu na kusikiliza, kumbukumbu ya kushindwa kwetu kwa kusikitisha itatuongoza mpaka kwenye baraza la mbele la Bwana wetu, badala ya kuturuhusu kujisifu kwa mafanikio tunayodhani tumepata.

Huu ndio huduma yenye baraka ya wingu. Mara nyingi ndilo chombo ambacho Bwana hutumia kutuleta mahali ambapo tunaweza kupokea kwa kweli utukufu wake unaodhihirika mioyoni mwetu. Haya si mawingu meupe, laini ya cumulus ya siku tulivu ya kiangazi, bali ni mawingu ya stratus yaliyo tambarare na yasiyo na umbo maalumu, yanayofunika anga kuanzia mashariki hadi magharibi na kuzuia kabisa miale yote ya jua la mbinguni. Yanaweza kuufunika mchana wakati wa adhuhuri kwa giza tele linalochoma mioyo yetu hadi kilindini. Mambo madogo ambayo siku nyingine hayakuwa na athari kubwa kwa mitazamo yetu sasa yanaonekana kama majitu yanayotuogopesha. Huenda tukakabiliwa na mambo yanayotokea ambayo tunajua hatuwezi kuyadhibiti, lakini akili zetu zinakataa kutulia. Nyakati kama hizo, ikiwa kwa bahati mbaya kuna mtu upande wa pili wa mazungumzo yetu anayepitia shida kama hiyo, tunaweza kujionea wenyewe kwamba …mwanadamu amezaliwa ili apate taabu, kama vile cheche za moto zirukavyo juu –Ayu 5:7. Nyakati nyingine, hali yetu ya huzuni inaweza kuridhika kujitenga na kujilisha kwa kujihurumia na taabu zetu wenyewe za upweke na ukungu.

Wengine, kwa kukata tamaa, hugeukia dawa za akili na huko hupata nafuu kwa kiwango fulani. Lakini Mungu hakutuingiza katika wingu ili tutafute msaada wa waganga na wanasaikolojia. Huduma ya wingu ni kufunga njia zote nyingine ili tupokee kutoka kwake faraja yake iliyojaa baraka. Mungu yuko tayari tutekeleze jua linalong’aa la leo kwa ajili ya utimilifu wa uwepo wake kesho.

Maana hamjui yatakayokuwako kesho. Maana maisha yenu ni nini? Maana ninyi ni mvuke, uonekanao kwa kitambo, kisha hutoweka –Yak 4:14. Miaka iliyopita, nilihubiri juu ya mstari huu, nikizihimiza nafsi kuhusu ufupi wa maisha na kuzitia moyo zisipoteze miaka yao. Lakini nilikuwa nimepuuza kabisa msingi wake—hamjui yatakayokuwako kesho. Huenda hili likaonekana jambo dogo kwa wale walio na moyo mchanga, lakini kadiri matunda ya umri wangu yanavyoendelea kuiva, ndivyo ninavyozidi kuthamini misemo ya kawaida na iliyo wazi. Ulimwengu wetu wa kisasa wa kisayansi unafuata kwa msisitizo mkubwa sana kupenda maisha kiasi kwamba hauwezi kuthamini maisha ya upendo yanayozaliwa kupitia mateso. Ingawa wale walioteseka katika mwili na kuacha dhambi zamani (1 Pet 4:1), sioni sababu kwa nini wale wanaopitia mateso dhaifu ya akili iliyofunikwa na wingu wasishiriki utukufu huo huo, ikiwa tu watavumilia na kumwachia Mungu matokeo.

Sisi ni watu wenye kiburi tunaotegemea utabiri wa kesho. Tunajidanganya kwamba tunaweza kupanga kustaafu kwetu na kupanga matukio ya maisha yetu kwa undani usio na dosari. Watabiri wa hali ya hewa hutuambia halijoto ya kesho ili tuweze kupanga siku yetu kwa umakini. Bima yetu hutuhakikishia kwamba hatutakabiliwa na umaskini siku zijazo. Friza zetu na akaunti zetu za benki zimejaa vya kutosha kutuendesha hata baada ya kesho, nasi tumezoea kuamini kwamba …naketi kama malkia, wala mimi si mjane, wala sitaona huzuni –Ufu 18:7. Hata hivyo, huzuni ya moyo haiwezi kuondolewa kwa urahisi hivyo kwa huduma za duniani. Maisha yetu ni mvuke (wingu) kwa sababu …hatujui yatakayokuwako kesho… –Yak 4:14. Licha ya teknolojia yetu yote, bado hatuwezi kuondoa ukweli huo. Hapo ndipo tunapopaswa kuweka kando hisia zetu, matarajio yetu na matamanio yetu yote kuhusu maisha yetu yanavyopaswa kuwa, na kumkuta Mungu wetu katika wingu.

Huzuia uso wa kiti chake cha enzi, na kutandaza wingu lake juu yake –Ayu 26:9. Kuna faida gani wingu linapofunika uso wa kiti cha enzi cha Mungu? Kama kingeonekana kwa urahisi, wengi wetu tungeridhika kukaa naye kwa mbali. Hata hivyo, kwa sababu ya ukungu unaotukaribia, ni lazima tusogee karibu ili kuonja utimilifu wake. Tunapaswa kushukuru sana kwamba mambo yako hivi, kwa maana hasara yetu ya kiroho ingekuwa kubwa jinsi gani kama isingekuwa hivyo.

Kama maisha yetu ya kujitegemea yangeendelea kuwa na uhai mwingi daima na Mungu angeweza kutambuliwa kwa urahisi, tungepoteza…

…Imani

Tunataka uhakikisho kwamba majaribu yetu yataishia kwa furaha ya kudumu na kwamba maombi yetu kwa kawaida hayatakuwa tena na ulazima. Kwa imani, tunaamini katika riziki ya Mungu, lakini ukweli kwamba hatujui siku italeta nini unatuhitaji tupige magoti yetu dhaifu na kuomba. Huenda kuna mambo mengi yanayotufanya iwe vigumu kumtumaini Mungu, lakini kutokujulikana kwa kesho iliyofunikwa na wingu hurahisisha jambo hilo. Watafiti wametumia mamilioni katika juhudi zao za kudhibiti hali ya hewa. Wametawanya kila aina ya mbegu za mawingu zinazoweza kuwazika angani kwa juhudi za kutokeza mawingu ya mvua. Baada ya kukagua miaka 40 ya juhudi za kutawanya mbegu za mawingu katika eneo lililo kaskazini mwa Israeli, watafiti katika Chuo Kikuu cha Tel Aviv wamehitimisha kwamba kutawanya mbegu za mawingu kwa kweli hakuleti ongezeko lolote la mvua. Tunapaswa kushukuru sana. Kadiri tunavyoweza kudhibiti kesho isiyojulikana, ndivyo tunavyohitaji imani kidogo kwa Bwana wa Ulimwengu.

Yakobo, alipomwacha nyuma ndugu mwenye hasira, baba aliyekatishwa tamaa, na uhusiano uliokatika na mama yake, alikabili wakati ujao usiojulikana kabisa. Hii ni sehemu ya ngazi inayoelekea kwenye kiti cha enzi, nayo huimarisha kujitoa kwetu kwa Mungu wetu mwenye uweza wote. Sasa tunajua kwa sehemu, na tunaona kwa sehemu. Huenda kipande hicho kidogo kikatuongezea utajiri wa ndani zaidi kuliko kama tungeelewa kila kitu kikamilifu. Kama wakati wetu ujao ungekuwa chini ya uwezo wetu wa kuutengeneza kwa wingi, tungeunda utopia kamilifu yenye idadi kamili ya watoto wanaoishi kwa anasa katika nyumba kamilifu, wakitegemezwa na kazi kamilifu na kuzungukwa na mwenendo mkamilifu ulio tasa na mfu kabisa.

…Tumaini

Najiuliza kama tunatambua jinsi tunavyodaiwa sana na mambo yasiyotazamiwa. Mwandishi wa Waebrania anasema tumaini letu ni …nanga ya nafsi, yenye salama na thabiti… –Ebr 6:19. Watoto huwa na furaha kwa sababu wana ndoto kubwa. Mara nyingi matarajio na mipango ya tukio husisimua karibu sawa na safari yenyewe. Kila siku ni dirisha jipya lenye nuru kwa akili isiyoharibiwa na iliyojaa tumaini. Tunapotazama mambo kupitia masikitiko ya jana, mambo tuliyoyapitia mara nyingi yanaweza kutupeleka ukingoni mwa kuwa na mashaka na uchungu. Yakobo, hata baada ya kuunganishwa tena kwa ajabu na mwanawe Yosefu, bado alisema, siku za maisha yangu zimekuwa chache na mbaya. Ingawa mambo huwa hivyo kwa kawaida, si lazima yawe hivyo. Paulo anasema …dhiki huleta saburi; na saburi huleta utahiniwa; na utahiniwa huleta tumaini –Rum 5:3-4. Hakika, kama tungejua yaliyotusubiri kesho (mazuri na mabaya), kipengele chenye kuchangamsha cha tumaini kingepungua. Hawa alijifanya kwamba maisha yangekuwa bora kama tu angeweza kupata maarifa zaidi. Lakini tumaini lenye baraka jinsi gani alilopoteza katika harakati yake ya kutamani uwazi.

…Upendo

Kuna upole wa mapenzi uliojaa hisia ambao hakuna kitu isipokuwa kutokuwa na uhakika kinachoweza kuleta. Ni mshangao usio na uhakika unaozunguka njia ya kijana na msichana. Hatari zisizojulikana za kesho humsukuma mama kuwapenda watoto wake na kuwaombea. Ni maono ya kesho angavu zaidi kwa familia yake yanayomsukuma baba kufanya kazi yake ya kila siku kwa bidii. Mahali popote ambapo mume na mke wameunganishwa katika umoja wa kibiblia wa ndoa takatifu, fumbo linaloifunika kesho huwa kama noti ndogo katika melodi kuu. Husema kwa furaha kuhusu huzuni inayodokezwa, na kuangaza huzuni kwa furaha inayoizunguka. Je, miaka saba ambayo Yakobo alingoja ingeonekana kama siku chache kama angejua kesho ingeleta nini? Kama tungejua kila kitu, upendo ungekuwa mgumu mno. Kama tungejua kila kitu, upendo ungekuwa rahisi mno. Kama tungejua kila kitu, mioyo yetu ingevunjika. Kama tungejua kila kitu, tusingejali. Kwa maneno mengine, kutokujua mabaya zaidi hutufanya kuwa imara zaidi, na kutokujua mazuri zaidi hutufanya kuwa wapole zaidi. Kwa maana katika mtazamo wetu uliofunikwa na wingu na kutiwa giza, …hudumu imani, tumaini, upendo, haya matatu; na katika hayo lililo kuu ni upendo –1 Kor 13:13.

Si kwa bahati kwamba wanafunzi walipokuwa …wakitazama, akachukuliwa juu; wingu likampokea kutoka machoni pao –Mdo 1:9. Kwa hiyo hatupaswi kushangaa kwamba nyakati fulani tutaitwa kuvumilia mkazo na msongo wa kiakili wa kesho isiyoeleweka na isiyojulikana. …Maana maisha yenu ni nini? Maana ninyi ni mvuke, uonekanao kwa kitambo, kisha hutoweka –Yak 4:14. Siku inakuja ambapo …watamwona Mwana wa Adamu akija katika wingu pamoja na nguvu na utukufu mwingi –Lk 21:27. Tena imeandikwa, Tazama, yuaja pamoja na mawingu; na kila jicho litamwona … Naam, Amina –Ufu 1:7.

If marriage is a covenant, what is the significance of covenant relationship? What makes it a covenant relationship, and how does this differ from any other relationship? These are answers that we must pursue if we are to understand the permanence of marriage and if we are to successfully navigate the rocky shores of a troubled marriage.

Covenant in our society has become archaic. The cultural revolution of the sixties has made divorce culturally acceptable, and life-long fidelity in marriage has become the exception rather than the rule. Unfortunately, this blight has infected most mainstream churches and is currently invading our Anabaptist churches.

Covenant is God’s idea. He is the primary covenant maker. His holy name “Jehovah” indicates that God is always true to His word. The Hebrew origin of “Jehovah” is yeh-ho-vaw. This word combines two Hebrew verbs of being. A most literal translation for the name yeh-ho-vaw would be (is is) or as God said to Moses “I am that I am.”

God’s name “Jehovah” indicates that God is always true to His word, that he cannot lie, and that He is true to His character. James states it this way: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning –Jas 1:17.

What makes a covenant?

Careful investigation of scripture will reveal that there are three key elements in the establishment of a covenant.

  • Words
  • Witnesses
  • That which ratifies the covenant

Words

Words define the terms and conditions of a covenant. It is very important that the terms and conditions of the covenant be clearly defined and understood by both parties involved. When God made covenant with Abraham, He spake and said, And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee, and to thy seed after thee –Gen 17:7.

When God made covenant with the nation of Israel at Mt Sinai, He gave them the Law which was the terms and conditions of the Mosaic covenant.

In our Bibles today we have the Old and the New Testament. This refers to the Old and the New Covenant. In the New Testament we have the teachings of Jesus and His Apostles which supersede the Old Testament law. In the Sermon on the Mount, Jesus said repeatedly, “You have heard that it hath been said, but I say unto you.”

The Hebrew writer had this to say about the New Covenant: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises –Heb 8:6.

On our wedding day we use words with precise meaning to establish a covenant that is binding “…till death do us part.” Wedding vows may contain some variation but should always include a commitment to a mutually loving relationship that is binding for life, and thus irrevocable.

Witnesses

Another important part of a covenant is the witnesses. Witnesses provide validation and accountability to the vows that have been made. This is especially true of a covenant made between two people.

When Joshua re-established the covenant with Israel upon entering the land of Canaan, he challenged them: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you the LORD, to serve him. And they said, We are witnesses –Jos 24:22. What they were saying was that, “We will hold one another accountable for the commitments that we are making today.”

Regarding the New Covenant, we have the testimony of the Apostle John where he says: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one. And there are three that bear witness in earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one –1Joh 5:7-8. Here John is saying that in this New Covenant between God and man there are three witnesses in heaven and three witnesses in earth, and these witnesses all agree.

In the establishment of a marriage covenant the wedding guests are the witnesses. Every guest becomes a witness of the vows that are made. By their presence and blessing, they validate the marriage and become personally responsible to ensure that this marriage endures.

This community commitment to the permanence of marriage is the moral fabric of our society and our churches. When a society becomes negligent in enforcing the permanence of marriage, chaos and confusion ensue. We see this in the society around us. Unfortunately, we are also seeing an increasing number of marriage breakups within our Anabaptist churches.

That which ratifies the covenant

The final step in establishing a covenant is that which ratifies and renders binding and effective the terms of the covenant. Historically there have been a variety of methods of binding a covenant. Ancient Bedouins had a practice of using salt to bind a covenant. Each party would give to the other a measure of salt. The salt was mixed with their respective stores of salt making it impossible to ever separate “my salt” from “your salt.” This symbolized the immutability of this treaty.

Then there was the practice of berith. Berith is a Hebrew word that means “to cut.” In ancient Israel a covenant was ratified by “cutting a covenant.” This practice is clearly illustrated in Genesis 15 where God ratified His covenant with Abraham. Abraham asked God, …Lord GOD, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it? –Gen 15:8. God’s response to Abraham’s plea was …Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon –Gen 15:9. Abraham took these animals and divided them in the midst and lay them out as a sacrifice to God. God reaffirmed His covenant with Abraham (with words), and then in verse 17, we have this mysterious event: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces –Gen 15:17. This was “berith” or the “cutting of the covenant.” This ceremony ratified and rendered binding the terms and conditions of the covenant. After this event, we have no record that Abraham ever questioned or doubted the promise of God, although he did take it into his own hands to bring that promise to fruition.

When God made covenant with Israel at Mt Sinai, …Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the LORD hath made with you concerning all these words –Exo 24:8. This blood rendered binding and effective the terms and conditions set forth in the law—this was the Old Covenant.

When God made covenant with you and I at Mt Calvary, the blood of Jesus became the ratifying evidence or the binding token of His New Covenant with us. When we partake of the communion, we are commemorating the covenant that we have with God through Christ.

What ratifies the marriage covenant? As we have already seen, in a marriage we have words (the vows), and we have witnesses (the guests). Does this complete the marriage? No. The marriage is not complete until there is a coming together in physical intimacy. This completes or, as we sometimes say, consummates the marriage covenant. This is that which ratifies and renders binding and permanent the terms and conditions of the marriage covenant. Early on in Scripture we have example of this. And Adam knew Eve his wife… Gen 4:1. Then later on we see another example, And Isaac brought her [Rebekah] into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her… –Gen 24:67. Physical oneness belongs to covenant. This is why such a relationship outside of marriage is sin. Fornication or adultery takes that which God has ordained to be inextricably linked to marriage and adulterates the covenant.

When a married couple comes together in physical union they are commemorating and celebrating their marriage covenant. This is the start of them establishing a biblical “one flesh” reality. From this blessed union new life emerges in the form of precious “little ones” and of hearts that are renewed by the power of love.

When we partake of the bread and the wine of communion we are commemorating and celebrating our covenant relationship with Christ. From this blessed oneness new life emerges in the form of hearts that are renewed by the power of love. This is the strength of covenant.

Where these three elements exist—vows, witnesses, and that which ratifies—we have a covenant relationship. How does a covenant relationship differ from any other relationship?

A commitment to fidelity

Some of the most noble words that human lips can utter are “I promise to love you till death do us part.” On our wedding day these words are easy to utter, and we may be most sincere when we speak them. The fact is that no one can possibly know what those words may cost in the course of a lifetime.

Love is a choice and must become established and endure as an every day walk of life. We must choose to direct our affection toward the one of our covenant love and away from the enticements of others. Many, many marriages are destroyed through infidelity.

God has designed marriage to be powerfully bonding. The spiritual, emotional, and physical attachment of marriage creates an inseparable bond. In Genesis we read Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh –Gen 2:24. The word cleave in this verse denotes “being welded or glued together in such a way as to be inseparable.”

To break the marriage bond through infidelity causes rending and wounding to both parties. Satan, the great deceiver, would have us to believe that being unfaithful to our spouse will somehow benefit us. This is a huge lie.

A commitment to faithfulness

God demonstrated covenant faithfulness in his dealings with His Old Testament bride—the nation of Israel. She was not true to her covenant vows. She turned from the worship of Jehovah, and she bowed her knee to pagan altars. Despite her unfaithfulness, God continued to pursue her and call her back unto himself. Israel’s unfaithfulness did not alter God’s faithfulness. This is the strength of covenant love. Covenant love is not contingent upon the actions of the other party. Covenant love persists even though it is not reciprocated. This is a kingdom concept. Paul taught, Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head –Rom 12:20. Would this principle not most aptly apply to a broken marriage?

The strength of covenant can only be fully realized through an understanding of the divine love of God for us. Our salvation is dependent upon God’s perfect love for us. He continues to love us even though our love for Him is sometimes flawed. His unfailing love continues to draw us back unto himself. The strength of covenant in marriage is found in seeking to emulate this divine love. This divine love will not be found in romance novels or other books on marriage. This divine love can only be found in an intimate relationship with “The Source” of undying love.

यदि विवाह एक वाचा है, तो वाचा के संबंध का क्या महत्त्व है? यह वाचा का संबंध किस बात से बनता है, और यह किसी अन्य संबंध से किस प्रकार भिन्न है? यदि हमें विवाह की स्थायित्व को समझना है और संकटग्रस्त विवाह के कठिन दौर से सफलतापूर्वक निकलना है, तो हमें इन प्रश्नों के उत्तर खोजने होंगे।

हमारे समाज में वाचा की धारणा पुरानी पड़ गई है। साठ के दशक की सांस्कृतिक क्रांति ने तलाक को सांस्कृतिक रूप से स्वीकार्य बना दिया है, और विवाह में आजीवन निष्ठा नियम के बजाय अपवाद बन गई है। दुर्भाग्य से, इस बुराई ने अधिकांश मुख्यधारा के कलीसियाई समुदायों को संक्रमित कर दिया है और अब हमारे अनाबैपटिस्ट कलीसियाई समुदायों में भी फैल रही है।

वाचा परमेश्वर की कल्पना है। वाचा बाँधने वाला मुख्य पक्ष वही है। उसका पवित्र नाम “यहोवा” दर्शाता है कि परमेश्वर अपनी बात का सदा सच्चा रहता है। “यहोवा” का इब्रानी मूल येहोवा है। यह शब्द अस्तित्व के दो इब्रानी क्रियापदों को मिलाकर बना है। येहोवा नाम का सबसे शाब्दिक अनुवाद “है है” होगा, या जैसा परमेश्वर ने मूसा से कहा था, “मैं जो हूँ सो हूँ।”

परमेश्वर का नाम “यहोवा” दर्शाता है कि परमेश्वर अपनी बात का सदा सच्चा रहता है, वह झूठ नहीं बोल सकता, और वह अपने चरित्र के प्रति सच्चा है। याकूब इसे इस प्रकार कहता है: हर एक अच्छा वरदान और हर एक उत्तम दान ऊपर ही से है, और ज्योतियों के पिता की ओर से मिलता है, जिसमें न तो कोई परिवर्तन हो सकता है और न अदल-बदल के कारण उस पर छाया पड़ती है—याकूब 1:17।

वाचा किस बात से बनती है?

पवित्रशास्त्र की सावधानीपूर्वक जाँच से पता चलता है कि वाचा स्थापित करने के तीन प्रमुख तत्व हैं।

  • शब्द
  • साक्षी
  • वह जो वाचा को पुष्ट करता है

शब्द

शब्द वाचा की शर्तों और नियमों को परिभाषित करते हैं। यह बहुत महत्त्वपूर्ण है कि वाचा की शर्तें और नियम स्पष्ट रूप से परिभाषित हों और उसमें शामिल दोनों पक्ष उन्हें समझें। जब परमेश्वर ने अब्राहम के साथ वाचा बाँधी, तो उसने कहा, और मैं तेरे साथ और तेरे पश्चात् तेरे वंश के साथ भी उनकी पीढ़ी-पीढ़ी में अपनी वाचा बाँधूँगा, कि मैं तेरे और तेरे पश्चात् तेरे वंश का परमेश्वर रहूँगा—उत्पत्ति 17:7।

जब परमेश्वर ने सीनै पर्वत पर इस्राएल राष्ट्र के साथ वाचा बाँधी, तो उसने उन्हें व्यवस्था दी, जो मूसा की वाचा की शर्तें और नियम थे।

आज हमारी बाइबलों में पुराना और नया नियम है। यह पुरानी और नई वाचा को दर्शाता है। नए नियम में यीशु और उसके प्रेरितों की शिक्षाएँ हैं, जो पुराने नियम की व्यवस्था का स्थान लेती हैं। पहाड़ी उपदेश में यीशु ने बार-बार कहा, “तुम सुन चुके हो कि कहा गया था, परन्तु मैं तुम से कहता हूँ।”

इब्रानियों के लेखक ने नई वाचा के बारे में यह कहा: पर अब उसने इससे भी उत्तम सेवा पाई है, क्योंकि वह उतनी ही उत्तम वाचा का मध्यस्थ ठहरा है, जो और भी उत्तम प्रतिज्ञाओं के आधार पर बाँधी गई है—इब्रानियों 8:6।

अपने विवाह के दिन हम ऐसे शब्दों का उपयोग करते हैं जिनका अर्थ स्पष्ट है, ताकि ऐसी वाचा बाँधी जाए जो “…मृत्यु हमें अलग करे तब तक” बंधनकारी हो। विवाह की प्रतिज्ञाओं में कुछ अंतर हो सकता है, लेकिन उनमें हमेशा एक-दूसरे के प्रति प्रेमपूर्ण संबंध निभाने की ऐसी प्रतिबद्धता होनी चाहिए जो जीवनभर के लिए बंधनकारी और इस प्रकार अपरिवर्तनीय हो।

साक्षी

वाचा का एक और महत्त्वपूर्ण भाग साक्षी हैं। साक्षी ली गई प्रतिज्ञाओं को प्रमाणित करते हैं और उनके प्रति जवाबदेही सुनिश्चित करते हैं। दो व्यक्तियों के बीच की गई वाचा के मामले में यह विशेष रूप से सच है।

जब यहोशू ने कनान देश में प्रवेश करने पर इस्राएल के साथ वाचा को फिर से स्थापित किया, तो उसने उन्हें चुनौती दी: यहोशू ने लोगों से कहा, “तुम आप ही अपने विरुद्ध साक्षी हो कि तुम ने यहोवा को चुन लिया है, कि उसकी सेवा करो।” उन्होंने कहा, “हम साक्षी हैं”—यहोशू 24:22। वे कह रहे थे, “आज हम जो प्रतिबद्धताएँ कर रहे हैं, उनके लिए हम एक-दूसरे को जवाबदेह ठहराएँगे।”

नई वाचा के संबंध में, हमारे पास प्रेरित यूहन्ना की गवाही है, जहाँ वह कहता है: क्योंकि गवाही देनेवाले तीन हैं: स्वर्ग में पिता, वचन और पवित्र आत्मा; और ये तीनों एक हैं। और पृथ्वी पर गवाही देनेवाले तीन हैं: आत्मा, जल और लहू; और ये तीनों एकमत हैं—1 यूहन्ना 5:7-8। यहाँ यूहन्ना कह रहा है कि परमेश्वर और मनुष्य के बीच इस नई वाचा में स्वर्ग में तीन साक्षी और पृथ्वी पर तीन साक्षी हैं, और ये सभी साक्षी एकमत हैं।

विवाह की वाचा स्थापित करते समय विवाह में आए अतिथि साक्षी होते हैं। हर अतिथि ली गई प्रतिज्ञाओं का साक्षी बनता है। अपनी उपस्थिति और आशीष के द्वारा वे विवाह को प्रमाणित करते हैं और यह सुनिश्चित करने की व्यक्तिगत ज़िम्मेदारी लेते हैं कि यह विवाह बना रहे।

विवाह की स्थायित्व के प्रति समुदाय की यह प्रतिबद्धता हमारे समाज और हमारी कलीसियाओं का नैतिक ताना-बाना है। जब कोई समाज विवाह की स्थायित्व को लागू करने में लापरवाह हो जाता है, तो अव्यवस्था और भ्रम पैदा होते हैं। हम अपने आसपास के समाज में इसे देखते हैं। दुर्भाग्य से, हम अपने अनाबैपटिस्ट कलीसियाई समुदायों में भी विवाह टूटने की बढ़ती संख्या देख रहे हैं।

वह जो वाचा को पुष्ट करता है

वाचा स्थापित करने का अंतिम चरण वह है जो वाचा की शर्तों को पुष्ट करके उन्हें बंधनकारी और प्रभावी बनाता है। ऐतिहासिक रूप से, वाचा को बाँधने के कई तरीके रहे हैं। प्राचीन बेदुइनों में वाचा बाँधने के लिए नमक इस्तेमाल करने की प्रथा थी। हर पक्ष दूसरे को कुछ नमक देता था। उस नमक को उनके अपने-अपने नमक के भंडार में मिला दिया जाता था, जिससे “मेरा नमक” और “तुम्हारा नमक” कभी अलग करना असंभव हो जाता था। यह इस संधि की अपरिवर्तनीयता का प्रतीक था।

फिर बेरीथ की प्रथा थी। बेरीथ एक इब्रानी शब्द है जिसका अर्थ है “काटना।” प्राचीन इस्राएल में वाचा की पुष्टि “वाचा काटने” से की जाती थी। इस प्रथा को उत्पत्ति 15 में स्पष्ट रूप से दिखाया गया है, जहाँ परमेश्वर ने अब्राहम के साथ अपनी वाचा की पुष्टि की। अब्राहम ने परमेश्वर से पूछा, …हे प्रभु यहोवा, मैं कैसे जानूँ कि उसका वारिस होऊँगा?—उत्पत्ति 15:8। अब्राहम की विनती के उत्तर में परमेश्वर ने कहा, …तीन वर्ष की एक कलोर, तीन वर्ष की एक बकरी, तीन वर्ष का एक मेढ़ा, एक पिंडुकी और एक कबूतर का बच्चा मेरे पास ले—उत्पत्ति 15:9। अब्राहम ने इन पशुओं को लिया, उन्हें बीच से चीरकर परमेश्वर के लिए बलि के रूप में रख दिया। परमेश्वर ने अब्राहम के साथ अपनी वाचा को फिर से पुष्ट किया (शब्दों के द्वारा), और फिर पद 17 में यह रहस्यमय घटना हुई: और ऐसा हुआ कि जब सूर्य अस्त हो गया और अन्धेरा छा गया, तब देखो, एक धुआँ देनेवाली अँगीठी और एक जलती हुई मशाल उन टुकड़ों के बीच से निकल गई—उत्पत्ति 15:17। यही “बेरीथ” या “वाचा काटना” था। इस समारोह ने वाचा की शर्तों और नियमों को पुष्ट करके उन्हें बंधनकारी बनाया। इस घटना के बाद हमारे पास ऐसा कोई लेखा नहीं है कि अब्राहम ने कभी परमेश्वर की प्रतिज्ञा पर प्रश्न उठाया हो या संदेह किया हो, हालाँकि उसने उस प्रतिज्ञा को पूरा करने की ज़िम्मेदारी अपने हाथ में ले ली थी।

जब परमेश्वर ने सीनै पर्वत पर इस्राएल के साथ वाचा बाँधी, तब …मूसा ने लहू लेकर लोगों पर छिड़का, और कहा, “देखो, यह उस वाचा का लहू है जिसे यहोवा ने इन सब वचनों के विषय में तुम्हारे साथ बाँधी है”—निर्गमन 24:8। इस लहू ने व्यवस्था में बताई गई शर्तों और नियमों को बंधनकारी और प्रभावी बनाया—यह पुरानी वाचा थी।

जब परमेश्वर ने कलवरी पर्वत पर तुम्हारे और मेरे साथ वाचा बाँधी, तब यीशु का लहू हमारे साथ उसकी नई वाचा का पुष्टिकारक प्रमाण या बंधनकारी चिन्ह बन गया। जब हम प्रभु-भोज में भाग लेते हैं, तो हम उस वाचा का स्मरण करते हैं जो मसीह के द्वारा परमेश्वर के साथ हमारी है।

विवाह की वाचा को क्या पुष्ट करता है? जैसा कि हम पहले ही देख चुके हैं, विवाह में शब्द (प्रतिज्ञाएँ) और साक्षी (अतिथि) होते हैं। क्या इससे विवाह पूरा हो जाता है? नहीं। विवाह तब तक पूरा नहीं होता जब तक शारीरिक अंतरंगता में दोनों एक न हों। इससे विवाह पूरा होता है या, जैसा हम कभी-कभी कहते हैं, विवाह की वाचा संपन्न होती है। यही वह है जो विवाह की वाचा की शर्तों और नियमों को पुष्ट करके उन्हें बंधनकारी और स्थायी बनाता है। पवित्रशास्त्र के आरंभिक भाग में इसका एक उदाहरण मिलता है: और आदम अपनी पत्नी हव्वा के पास गया… उत्पत्ति 4:1। बाद में एक और उदाहरण देखते हैं: तब इसहाक रिबका को अपनी माता सारा के तम्बू में ले गया, और रिबका को ब्याह लिया; और वह उसकी पत्नी हुई; और उसने उससे प्रेम किया…—उत्पत्ति 24:67। शारीरिक एकता वाचा का हिस्सा है। यही कारण है कि विवाह के बाहर ऐसा संबंध पाप है। व्यभिचार या परस्त्रीगमन उस बात को, जिसे परमेश्वर ने विवाह के साथ अविभाज्य रूप से जुड़ा ठहराया है, दूषित करके वाचा को बिगाड़ देता है।

जब विवाहित जोड़ा शारीरिक एकता में आता है, तो वे अपनी विवाह-वाचा का स्मरण और उत्सव मनाते हैं। यह उनके द्वारा बाइबिल के “एक तन” की वास्तविकता स्थापित करने की शुरुआत है। इस धन्य मिलन से अनमोल “नन्हे-मुन्ने” बच्चों के रूप में नया जीवन जन्म लेता है और प्रेम की शक्ति से हृदय नए हो जाते हैं।

जब हम प्रभु-भोज की रोटी और दाखमधु में भाग लेते हैं, तो हम मसीह के साथ अपनी वाचा के संबंध का स्मरण और उत्सव मनाते हैं। इस धन्य एकता से प्रेम की शक्ति से नए हुए हृदयों के रूप में नया जीवन जन्म लेता है। यही वाचा की सामर्थ्य है।

जहाँ ये तीन तत्व—प्रतिज्ञाएँ, साक्षी और वाचा को पुष्ट करनेवाली बात—मौजूद हों, वहाँ वाचा का संबंध होता है। वाचा का संबंध किसी अन्य संबंध से किस प्रकार भिन्न है?

निष्ठा निभाने की प्रतिबद्धता

मानव होंठों से बोले जा सकने वाले कुछ सबसे उदात्त शब्द हैं, “मैं मृत्यु हमें अलग करे तब तक तुमसे प्रेम करने की प्रतिज्ञा करता हूँ।” हमारे विवाह के दिन इन शब्दों को कहना आसान होता है, और जब हम उन्हें कहते हैं तो हम पूरी तरह सच्चे भी हो सकते हैं। सच तो यह है कि कोई भी यह नहीं जान सकता कि जीवनभर में इन शब्दों की कीमत क्या हो सकती है।

प्रेम एक चुनाव है और इसे जीवन की रोज़मर्रा की चाल के रूप में स्थापित होकर कायम रहना चाहिए। हमें अपने वाचा-प्रेम के साथी की ओर अपना स्नेह लगाने और दूसरों के आकर्षणों से दूर रहने का चुनाव करना चाहिए। बहुत-से विवाह बेवफाई के कारण नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

परमेश्वर ने विवाह को एक शक्तिशाली बंधन बनाने के लिए रचा है। विवाह का आध्यात्मिक, भावनात्मक और शारीरिक जुड़ाव एक अटूट बंधन बनाता है। उत्पत्ति में हम पढ़ते हैं, इस कारण पुरुष अपने माता-पिता को छोड़कर अपनी पत्नी से मिला रहेगा, और वे एक तन बने रहेंगे—उत्पत्ति 2:24। इस पद में मिला रहेगा शब्द का अर्थ है “इस तरह वेल्ड होकर या चिपककर एक होना कि अलग न किया जा सके।”

बेवफाई के द्वारा विवाह के बंधन को तोड़ने से दोनों पक्षों को गहरी चोट और पीड़ा पहुँचती है। बड़ा धोखेबाज़ शैतान चाहता है कि हम यह मानें कि अपने जीवनसाथी के प्रति बेवफा होने से हमें किसी तरह लाभ होगा। यह बहुत बड़ा झूठ है।

विश्वसनीय बने रहने की प्रतिबद्धता

परमेश्वर ने अपनी पुरानी वाचा की दुल्हन—इस्राएल राष्ट्र—के साथ अपने व्यवहार में वाचा के प्रति अपनी विश्वासयोग्यता दिखाई। वह अपनी वाचा की प्रतिज्ञाओं पर खरी नहीं उतरी। उसने यहोवा की उपासना से मुँह मोड़ा और मूर्तिपूजक वेदियों के आगे घुटने टेक दिए। उसकी अविश्वासयोग्यता के बावजूद, परमेश्वर उसका पीछा करता रहा और उसे अपने पास लौट आने के लिए बुलाता रहा। इस्राएल की अविश्वासयोग्यता ने परमेश्वर की विश्वासयोग्यता को नहीं बदला। यही वाचा के प्रेम की सामर्थ्य है। वाचा का प्रेम दूसरे पक्ष के कार्यों पर निर्भर नहीं होता। वाचा का प्रेम तब भी बना रहता है जब उसका प्रत्युत्तर नहीं मिलता। यह राज्य का सिद्धांत है। पौलुस ने सिखाया, इसलिये यदि तेरा बैरी भूखा हो तो उसे खाना खिला; यदि प्यासा हो तो उसे पानी पिला; क्योंकि ऐसा करने से तू उसके सिर पर आग के अंगारे जमा करेगा—रोमियों 12:20। क्या यह सिद्धांत टूटे हुए विवाह पर सबसे अधिक उचित रूप से लागू नहीं होगा?

वाचा की सामर्थ्य को पूरी तरह तभी समझा जा सकता है जब हम परमेश्वर के हमारे प्रति दिव्य प्रेम को समझें। हमारा उद्धार हमारे लिए परमेश्वर के सिद्ध प्रेम पर निर्भर है। वह हमसे तब भी प्रेम करता रहता है, जब उसके प्रति हमारा प्रेम कभी-कभी त्रुटिपूर्ण होता है। उसका अटल प्रेम हमें अपने पास लौटने के लिए खींचता रहता है। विवाह में वाचा की सामर्थ्य इस दिव्य प्रेम का अनुकरण करने के प्रयास में मिलती है। यह दिव्य प्रेम प्रेम-कथाओं के उपन्यासों या विवाह पर लिखी दूसरी किताबों में नहीं मिलेगा। यह दिव्य प्रेम केवल अविनाशी प्रेम के “स्रोत” के साथ घनिष्ठ संबंध में पाया जा सकता है।

Today, I’d like to continue and possibly complete our discussion of Regenerative Medicine. I want to consider where it stands today, and how Christians can navigate the complex maze of treatments. As you may recall, in the previous issue of this magazine we discussed that Regenerative Medicine is man’s attempt to re-create organ systems. We described how fetal tissue was attempted to be used, due to its low rate of rejection by the people receiving it. Medically speaking, it was problematic in that, if used on a large scale, it would require large amounts of aborted fetuses. Later, embryonic stem cells were studied in depth. Here, embryos, which are newly conceived humans in their earliest stages, are dissected (cut apart) and stem cells are taken.

Think of stem cells as indolent, immature adults, who live in their parents’ basements, without direction, not knowing what they want to do with their lives. With a little encouragement and direction, they can finally find their way, finding a specialized skill and important role in life. In like manner, scientists have discovered ways to “program” these stem cells, “encouraging” them to become specialized into types of cells, such as nerve, heart, blood, and insulin producing. These cells would then be grown in a lab, then used to repair or replace the diseased or injured tissue.

However, “taking” stem cells from embryos results in his or her (the embryo’s) destruction. This is obviously problematic for Christians, knowing that one of the seven things that the Lord says is an abomination is …hands that shed innocent blood –Pro 6:17. Additionally, the sixth commandment directs, Thou shalt not kill –Exo 20:13. Because these objections were recognized by the scientific community, there was pressure to find an alternative.

The Apostle Paul states, There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it –1Co 10:13. His words are as true today as they were 2000 years ago. While Christians suffer from disease just as commonly as non-Christians do, modern medicine can present the “temptation” of a treatment and relief from disease or injury that is actually immoral. But God is faithful, and his escape is twofold. First and foremost, He gave His son to bear our burdens. It is to this Great Physician that we should always turn to first.

In the case of stem cell treatments, it so happens that it was discovered that these immature stem cells are not only found in human embryos, but they are also found in all people, from infants to grown-ups as well. This may be the physical “escape” for His faithful children. These immature stem cells (usually obtained from a patient’s fat tissue or bone marrow) can be grown, cultured, and used just as well as embryonic stem cells. It turns out that “Adult Stem Cells” have actually been more clinically effective, since they are “custom designed” for each individual, and since they come from that person’s own body; therefore, there is very little problem with rejection.

Umbilical cord stem cells have also been shown to be useful, particularly in bone and cartilage treatments. Just as there have been obstacles to overcome when using embryonic stem cells, so too there are problems with developing treatments using adult or umbilical cord stem cells. Think again of a stem cell as an immature, indolent adult. Just having him “hang out” with a master carpenter will not make him a master carpenter if all he does is find entertainment on his cell phone. Stem cells, like an apprentice, need intense, focused training and direction to become specialists in their chosen field of expertise. Learning how to turn these “switches” on is perhaps one of the greatest challenges. The main idea here is that just injecting stem cells that have not been “programmed” or “trained” into damaged or diseased tissue will not automatically make them “know” what to become or how to function.

Similarly, just putting a young electronics apprentice on a bus that is traveling into a city that just had a power grid failure will not result in restoring the power. Here the parallel is placing stem cells into the brain of a stroke victim or a paraplegic accident victim, hoping that the stem cells will “know” what to do, and which specific connections to repair in order to restore function. This may not work as hoped. It would be fruitless to expect success unless and until these problems are also addressed.

Then there is the lingering problem of these eager youngsters (stem cells) knowing when to stop. The problem with fetal tissue turning into cancerous tumors is also a problem to be dealt with in stem cells. Considering this, there is one exception: umbilical cord stem cells are generally not known to turn malignant.1

Here is a short list of treatments that are in development that would use stem cells:

  • Macular Degeneration—Repair a damaged retina.
  • Spinal Cord Injury/Stroke—Repair nerve tissue.
  • Burns—Repair skin tissue.
  • Congestive Heart Failure—Repair damaged heart tissue.
  • Diabetes—Replace or increase the pancreatic tissue that makes insulin.
  • Arthritis—Repair damaged cartilage.
  • Autoimmune diseases (Lupus, Multiple Sclerosis) —Destroy the immune system that is attacking its own body and replace or “reset” it with a new immune system derived from one’s own stem cells.
  • Leukemias—Destroy the cancerous blood cells and replace them with new stem cell derived blood cells.
  • New organs—Replace diseased, damaged, or cancer-ridden organs, such as the kidney, liver, or pancreas, with organs derived from the patient’s own stem cells, grown in a lab, and transplanted surgically, without the need of anti-rejection drugs.

As you can see, there is a very long list of diseases and ailments that may result in effective treatments with stem cells. I am very optimistic that within a decade, remedies for many of these ailments will be commonly available. However, learning how to make stem cells that are expertly specialized into specific tissue types, learning how to turn stems cells on and then turning them off at the necessary time (once the job is finished), and learning how to “teach” the stem cells where and how to make repairs will take time.

I am not the only one who is excited about the possibilities. That is why hundreds of stem cell clinics have sprung up across the country, trying to get in on the excitement. But do the claims of any of these clinics align with reality? Which ones are legitimate? I know that there are many clinics offering stem cell treatments for various ailments, so let’s now look at some of the treatments that are available today—ones that have evidence of actually helping, as well as realistic expectations. Let’s also look at some of the possible complications, to help us make informed decisions.

First, the risks and complications

  • Introduction of infection—For example, bacteria living on the skin can enter a joint space from a simple injection, resulting in destruction of the joint, even under the cleanest of conditions.
  • Stems cells moving from their introduction site and not going where they are intended or not staying contained to the specific area of treatment—One study involving pigs treated with stem cells injected into areas of a damaged heart after a heart attack showed near complete return of function, but then the new heart tissue kept growing, eventually filling the heart’s pumping chamber, which caused all the pigs to die.
  • Stem cells changing into unexpected or inappropriate cell types—Stem cells used for a facial cosmetic effect have actually turned to bone.2
  • Growth of tumors—There are documented cases of different tumors, including brain and kidney tumors that have developed after patients were treated for stroke and kidney failure using stem cells.
  • Failure to work as expected—There are documented cases of people with macular degeneration, who were treated with stem cells injected into the eye, that have resulted in blindness.
  • Stem cells can’t be withdrawn—Unlike medicines such as a pill or an injection, if something goes wrong, one can’t just withhold the next dose. Once stem cells are introduced, they can’t be taken back. The course that has been set will continue.

The rates of complications are hard to know, since there are no reporting requirements when performed outside of formal clinical investigations.

Next, the known benefits

The FDA (the governmental Food and Drug Administration that is tasked with health safety) has approved stem cell treatments for dozens of blood cancers (leukemias) and blood diseases using umbilical cord stem cells. Though not FDA approved, studies have shown some benefit for using stem cells for orthopedic applications, particularly arthritis of the knees. (Using stem cells for such orthopedic uses, without the need to stimulate them to become cartilage cells beforehand, appears to be the exception to the rule. Remember most stem cells need to be specialized before being used.) That’s it! Aside from this, most other uses for stem cells should only be considered either highly experimental or highly suspect of exaggerated benefits. Could there be other beneficial treatments that are not FDA approved? Perhaps, but it’s important to realize that the claims have often far outpaced the science.

So how is one to know? Here are some things to consider when choosing providers of stem cell treatments, as well as red flags, to tell you if there are better places to go for your health care. (These points are also true for just about any other treatment):

  1. Informed consent—Every medical treatment has risks and benefits. These should be routinely discussed with you beforehand, without you needing to ask. Any practitioner who claims there are no risks, only benefits, either is not sufficiently knowledgeable or is not sufficiently honest!
  2. Can they handle the complications? —Joint injections can sometimes result in infection. These can be severe infections that can potentially destroy the joint. Such complications are not just simply treated with antibiotics, but with surgery. These stem cell treatments are better handled by an orthopedic surgeon or practitioner that has a close relationship with one, if complications should arise. Likewise, treatments involving nerves should be done by neurologists or neurosurgeons.
  3. Is the clinic adequately equipped? —Stem cells need to be handled appropriately. The transport of umbilical stem cells and improper thawing from the supplier can drastically reduce numbers, which may have a great deal to do with determining the success of the procedure. Additionally, these cells may be in a state of “shock,” unless they are appropriately re-cultured after being thawed. This allows them to re-enter a desirable growth phase again.3 This may mean having a specialized lab and microbiologist on staff to properly grow and care for the stem cells, ensuring good quality control. This usually requires a university setting, not just a small clinic or office that has a nurse to thaw the stem cells after receiving them from an overnight delivery service. Glitzy web sites, colorful brochures, and informational dinners are not enough.
  4. Guinea pigs and rats are “experimented on,” people go through “clinical trials.” —Please avoid any practitioner who says they are doing experiments. Clinical trials involving people, which have the oversight of ethics boards, only occur after experiments on animals have shown low risk of harm, and a good chance of success. If a treatment is very effective, the FDA has suggested that as few as 42 participants can demonstrate adequate safety to grant approval. This is not an outrageously high threshold to overcome. Additionally, patients involved in clinical trials are usually only expected to cover minimal costs, if any. Practitioners who “experiment” on people rarely do it for free.4
  5. Realistic claims. —Does your practitioner claim 100 percent success? If so, it is better to run away (if your knees will allow you to) than to simply walk away! Knee treatments, for example, may only delay knee replacements for many people. Some may avoid surgery, but certainly not all. Do not expect a cure. Also, do they make claims well outside of what is commonly recognized? “Cures” claimed for Alzheimers, Parkinson’s, or other ailments that are not FDA approved? I cannot totally exclude the possibility that such treatments may exist at some future time. However, these practitioners should be able to point to (and provide to you) published studies. If there is a miraculous cure, the world should be able to benefit from it, and he or she should be able to patent it, so as to reap the financial benefits of sharing their techniques and discoveries with the rest of the world. By doing so, it is independently tested and verified. Anyone who has a “secret” cure, that they alone possess, should be avoided.
  1. Does it make sense? —By simply injecting stem cells (that have not been induced by a lab into their specialty state such as nerve cells, heart cells, etc.) into the bloodstream to treat things like nerve disorders, for example, does not make sense. Clinical trials of legitimate treatments first specialize the stem cells, then directly apply them to the affected area. For example, specific types of nerve cells are injected directly into specific locations of the brain, and heart cells are injected directly into the scarred tissue of the heart. Remember the indolent adult (the unspecialized stem cell)? You can’t expect to put them on a bus (inject them into a vein), send them into the big city (the body), without instructions on what to do (leaving them unspecialized), not knowing where to go (to somehow find the diseased part of the body) and then magically expect success.
  2. The hard sell. —Are you being told that or are you made to feel that you are “missing out” if you decline? Do the clinic advertisements have testimonial bylines, something to the effect of “Individual results may vary, and testimonials are not claimed to represent typical results and are not intended to represent or guarantee that anyone will achieve the same or similar results…”? As the old adage goes, if it’s too good to be true (especially if they actually tell you so), then it probably is. In these cases, consider the claims to be most likely somewhat exaggerated, and also consider working with someone who can give a more honest set of expectations.

I pray that God may grant you wisdom: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him –Jas 1:5.

Hoje, gostaria de continuar e talvez concluir nossa discussão sobre Medicina Regenerativa. Quero considerar em que ponto ela se encontra atualmente e como os cristãos podem navegar pelo complexo labirinto de tratamentos. Como talvez se lembrem, na edição anterior desta revista discutimos que a Medicina Regenerativa é uma tentativa humana de recriar sistemas de órgãos. Descrevemos como se tentou usar tecido fetal, devido à baixa taxa de rejeição por parte das pessoas que o recebiam. Do ponto de vista médico, isso era problemático porque, se fosse usado em grande escala, exigiria grandes quantidades de fetos abortados. Mais tarde, as células-tronco embrionárias foram estudadas em profundidade. Nesse caso, embriões, que são seres humanos recém-concebidos em seus estágios mais iniciais, são dissecados (cortados em partes), e deles são retiradas células-tronco.

Pense nas células-tronco como adultos imaturos e indolentes, que vivem no porão dos pais, sem rumo e sem saber o que querem fazer da vida. Com um pouco de incentivo e orientação, podem finalmente encontrar seu caminho, descobrir uma habilidade especializada e um papel importante na vida. De modo semelhante, os cientistas descobriram maneiras de “programar” essas células-tronco, “incentivando-as” a se especializarem em tipos de células, como células nervosas, cardíacas, sanguíneas e produtoras de insulina. Essas células seriam então cultivadas em laboratório e usadas para reparar ou substituir o tecido doente ou lesionado.

No entanto, “retirar” células-tronco de embriões resulta na destruição dele ou dela (o embrião). Isso é obviamente problemático para os cristãos, sabendo que uma das sete coisas que o Senhor declara abomináveis são as …mãos que derramam sangue inocente – Pv 6:17. Além disso, o sexto mandamento ordena: Não matarás – Êx 20:13. Como a comunidade científica reconheceu essas objeções, houve pressão para encontrar uma alternativa.

O apóstolo Paulo declara: Não vos sobreveio tentação que não fosse humana; mas Deus é fiel e não permitirá que sejais tentados além do que podeis suportar; pelo contrário, juntamente com a tentação, proverá livramento, para que a possais suportar – 1Co 10:13. Suas palavras são tão verdadeiras hoje quanto eram há 2000 anos. Embora os cristãos sofram de doenças tão frequentemente quanto os não cristãos, a medicina moderna pode apresentar a “tentação” de um tratamento e de alívio de uma doença ou lesão que, na realidade, é imoral. Mas Deus é fiel, e seu livramento tem duas dimensões. Em primeiro lugar e acima de tudo, Ele deu Seu Filho para levar nossos fardos. É a esse Grande Médico que devemos sempre recorrer primeiro.

No caso dos tratamentos com células-tronco, descobriu-se que essas células-tronco imaturas não são encontradas apenas em embriões humanos, mas também em todas as pessoas, desde bebês até adultos. Essa pode ser a saída física para Seus filhos fiéis. Essas células-tronco imaturas (geralmente obtidas do tecido adiposo ou da medula óssea do paciente) podem ser cultivadas e usadas tão bem quanto as células-tronco embrionárias. Na verdade, as “células-tronco adultas” têm sido clinicamente mais eficazes, pois são “feitas sob medida” para cada indivíduo e provêm do próprio corpo da pessoa; portanto, há muito menos problema de rejeição.

Também se demonstrou que as células-tronco do cordão umbilical são úteis, particularmente em tratamentos de ossos e cartilagens. Assim como houve obstáculos a superar no uso de células-tronco embrionárias, também há problemas no desenvolvimento de tratamentos com células-tronco adultas ou do cordão umbilical. Pense novamente numa célula-tronco como um adulto imaturo e indolente. Simplesmente deixá-lo “passar o tempo” com um mestre carpinteiro não fará dele um mestre carpinteiro se tudo o que ele faz é procurar diversão no celular. As células-tronco, como um aprendiz, precisam de treinamento e orientação intensos e concentrados para se tornarem especialistas no campo de conhecimento que escolheram. Aprender a ligar esses “interruptores” é talvez um dos maiores desafios. A ideia principal aqui é que simplesmente injetar células-tronco que não foram “programadas” ou “treinadas” em tecido danificado ou doente não fará automaticamente com que elas “saibam” no que se tornar ou como funcionar.

Da mesma forma, simplesmente colocar um jovem aprendiz de eletrônica num ônibus que está indo para uma cidade que acabou de sofrer uma falha na rede elétrica não resultará na restauração da energia. A comparação aqui é colocar células-tronco no cérebro de alguém que sofreu um AVC ou de uma vítima de acidente paraplégica, na esperança de que as células-tronco “saibam” o que fazer e quais conexões específicas reparar para restaurar a função. Isso talvez não funcione como se espera. Seria inútil esperar sucesso a menos que, e até que, esses problemas também sejam abordados.

Há ainda o problema persistente de essas jovens entusiasmadas (as células-tronco) saberem quando parar. O problema de tecido fetal se transformar em tumores cancerosos também precisa ser enfrentado no caso das células-tronco. Considerando isso, há uma exceção: em geral, não se sabe que células-tronco do cordão umbilical se tornem malignas.1

Segue uma breve lista de tratamentos em desenvolvimento que usariam células-tronco:

  • Degeneração macular—Reparar uma retina danificada.
  • Lesão da medula espinhal/AVC—Reparar tecido nervoso.
  • Queimaduras—Reparar tecido cutâneo.
  • Insuficiência cardíaca congestiva—Reparar tecido cardíaco danificado.
  • Diabetes—Substituir ou aumentar o tecido pancreático que produz insulina.
  • Artrite—Reparar cartilagem danificada.
  • Doenças autoimunes (lúpus, esclerose múltipla)—Destruir o sistema imunológico que está atacando o próprio corpo e substituí-lo ou “reiniciá-lo” com um novo sistema imunológico derivado das células-tronco da própria pessoa.
  • Leucemias—Destruir as células sanguíneas cancerosas e substituí-las por novas células sanguíneas derivadas de células-tronco.
  • Novos órgãos—Substituir órgãos doentes, danificados ou tomados pelo câncer, como rins, fígado ou pâncreas, por órgãos derivados das células-tronco do próprio paciente, cultivados em laboratório e transplantados cirurgicamente, sem necessidade de medicamentos antirrejeição.

Como podem ver, há uma lista muito longa de doenças e enfermidades para as quais as células-tronco podem resultar em tratamentos eficazes. Estou muito otimista de que, dentro de uma década, tratamentos para muitas dessas enfermidades estarão comumente disponíveis. No entanto, aprender a produzir células-tronco especializadas com precisão em tipos específicos de tecido, aprender a ativá-las e depois desativá-las no momento necessário (quando o trabalho estiver concluído), e aprender a “ensinar” às células-tronco onde e como fazer reparos levará tempo.

Não sou o único entusiasmado com as possibilidades. É por isso que centenas de clínicas de células-tronco surgiram por todo o país, tentando aproveitar esse entusiasmo. Mas as alegações dessas clínicas correspondem à realidade? Quais são legítimas? Sei que há muitas clínicas oferecendo tratamentos com células-tronco para diversas enfermidades; então, vejamos agora alguns dos tratamentos disponíveis atualmente—aqueles que têm evidências de realmente ajudar, além de expectativas realistas. Vejamos também algumas possíveis complicações, para nos ajudar a tomar decisões informadas.

Primeiro, os riscos e as complicações

  • Introdução de infecção—Por exemplo, bactérias presentes na pele podem entrar numa articulação por meio de uma simples injeção, causando a destruição da articulação, mesmo nas condições mais limpas.
  • Migração das células-tronco para fora do local de introdução, sem chegarem ao destino pretendido ou sem permanecerem contidas na área específica do tratamento—Um estudo que envolveu porcos tratados com células-tronco injetadas em áreas do coração danificado após um ataque cardíaco mostrou um retorno quase completo da função; porém, o novo tecido cardíaco continuou a crescer, acabando por preencher a câmara de bombeamento do coração, o que levou à morte de todos os porcos.
  • Transformação das células-tronco em tipos celulares inesperados ou inadequados—Células-tronco usadas para fins cosméticos faciais chegaram a se transformar em osso.2
  • Crescimento de tumores—Há casos documentados de diferentes tumores, incluindo tumores cerebrais e renais, que se desenvolveram após pacientes terem sido tratados com células-tronco por AVC e insuficiência renal.
  • Falha em funcionar como esperado—Há casos documentados de pessoas com degeneração macular que, após serem tratadas com células-tronco injetadas no olho, ficaram cegas.
  • As células-tronco não podem ser retiradas—Ao contrário de medicamentos como um comprimido ou uma injeção, se algo der errado, não se pode simplesmente suspender a dose seguinte. Depois de introduzidas, as células-tronco não podem ser retiradas. O curso iniciado continuará.

É difícil saber as taxas de complicações, pois não há exigência de notificação quando os procedimentos são realizados fora de investigações clínicas formais.

Em seguida, os benefícios conhecidos

A FDA (a agência governamental de Administração de Alimentos e Medicamentos, encarregada da segurança da saúde) aprovou tratamentos com células-tronco para dezenas de cânceres do sangue (leucemias) e doenças sanguíneas, usando células-tronco do cordão umbilical. Embora não aprovados pela FDA, estudos demonstraram algum benefício do uso de células-tronco em aplicações ortopédicas, particularmente na artrite dos joelhos. (O uso de células-tronco para essas aplicações ortopédicas sem a necessidade de estimulá-las previamente para que se tornem células de cartilagem parece ser a exceção à regra. Lembrem-se: a maioria das células-tronco precisa ser especializada antes de ser usada.) É isso! Fora isso, a maioria dos outros usos de células-tronco só deve ser considerada altamente experimental ou altamente suspeita de benefícios exagerados. Poderá haver outros tratamentos benéficos que não sejam aprovados pela FDA? Talvez, mas é importante perceber que as alegações muitas vezes foram muito além do que a ciência sustenta.

Então, como saber? Eis algumas coisas a considerar ao escolher prestadores de tratamentos com células-tronco, bem como sinais de alerta que indicam se há lugares melhores para procurar assistência médica. (Esses pontos também se aplicam a quase qualquer outro tratamento):

  1. Consentimento informado—Todo tratamento médico tem riscos e benefícios. Estes devem ser discutidos com você rotineiramente, de antemão, sem que você precise perguntar. Qualquer profissional que afirme não haver riscos, apenas benefícios, ou não tem conhecimento suficiente ou não é suficientemente honesto!
  2. Conseguem lidar com as complicações?—Injeções nas articulações podem, por vezes, resultar em infecção. Essas infecções podem ser graves e potencialmente destruir a articulação. Tais complicações não são tratadas simplesmente com antibióticos, mas com cirurgia. É melhor que esses tratamentos com células-tronco sejam realizados por um cirurgião ortopédico ou por um profissional que tenha uma relação próxima com um, caso surjam complicações. Da mesma forma, tratamentos que envolvam nervos devem ser realizados por neurologistas ou neurocirurgiões.
  3. A clínica está adequadamente equipada?—As células-tronco precisam ser manuseadas de forma apropriada. O transporte de células-tronco umbilicais e o descongelamento inadequado pelo fornecedor podem reduzir drasticamente sua quantidade, o que pode ter grande influência na determinação do sucesso do procedimento. Além disso, essas células podem estar em estado de “choque”, a menos que sejam devidamente recultivadas após o descongelamento. Isso permite que voltem a entrar numa fase de crescimento desejável.3 Isso pode exigir um laboratório especializado e um microbiologista na equipe para cultivar e cuidar adequadamente das células-tronco, garantindo um bom controle de qualidade. Em geral, isso exige um ambiente universitário, e não apenas uma pequena clínica ou consultório com um enfermeiro para descongelar as células-tronco depois de recebê-las por um serviço de entrega noturna. Sites sofisticados, folhetos coloridos e jantares informativos não bastam.
  4. Cobaias e ratos são “submetidos a experimentos”; pessoas participam de “ensaios clínicos”.—Evite qualquer profissional que diga estar realizando experimentos. Ensaios clínicos com pessoas, supervisionados por comissões de ética, só ocorrem depois que experimentos com animais demonstraram baixo risco de dano e boas chances de sucesso. Se um tratamento for muito eficaz, a FDA sugeriu que apenas 42 participantes podem bastar para demonstrar segurança adequada para conceder aprovação. Não é um obstáculo exorbitante a superar. Além disso, geralmente se espera que os pacientes que participam de ensaios clínicos cubram apenas custos mínimos, se houver algum. Profissionais que “experimentam” em pessoas raramente o fazem de graça.4
  5. Alegações realistas.—O profissional que atende você afirma ter 100 por cento de sucesso? Nesse caso, é melhor sair correndo (se os seus joelhos permitirem) do que simplesmente ir embora a pé! Os tratamentos para os joelhos, por exemplo, talvez apenas adiem a necessidade de próteses para muitas pessoas. Algumas podem evitar a cirurgia, mas certamente não todas. Não espere uma cura. Além disso, fazem alegações que vão muito além do que é geralmente reconhecido? “Curas” para Alzheimer, Parkinson ou outras enfermidades que não são aprovadas pela FDA? Não posso excluir totalmente a possibilidade de que tais tratamentos venham a existir em algum momento futuro. No entanto, esses profissionais devem poder indicar (e fornecer a você) estudos publicados. Se houver uma cura milagrosa, o mundo deve poder se beneficiar dela, e quem a desenvolveu deve poder patenteá-la, para colher os benefícios financeiros de compartilhar suas técnicas e descobertas com o resto do mundo. Dessa forma, ela é testada e verificada de maneira independente. Deve-se evitar qualquer pessoa que tenha uma cura “secreta” que só ela possua.
  1. Faz sentido?—Simplesmente injetar células-tronco (que não foram induzidas em laboratório a atingir seu estado especializado, como células nervosas, células cardíacas etc.) na corrente sanguínea para tratar, por exemplo, distúrbios nervosos não faz sentido. Ensaios clínicos de tratamentos legítimos primeiro especializam as células-tronco e depois as aplicam diretamente na área afetada. Por exemplo, tipos específicos de células nervosas são injetados diretamente em locais específicos do cérebro, e células cardíacas são injetadas diretamente no tecido cicatricial do coração. Lembrem-se do adulto indolente (a célula-tronco não especializada). Não se pode esperar colocá-lo num ônibus (injetá-lo numa veia), enviá-lo à grande cidade (o corpo), sem instruções sobre o que fazer (deixando-o sem especialização), sem saber para onde ir (para encontrar de algum modo a parte doente do corpo) e depois esperar magicamente que dê certo.
  2. A pressão para vender.—Estão lhe dizendo, ou fazendo você sentir, que vai “perder uma oportunidade” se recusar? Os anúncios da clínica incluem avisos junto a depoimentos, algo como “Os resultados individuais podem variar, e os depoimentos não pretendem representar resultados típicos nem afirmar ou garantir que alguém obterá resultados iguais ou semelhantes…”? Como diz o velho ditado, se parece bom demais para ser verdade (especialmente se lhe dizem isso explicitamente), provavelmente é mesmo. Nesses casos, considere que as alegações provavelmente são um tanto exageradas e também considere procurar alguém que possa oferecer expectativas mais honestas.

Oro para que Deus lhe conceda sabedoria: Se algum de vós tem falta de sabedoria, peça-a a Deus, que a todos dá liberalmente e não censura; e ela lhe será concedida – Tg 1:5.
