Today, I’d like to continue and possibly complete our discussion of Regenerative Medicine. I want to consider where it stands today, and how Christians can navigate the complex maze of treatments. As you may recall, in the previous issue of this magazine we discussed that Regenerative Medicine is man’s attempt to re-create organ systems. We described how fetal tissue was attempted to be used, due to its low rate of rejection by the people receiving it. Medically speaking, it was problematic in that, if used on a large scale, it would require large amounts of aborted fetuses. Later, embryonic stem cells were studied in depth. Here, embryos, which are newly conceived humans in their earliest stages, are dissected (cut apart) and stem cells are taken.

Think of stem cells as indolent, immature adults, who live in their parents’ basements, without direction, not knowing what they want to do with their lives. With a little encouragement and direction, they can finally find their way, finding a specialized skill and important role in life. In like manner, scientists have discovered ways to “program” these stem cells, “encouraging” them to become specialized into types of cells, such as nerve, heart, blood, and insulin producing. These cells would then be grown in a lab, then used to repair or replace the diseased or injured tissue.

However, “taking” stem cells from embryos results in his or her (the embryo’s) destruction. This is obviously problematic for Christians, knowing that one of the seven things that the Lord says is an abomination is …hands that shed innocent blood –Pro 6:17. Additionally, the sixth commandment directs, Thou shalt not kill –Exo 20:13. Because these objections were recognized by the scientific community, there was pressure to find an alternative.

The Apostle Paul states, There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it –1Co 10:13. His words are as true today as they were 2000 years ago. While Christians suffer from disease just as commonly as non-Christians do, modern medicine can present the “temptation” of a treatment and relief from disease or injury that is actually immoral. But God is faithful, and his escape is twofold. First and foremost, He gave His son to bear our burdens. It is to this Great Physician that we should always turn to first.

In the case of stem cell treatments, it so happens that it was discovered that these immature stem cells are not only found in human embryos, but they are also found in all people, from infants to grown-ups as well. This may be the physical “escape” for His faithful children. These immature stem cells (usually obtained from a patient’s fat tissue or bone marrow) can be grown, cultured, and used just as well as embryonic stem cells. It turns out that “Adult Stem Cells” have actually been more clinically effective, since they are “custom designed” for each individual, and since they come from that person’s own body; therefore, there is very little problem with rejection.

Umbilical cord stem cells have also been shown to be useful, particularly in bone and cartilage treatments. Just as there have been obstacles to overcome when using embryonic stem cells, so too there are problems with developing treatments using adult or umbilical cord stem cells. Think again of a stem cell as an immature, indolent adult. Just having him “hang out” with a master carpenter will not make him a master carpenter if all he does is find entertainment on his cell phone. Stem cells, like an apprentice, need intense, focused training and direction to become specialists in their chosen field of expertise. Learning how to turn these “switches” on is perhaps one of the greatest challenges. The main idea here is that just injecting stem cells that have not been “programmed” or “trained” into damaged or diseased tissue will not automatically make them “know” what to become or how to function.

Similarly, just putting a young electronics apprentice on a bus that is traveling into a city that just had a power grid failure will not result in restoring the power. Here the parallel is placing stem cells into the brain of a stroke victim or a paraplegic accident victim, hoping that the stem cells will “know” what to do, and which specific connections to repair in order to restore function. This may not work as hoped. It would be fruitless to expect success unless and until these problems are also addressed.

Then there is the lingering problem of these eager youngsters (stem cells) knowing when to stop. The problem with fetal tissue turning into cancerous tumors is also a problem to be dealt with in stem cells. Considering this, there is one exception: umbilical cord stem cells are generally not known to turn malignant.1

Here is a short list of treatments that are in development that would use stem cells:

  • Macular Degeneration—Repair a damaged retina.
  • Spinal Cord Injury/Stroke—Repair nerve tissue.
  • Burns—Repair skin tissue.
  • Congestive Heart Failure—Repair damaged heart tissue.
  • Diabetes—Replace or increase the pancreatic tissue that makes insulin.
  • Arthritis—Repair damaged cartilage.
  • Autoimmune diseases (Lupus, Multiple Sclerosis) —Destroy the immune system that is attacking its own body and replace or “reset” it with a new immune system derived from one’s own stem cells.
  • Leukemias—Destroy the cancerous blood cells and replace them with new stem cell derived blood cells.
  • New organs—Replace diseased, damaged, or cancer-ridden organs, such as the kidney, liver, or pancreas, with organs derived from the patient’s own stem cells, grown in a lab, and transplanted surgically, without the need of anti-rejection drugs.

As you can see, there is a very long list of diseases and ailments that may result in effective treatments with stem cells. I am very optimistic that within a decade, remedies for many of these ailments will be commonly available. However, learning how to make stem cells that are expertly specialized into specific tissue types, learning how to turn stems cells on and then turning them off at the necessary time (once the job is finished), and learning how to “teach” the stem cells where and how to make repairs will take time.

I am not the only one who is excited about the possibilities. That is why hundreds of stem cell clinics have sprung up across the country, trying to get in on the excitement. But do the claims of any of these clinics align with reality? Which ones are legitimate? I know that there are many clinics offering stem cell treatments for various ailments, so let’s now look at some of the treatments that are available today—ones that have evidence of actually helping, as well as realistic expectations. Let’s also look at some of the possible complications, to help us make informed decisions.

First, the risks and complications

  • Introduction of infection—For example, bacteria living on the skin can enter a joint space from a simple injection, resulting in destruction of the joint, even under the cleanest of conditions.
  • Stems cells moving from their introduction site and not going where they are intended or not staying contained to the specific area of treatment—One study involving pigs treated with stem cells injected into areas of a damaged heart after a heart attack showed near complete return of function, but then the new heart tissue kept growing, eventually filling the heart’s pumping chamber, which caused all the pigs to die.
  • Stem cells changing into unexpected or inappropriate cell types—Stem cells used for a facial cosmetic effect have actually turned to bone.2
  • Growth of tumors—There are documented cases of different tumors, including brain and kidney tumors that have developed after patients were treated for stroke and kidney failure using stem cells.
  • Failure to work as expected—There are documented cases of people with macular degeneration, who were treated with stem cells injected into the eye, that have resulted in blindness.
  • Stem cells can’t be withdrawn—Unlike medicines such as a pill or an injection, if something goes wrong, one can’t just withhold the next dose. Once stem cells are introduced, they can’t be taken back. The course that has been set will continue.

The rates of complications are hard to know, since there are no reporting requirements when performed outside of formal clinical investigations.

Next, the known benefits

The FDA (the governmental Food and Drug Administration that is tasked with health safety) has approved stem cell treatments for dozens of blood cancers (leukemias) and blood diseases using umbilical cord stem cells. Though not FDA approved, studies have shown some benefit for using stem cells for orthopedic applications, particularly arthritis of the knees. (Using stem cells for such orthopedic uses, without the need to stimulate them to become cartilage cells beforehand, appears to be the exception to the rule. Remember most stem cells need to be specialized before being used.) That’s it! Aside from this, most other uses for stem cells should only be considered either highly experimental or highly suspect of exaggerated benefits. Could there be other beneficial treatments that are not FDA approved? Perhaps, but it’s important to realize that the claims have often far outpaced the science.

So how is one to know? Here are some things to consider when choosing providers of stem cell treatments, as well as red flags, to tell you if there are better places to go for your health care. (These points are also true for just about any other treatment):

  1. Informed consent—Every medical treatment has risks and benefits. These should be routinely discussed with you beforehand, without you needing to ask. Any practitioner who claims there are no risks, only benefits, either is not sufficiently knowledgeable or is not sufficiently honest!
  2. Can they handle the complications? —Joint injections can sometimes result in infection. These can be severe infections that can potentially destroy the joint. Such complications are not just simply treated with antibiotics, but with surgery. These stem cell treatments are better handled by an orthopedic surgeon or practitioner that has a close relationship with one, if complications should arise. Likewise, treatments involving nerves should be done by neurologists or neurosurgeons.
  3. Is the clinic adequately equipped? —Stem cells need to be handled appropriately. The transport of umbilical stem cells and improper thawing from the supplier can drastically reduce numbers, which may have a great deal to do with determining the success of the procedure. Additionally, these cells may be in a state of “shock,” unless they are appropriately re-cultured after being thawed. This allows them to re-enter a desirable growth phase again.3 This may mean having a specialized lab and microbiologist on staff to properly grow and care for the stem cells, ensuring good quality control. This usually requires a university setting, not just a small clinic or office that has a nurse to thaw the stem cells after receiving them from an overnight delivery service. Glitzy web sites, colorful brochures, and informational dinners are not enough.
  4. Guinea pigs and rats are “experimented on,” people go through “clinical trials.” —Please avoid any practitioner who says they are doing experiments. Clinical trials involving people, which have the oversight of ethics boards, only occur after experiments on animals have shown low risk of harm, and a good chance of success. If a treatment is very effective, the FDA has suggested that as few as 42 participants can demonstrate adequate safety to grant approval. This is not an outrageously high threshold to overcome. Additionally, patients involved in clinical trials are usually only expected to cover minimal costs, if any. Practitioners who “experiment” on people rarely do it for free.4
  5. Realistic claims. —Does your practitioner claim 100 percent success? If so, it is better to run away (if your knees will allow you to) than to simply walk away! Knee treatments, for example, may only delay knee replacements for many people. Some may avoid surgery, but certainly not all. Do not expect a cure. Also, do they make claims well outside of what is commonly recognized? “Cures” claimed for Alzheimers, Parkinson’s, or other ailments that are not FDA approved? I cannot totally exclude the possibility that such treatments may exist at some future time. However, these practitioners should be able to point to (and provide to you) published studies. If there is a miraculous cure, the world should be able to benefit from it, and he or she should be able to patent it, so as to reap the financial benefits of sharing their techniques and discoveries with the rest of the world. By doing so, it is independently tested and verified. Anyone who has a “secret” cure, that they alone possess, should be avoided.
  1. Does it make sense? —By simply injecting stem cells (that have not been induced by a lab into their specialty state such as nerve cells, heart cells, etc.) into the bloodstream to treat things like nerve disorders, for example, does not make sense. Clinical trials of legitimate treatments first specialize the stem cells, then directly apply them to the affected area. For example, specific types of nerve cells are injected directly into specific locations of the brain, and heart cells are injected directly into the scarred tissue of the heart. Remember the indolent adult (the unspecialized stem cell)? You can’t expect to put them on a bus (inject them into a vein), send them into the big city (the body), without instructions on what to do (leaving them unspecialized), not knowing where to go (to somehow find the diseased part of the body) and then magically expect success.
  2. The hard sell. —Are you being told that or are you made to feel that you are “missing out” if you decline? Do the clinic advertisements have testimonial bylines, something to the effect of “Individual results may vary, and testimonials are not claimed to represent typical results and are not intended to represent or guarantee that anyone will achieve the same or similar results…”? As the old adage goes, if it’s too good to be true (especially if they actually tell you so), then it probably is. In these cases, consider the claims to be most likely somewhat exaggerated, and also consider working with someone who can give a more honest set of expectations.

I pray that God may grant you wisdom: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him –Jas 1:5.

I dag vill jag fortsätta och kanske avsluta vår diskussion om regenerativ medicin. Jag vill se på var den står i dag och hur kristna kan navigera i behandlingarnas komplicerade labyrint. Som ni kanske minns diskuterade vi i förra numret av den här tidskriften att regenerativ medicin är människans försök att återskapa organsystem. Vi beskrev hur man försökte använda fostervävnad på grund av den låga risken för avstötning hos mottagarna. Medicinskt sett var detta problematiskt eftersom det, om det användes i stor skala, skulle krävas stora mängder aborterade foster. Senare studerades embryonala stamceller ingående. Då dissekeras (skärs sönder) embryon, som är nybefruktade människor i sina allra tidigaste utvecklingsstadier, och stamceller tas ut.

Tänk på stamceller som lata, omogna vuxna som bor i sina föräldrars källare, utan riktning och utan att veta vad de vill göra med sina liv. Med lite uppmuntran och vägledning kan de till slut hitta sin väg och finna en specialiserad färdighet och en viktig roll i livet. På samma sätt har forskare upptäckt sätt att ”programmera” dessa stamceller och ”uppmuntra” dem att utvecklas till specialiserade celltyper, som nerv-, hjärt- och blodceller samt insulinproducerande celler. Dessa celler skulle sedan odlas i ett laboratorium och därefter användas för att reparera eller ersätta sjuk eller skadad vävnad.

Att ”ta” stamceller från embryon leder emellertid till att embryot förstörs. Detta är uppenbart problematiskt för kristna, eftersom vi vet att en av de sju saker som Herren säger är en styggelse är …händer som utgjuter oskyldigt blod – Ords 6:17. Dessutom lyder det sjätte budet: Du skall inte dräpa – 2 Mos 20:13. Eftersom den vetenskapliga världen insåg dessa invändningar uppstod ett tryck att finna ett alternativ.

Aposteln Paulus säger: Ingen annan frestelse har drabbat er än sådana som människor möter. Gud är trofast och skall inte tillåta att ni frestas över er förmåga, utan när frestelsen kommer skall han också bereda en utväg, så att ni kan härda ut – 1 Kor 10:13. Hans ord är lika sanna i dag som de var för 2 000 år sedan. Kristna drabbas av sjukdom lika ofta som icke-kristna, men den moderna medicinen kan erbjuda ”frestelsen” att få behandling och lindring från sjukdom eller skada på ett sätt som faktiskt är omoraliskt. Men Gud är trofast, och hans utväg är tvåfaldig. Framför allt gav han sin Son för att bära våra bördor. Det är till denne store läkare vi alltid först bör vända oss.

När det gäller stamcellsbehandlingar visade det sig att dessa omogna stamceller inte bara finns i mänskliga embryon, utan också hos alla människor, från spädbarn till vuxna. Detta kan vara den fysiska ”utvägen” för hans trogna barn. Dessa omogna stamceller (som vanligtvis tas från patientens fettvävnad eller benmärg) kan odlas, förökas och användas lika väl som embryonala stamceller. Det visar sig att ”vuxna stamceller” faktiskt har varit mer effektiva kliniskt, eftersom de är ”specialanpassade” för varje individ och kommer från personens egen kropp; därför är risken för avstötning mycket liten.

Stamceller från navelsträngen har också visat sig vara användbara, särskilt vid behandling av ben och brosk. Precis som det har funnits hinder att övervinna vid användning av embryonala stamceller finns det också problem med att utveckla behandlingar med vuxna stamceller eller stamceller från navelsträngen. Tänk åter på en stamcell som en omogen, lat vuxen. Att bara låta honom ”hänga med” en mästersnickare gör honom inte till en mästersnickare om allt han gör är att roa sig med sin mobiltelefon. Stamceller behöver, liksom lärlingar, intensiv och fokuserad träning och vägledning för att bli specialister inom det område de valt. Att lära sig slå på dessa ”omkopplare” är kanske en av de största utmaningarna. Huvudpoängen här är att det inte automatiskt får stamceller att ”veta” vad de ska bli eller hur de ska fungera om man bara injicerar stamceller som inte har ”programmerats” eller ”tränats” i skadad eller sjuk vävnad.

På samma sätt leder det inte till att elektriciteten återställs om man bara sätter en ung elektronikmontör på en buss som åker in i en stad där elnätet just har slagits ut. Parallellen här är att placera stamceller i hjärnan hos någon som drabbats av stroke eller hos en olycksoffer som blivit förlamad och hoppas att stamcellerna ska ”veta” vad de ska göra och vilka specifika förbindelser de ska reparera för att återställa funktionen. Det kanske inte fungerar som man hoppas. Det vore meningslöst att förvänta sig framgång om inte även dessa problem hanteras.

Det finns också det kvarstående problemet med att dessa ivriga ungdomar (stamcellerna) vet när de ska sluta. Problemet med fostervävnad som utvecklas till cancertumörer måste också hanteras när det gäller stamceller. Med detta i åtanke finns ett undantag: stamceller från navelsträngen är i allmänhet inte kända för att bli maligna.1

Här är en kort lista över behandlingar under utveckling där stamceller skulle användas:

  • Makuladegeneration – Reparera en skadad näthinna.
  • Ryggmärgsskada/stroke – Reparera nervvävnad.
  • Brännskador – Reparera hudvävnad.
  • Kongestiv hjärtsvikt – Reparera skadad hjärtvävnad.
  • Diabetes – Ersätta eller öka den bukspottkörtelvävnad som producerar insulin.
  • Artrit – Reparera skadat brosk.
  • Autoimmuna sjukdomar (lupus, multipel skleros) – Förstöra immunförsvaret som angriper den egna kroppen och ersätta det eller ”återställa” det med ett nytt immunförsvar som härrör från personens egna stamceller.
  • Leukemier – Förstöra de cancerösa blodcellerna och ersätta dem med nya blodceller som härrör från stamceller.
  • Nya organ – Ersätta sjuka, skadade eller cancerdrabbade organ, som njurar, lever eller bukspottkörtel, med organ som härrör från patientens egna stamceller, odlade i ett laboratorium och inopererade utan behov av avstötningshämmande läkemedel.

Som ni ser finns det en mycket lång lista över sjukdomar och besvär som kan få effektiva behandlingar med stamceller. Jag är mycket optimistisk och tror att botemedel mot många av dessa besvär kommer att vara allmänt tillgängliga inom ett decennium. Men det kommer att ta tid att lära sig att få stamceller att bli specialiserade på specifika vävnadstyper, att lära sig slå på stamceller och sedan stänga av dem vid rätt tidpunkt (när arbetet är klart) och att lära sig ”visa” stamcellerna var och hur de ska reparera.

Jag är inte den enda som är entusiastisk över möjligheterna. Därför har hundratals stamcellskliniker dykt upp runt om i landet och försöker ta del av entusiasmen. Men stämmer någon av dessa klinikers påståenden överens med verkligheten? Vilka är seriösa? Jag vet att många kliniker erbjuder stamcellsbehandlingar för olika besvär, så låt oss nu se på några av de behandlingar som finns tillgängliga i dag – sådana där det finns belägg för faktisk nytta och där förväntningarna är realistiska. Låt oss också se på några möjliga komplikationer, så att vi kan fatta välgrundade beslut.

Först: riskerna och komplikationerna

  • Infektion förs in – Till exempel kan bakterier som lever på huden komma in i en led genom en enkel injektion och leda till att leden förstörs, även under de allra renaste förhållanden.
  • Stamceller förflyttar sig från platsen där de fördes in och hamnar inte där de är avsedda att hamna eller stannar inte inom det specifika behandlingsområdet – I en studie där grisar behandlades med stamceller som injicerades i områden med skadad hjärtmuskel efter en hjärtinfarkt återställdes funktionen nästan helt. Men den nya hjärtvävnaden fortsatte sedan att växa och fyllde så småningom hjärtats pumpkammare, vilket ledde till att alla grisarna dog.
  • Stamceller utvecklas till oväntade eller olämpliga celltyper – Stamceller som använts för kosmetisk behandling av ansiktet har faktiskt utvecklats till benvävnad.2
  • Tumörer växer – Det finns dokumenterade fall av olika tumörer, däribland hjärn- och njurtumörer, som utvecklats efter att patienter behandlats med stamceller för stroke och njursvikt.
  • Behandlingen fungerar inte som väntat – Det finns dokumenterade fall där personer med makuladegeneration som behandlats med stamceller injicerade i ögat har blivit blinda.
  • Stamcellerna kan inte tas tillbaka – Till skillnad från läkemedel som ett piller eller en injektion kan man inte bara avstå från nästa dos om något går fel. När stamceller väl har förts in kan de inte tas tillbaka. Det förlopp som satts i gång fortsätter.

Det är svårt att veta hur ofta komplikationer uppstår, eftersom det inte finns några rapporteringskrav när behandlingar utförs utanför formella kliniska prövningar.

Därefter: kända fördelar

FDA (den amerikanska myndigheten Food and Drug Administration, som ansvarar för hälsosäkerhet) har godkänt stamcellsbehandlingar för dussintals blodcancerformer (leukemier) och blodsjukdomar med hjälp av stamceller från navelsträngen. Studier har visat viss nytta av stamceller vid ortopediska tillämpningar, särskilt knäartros, även om de inte är godkända av FDA. (Att använda stamceller vid sådana ortopediska behandlingar utan att först behöva stimulera dem att bli broskceller verkar vara undantaget från regeln. Kom ihåg att de flesta stamceller behöver specialiseras innan de används.) Det är allt! Bortsett från detta bör de flesta andra användningsområden för stamceller endast betraktas som antingen mycket experimentella eller starkt misstänkta för att överdriva nyttan. Kan det finnas andra nyttiga behandlingar som inte godkänts av FDA? Kanske, men det är viktigt att inse att påståendena ofta har sprungit långt före vetenskapen.

Så hur ska man veta? Här är några saker att tänka på när man väljer vårdgivare för stamcellsbehandlingar, liksom varningssignaler som kan visa att det finns bättre ställen att söka vård på. (Dessa punkter gäller också i stort sett alla andra behandlingar):

  1. Informerat samtycke – Alla medicinska behandlingar har risker och fördelar. Dessa bör rutinmässigt diskuteras med dig i förväg, utan att du ska behöva fråga. En vårdgivare som påstår att det inte finns några risker, bara fördelar, är antingen inte tillräckligt kunnig eller inte tillräckligt ärlig!
  2. Kan de hantera komplikationerna? – Ledinjektioner kan ibland leda till infektion. Sådana infektioner kan vara allvarliga och potentiellt förstöra leden. Komplikationerna behandlas inte bara med antibiotika, utan med kirurgi. Stamcellsbehandlingar av det här slaget hanteras bäst av en ortopedkirurg eller en vårdgivare med nära kontakt med en sådan, om komplikationer skulle uppstå. På samma sätt bör behandlingar som involverar nerver utföras av neurologer eller neurokirurger.
  3. Är kliniken tillräckligt välutrustad? – Stamceller måste hanteras på rätt sätt. Transporten av stamceller från navelsträngen och felaktig upptining hos leverantören kan drastiskt minska antalet celler, vilket kan ha stor betydelse för hur väl ingreppet lyckas. Dessutom kan cellerna befinna sig i ett tillstånd av ”chock” om de inte odlas på nytt på rätt sätt efter upptining. På så vis kan de återgå till en önskvärd tillväxtfas.3 Detta kan innebära att kliniken behöver ha ett specialiserat laboratorium och en mikrobiolog anställd för att odla och ta hand om stamcellerna på rätt sätt och säkerställa god kvalitetskontroll. Vanligtvis kräver detta en universitetsmiljö, inte bara en liten klinik eller mottagning där en sjuksköterska tinar upp stamcellerna efter att de levererats med en budtjänst över natten. Flotta webbplatser, färgglada broschyrer och informationsmiddagar räcker inte.
  4. ”Experimenterar man på” marsvin och råttor; människor deltar i ”kliniska prövningar”. – Undvik vårdgivare som säger att de utför experiment. Kliniska prövningar med människor, som granskas av etikkommittéer, sker först efter att djurförsök har visat låg risk för skada och goda utsikter till framgång. Om en behandling är mycket effektiv har FDA antytt att så få som 42 deltagare kan räcka för att visa tillräcklig säkerhet för ett godkännande. Det är inte en orimligt hög tröskel att ta sig över. Dessutom förväntas patienter som deltar i kliniska prövningar vanligtvis bara stå för minimala kostnader, om några alls. Vårdgivare som ”experimenterar” på människor gör det sällan gratis.4
  5. Realistiska påståenden – Påstår din vårdgivare att behandlingen lyckas till 100 procent? I så fall är det bättre att springa därifrån (om knäna tillåter det) än att bara gå därifrån! Knäbehandlingar kan till exempel bara skjuta upp knäprotesoperationer för många människor. Vissa kanske slipper operation, men absolut inte alla. Förvänta dig inte ett botemedel. Gör de också påståenden som går långt utöver vad som allmänt erkänns? Påstår de att de kan ”bota” Alzheimers sjukdom, Parkinsons sjukdom eller andra besvär utan FDA-godkännande? Jag kan inte helt utesluta möjligheten att sådana behandlingar kan finnas någon gång i framtiden. Men dessa vårdgivare bör kunna hänvisa till (och tillhandahålla) publicerade studier. Om det finns ett mirakulöst botemedel bör världen kunna dra nytta av det, och vårdgivaren bör kunna patentera det och därmed få ekonomisk vinning av att dela sina tekniker och upptäckter med resten av världen. Då kan det prövas och verifieras oberoende. Man bör undvika alla som har ett ”hemligt” botemedel som bara de själva besitter.
  1. Verkar det rimligt? – Det verkar inte rimligt att bara injicera stamceller i blodomloppet (som inte har fått laboratoriebehandling för att utvecklas till sin specialiserade form, till exempel nervceller eller hjärtceller) för att behandla exempelvis nervsjukdomar. I kliniska prövningar av seriösa behandlingar specialiseras stamcellerna först och förs sedan direkt till det drabbade området. Till exempel injiceras specifika typer av nervceller direkt på särskilda platser i hjärnan, och hjärtceller injiceras direkt i ärrvävnaden i hjärtat. Kom ihåg den lata vuxna (den ospecialiserade stamcellen). Man kan inte förvänta sig att sätta dem på en buss (injicera dem i en ven), skicka dem till storstaden (kroppen) utan instruktioner om vad de ska göra (låta dem vara ospecialiserade), utan att veta vart de ska (på något sätt hitta den sjuka delen av kroppen) och sedan magiskt förvänta sig framgång.
  2. Hårdförsäljning – Får du höra, eller får du känslan av, att du ”går miste om något” om du tackar nej? Har klinikens annonser vittnesmål med en ansvarsfriskrivning, ungefär som: ”Resultaten kan variera mellan individer. Vittnesmål påstås inte representera typiska resultat och är inte avsedda att representera eller garantera att någon kommer att uppnå samma eller liknande resultat…”? Som det gamla ordspråket säger: om något verkar för bra för att vara sant (särskilt om de faktiskt säger det till dig), så är det förmodligen det. I sådana fall bör du utgå från att påståendena sannolikt är något överdrivna och överväga att samarbeta med någon som kan ge mer ärliga förväntningar.

Jag ber att Gud må ge er vishet: Om någon av er saknar vishet skall han be Gud, som ger åt alla villigt och utan förebråelser, och han skall få den – Jak 1:5.

Särskild anmärkning:

En del föräldrar har visat intresse för att ta sina barn till Japan för att vaccinera dem där, om vi inte kan få vaccinerna skickade till USA. Om det finns några läsare av den här tidskriften som också är intresserade, ber vi er kontakta The Berean Voice, så att vi kan planera och samordna detta. Kontaktuppgifter finns på insidan av omslaget på valfritt exemplar av tidskriften The Heartbeat of the Remnant.

1 Chen G., Yue A., Ruan Z. Mänskliga mesenkymala stamceller från navelsträng genomgår inte malign omvandling vid långtidsodling i serumfritt medium. PLoS One. 2014;9:1–9.

2 https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/stem-cell-cosmetics/?redirect=1

3 https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3279133/

4 http://iacld.ir/DL/elm/95/clarifying%20stem%20cell%20therapy%60s%20benefits%20and%20risks.pdf

My Help and My Deliverer

Psalm 40:1 I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry. 2 He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings. 3 And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD. 4 Blessed is that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies. 5 Many, O LORD my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered. 6 Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required. 7 Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me, 8 I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart. 9 I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest. 10 I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation. 11 Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me. 12 For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me. 13 Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me. 14 Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil. 15 Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha. 16 Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified. 17 But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

A glorious morning unfolds before me, perfect and peaceful, unmarred by failure. The sky is clear and blue. The horizon is a soft, blushing pink, enhanced by a misty fog. The distant hills and trees are shaded a dusky blue in the misty morning coolness. The morning is ringing with the warbling, twittering, chirping of birds. The grass glows with millions of dew droplets sparkling in the morning light. The pink horizon above the distant, dusky hills gradually fades into a glowing orange sphere that becomes brighter and brighter.

I stand in awe of God. My heart is thrilled at the beauty spread out before me. I am also thrilled at what God has done in my life, and the beauty He has created out of ashes.

I waited patiently for the Lord; and He inclined unto me, and heard my cry. He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings. God has brought me up out of the pit of despair and discouragement. He has set my feet upon the Rock, Jesus Christ, and He has established my goings. He knows the plans He has for me. His thoughts and His ways are much higher than mine.

He hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the Lord. I desire that God will be glorified through the work He has done and is continuing to do in my life. Many, O Lord, are Thy wonderful works which Thou hast done, and Thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto Thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.

I delight to do Thy will, O God: yea, Thy law is within my heart. It is truly my delight to do the will of God; to love Him with my whole heart, soul, strength, and mind; to obey His commandments from my heart.

I have not hid Thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared Thy faithfulness and Thy salvation: I have not concealed Thy lovingkindness and Thy truth from the great congregation. It is such a blessing to have deep and edifying conversations with my brothers and sisters in the Lord, and to share together what the Lord is doing in our lives. It is a great strengthening to my faith.

Withhold not Thy tender mercies from me, O Lord: let Thy lovingkindness and Thy truth continually preserve me. Temptations and hard tests are a very real thing in life; the struggle to keep my heart with a diligence, the battle against stubborn pride, and the urge to utter hasty words of frustration. Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me: O Lord, make haste to help me. Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

The sun has risen above the distant hills and the countryside is now glowing gloriously. The mist has faded into the woods and the distant dusky blue hills and trees have exchanged their robes for vivid shades of green intermixed with hints of red and brown. The sparkling droplets of dew are dazzling in the brilliant sunlight.

Let those that seek Thee rejoice and be glad in Thee: let such as love Thy salvation say continually, The Lord be magnified. I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: Thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

Mon secours et mon libérateur

Psaume 40:1 J’ai attendu patiemment l’Éternel ; il s’est penché vers moi et a entendu mon cri. 2 Il m’a aussi fait remonter d’une fosse horrible, d’un bourbier fangeux, et a posé mes pieds sur un rocher ; il a affermi mes pas. 3 Il a mis dans ma bouche un chant nouveau, une louange à notre Dieu : beaucoup le verront, craindront et se confieront en l’Éternel. 4 Heureux l’homme qui fait de l’Éternel sa confiance et ne se tourne pas vers les orgueilleux, ni vers ceux qui s’égarent dans le mensonge. 5 Éternel, mon Dieu, tes œuvres merveilleuses sont nombreuses, ainsi que tes pensées en notre faveur ; elles ne peuvent être mises en ordre devant toi. Si je voulais les annoncer et en parler, elles seraient plus nombreuses qu’on ne peut les compter. 6 Tu n’as désiré ni sacrifice ni offrande ; tu m’as ouvert les oreilles ; tu n’as demandé ni holocauste ni sacrifice pour le péché. 7 Alors j’ai dit : Me voici, je viens ; il est écrit de moi dans le rouleau du livre. 8 Je prends plaisir à faire ta volonté, ô mon Dieu ; oui, ta loi est au fond de mon cœur. 9 J’ai annoncé la justice dans la grande assemblée ; voici, je n’ai pas retenu mes lèvres, Éternel, tu le sais. 10 Je n’ai pas caché ta justice au fond de mon cœur ; j’ai proclamé ta fidélité et ton salut ; je n’ai pas dissimulé ta bonté et ta vérité à la grande assemblée. 11 Éternel, ne me refuse pas tes tendres compassions ; que ta bonté et ta vérité me gardent continuellement. 12 Car des malheurs innombrables m’environnent ; mes iniquités m’ont atteint, au point que je ne peux plus lever les yeux ; elles sont plus nombreuses que les cheveux de ma tête, et mon cœur me manque. 13 Veuille, Éternel, me délivrer ; Éternel, hâte-toi de me secourir. 14 Qu’ils soient ensemble couverts de honte et confondus, ceux qui cherchent à m’ôter la vie ; qu’ils reculent et soient couverts de honte, ceux qui me veulent du mal. 15 Qu’ils soient désolés en récompense de leur honte, ceux qui me disent : Ah ! ah ! 16 Que tous ceux qui te cherchent se réjouissent et soient dans l’allégresse en toi ; que ceux qui aiment ton salut disent continuellement : L’Éternel soit magnifié ! 17 Mais moi, je suis pauvre et dans le besoin ; pourtant, le Seigneur pense à moi. Tu es mon secours et mon libérateur ; ne tarde pas, ô mon Dieu.

Un matin glorieux s’ouvre devant moi, parfait et paisible, sans être terni par l’échec. Le ciel est clair et bleu. L’horizon est d’un rose tendre, rehaussé par une brume vaporeuse. Les collines et les arbres lointains prennent une teinte bleu sombre dans la fraîcheur brumeuse du matin. Le matin résonne du chant mélodieux, des gazouillis et des pépiements des oiseaux. L’herbe luit, couverte de millions de gouttes de rosée qui scintillent dans la lumière matinale. L’horizon rose au-dessus des collines lointaines d’un bleu sombre se transforme peu à peu en une sphère orange éclatante, qui devient de plus en plus lumineuse.

Je contemple Dieu avec émerveillement. Mon cœur est émerveillé par la beauté qui s’étend devant moi. Je suis aussi émerveillée par ce que Dieu a fait dans ma vie et par la beauté qu’il a fait naître des cendres.

J’ai attendu patiemment le Seigneur ; il s’est penché vers moi et a entendu mon cri. Il m’a aussi fait remonter d’une fosse horrible, d’un bourbier fangeux, et a posé mes pieds sur un rocher ; il a affermi mes pas. Dieu m’a fait remonter de la fosse du désespoir et du découragement. Il a posé mes pieds sur le Rocher, Jésus-Christ, et il a affermi mes pas. Il connaît les projets qu’il a pour moi. Ses pensées et ses voies sont bien plus élevées que les miennes.

Il a mis dans ma bouche un chant nouveau, une louange à notre Dieu : beaucoup le verront, craindront et se confieront dans le Seigneur. Je désire que Dieu soit glorifié par l’œuvre qu’il a accomplie et qu’il continue d’accomplir dans ma vie. Seigneur, tes œuvres merveilleuses sont nombreuses, ainsi que tes pensées en notre faveur ; elles ne peuvent être mises en ordre devant toi. Si je voulais les annoncer et en parler, elles seraient plus nombreuses qu’on ne peut les compter.

Je prends plaisir à faire ta volonté, ô Dieu ; oui, ta loi est au fond de mon cœur. C’est véritablement pour moi un plaisir de faire la volonté de Dieu : l’aimer de tout mon cœur, de toute mon âme, de toute ma force et de toute ma pensée ; obéir à ses commandements de tout mon cœur.

Je n’ai pas caché ta justice au fond de mon cœur ; j’ai proclamé ta fidélité et ton salut ; je n’ai pas dissimulé ta bonté et ta vérité à la grande assemblée. C’est une telle bénédiction d’avoir des conversations profondes et édifiantes avec mes frères et sœurs dans le Seigneur, et de partager ensemble ce que le Seigneur fait dans nos vies. Cela fortifie grandement ma foi.

Ne me refuse pas tes tendres compassions, ô Seigneur ; que ta bonté et ta vérité me gardent continuellement. Les tentations et les épreuves difficiles sont bien réelles dans la vie : la lutte pour garder mon cœur avec diligence, le combat contre l’orgueil obstiné et la tentation de prononcer des paroles irréfléchies sous le coup de la frustration. Veuille, ô Seigneur, me délivrer ; ô Seigneur, hâte-toi de me secourir. Qu’ils soient ensemble couverts de honte et confondus, ceux qui cherchent à m’ôter la vie ; qu’ils reculent et soient couverts de honte, ceux qui me veulent du mal.

Le soleil s’est élevé au-dessus des collines lointaines et la campagne resplendit maintenant de toute sa splendeur. Today, I’d like to continue and possibly complete our discussion of Regenerative Medicine. I want to consider where it stands today, and how Christians can navigate the complex maze of treatments. As you may recall, in the previous issue of this magazine we discussed that Regenerative Medicine is man’s attempt to re-create organ systems. We described how fetal tissue was attempted to be used, due to its low rate of rejection by the people receiving it. Medically speaking, it was problematic in that, if used on a large scale, it would require large amounts of aborted fetuses. Later, embryonic stem cells were studied in depth. Here, embryos, which are newly conceived humans in their earliest stages, are dissected (cut apart) and stem cells are taken.

Think of stem cells as indolent, immature adults, who live in their parents’ basements, without direction, not knowing what they want to do with their lives. With a little encouragement and direction, they can finally find their way, finding a specialized skill and important role in life. In like manner, scientists have discovered ways to “program” these stem cells, “encouraging” them to become specialized into types of cells, such as nerve, heart, blood, and insulin producing. These cells would then be grown in a lab, then used to repair or replace the diseased or injured tissue.

However, “taking” stem cells from embryos results in his or her (the embryo’s) destruction. This is obviously problematic for Christians, knowing that one of the seven things that the Lord says is an abomination is …hands that shed innocent blood –Pro 6:17. Additionally, the sixth commandment directs, Thou shalt not kill –Exo 20:13. Because these objections were recognized by the scientific community, there was pressure to find an alternative.

The Apostle Paul states, There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it –1Co 10:13. His words are as true today as they were 2000 years ago. While Christians suffer from disease just as commonly as non-Christians do, modern medicine can present the “temptation” of a treatment and relief from disease or injury that is actually immoral. But God is faithful, and his escape is twofold. First and foremost, He gave His son to bear our burdens. It is to this Great Physician that we should always turn to first.

In the case of stem cell treatments, it so happens that it was discovered that these immature stem cells are not only found in human embryos, but they are also found in all people, from infants to grown-ups as well. This may be the physical “escape” for His faithful children. These immature stem cells (usually obtained from a patient’s fat tissue or bone marrow) can be grown, cultured, and used just as well as embryonic stem cells. It turns out that “Adult Stem Cells” have actually been more clinically effective, since they are “custom designed” for each individual, and since they come from that person’s own body; therefore, there is very little problem with rejection.

Umbilical cord stem cells have also been shown to be useful, particularly in bone and cartilage treatments. Just as there have been obstacles to overcome when using embryonic stem cells, so too there are problems with developing treatments using adult or umbilical cord stem cells. Think again of a stem cell as an immature, indolent adult. Just having him “hang out” with a master carpenter will not make him a master carpenter if all he does is find entertainment on his cell phone. Stem cells, like an apprentice, need intense, focused training and direction to become specialists in their chosen field of expertise. Learning how to turn these “switches” on is perhaps one of the greatest challenges. The main idea here is that just injecting stem cells that have not been “programmed” or “trained” into damaged or diseased tissue will not automatically make them “know” what to become or how to function.

Similarly, just putting a young electronics apprentice on a bus that is traveling into a city that just had a power grid failure will not result in restoring the power. Here the parallel is placing stem cells into the brain of a stroke victim or a paraplegic accident victim, hoping that the stem cells will “know” what to do, and which specific connections to repair in order to restore function. This may not work as hoped. It would be fruitless to expect success unless and until these problems are also addressed.

Then there is the lingering problem of these eager youngsters (stem cells) knowing when to stop. The problem with fetal tissue turning into cancerous tumors is also a problem to be dealt with in stem cells. Considering this, there is one exception: umbilical cord stem cells are generally not known to turn malignant.1

Here is a short list of treatments that are in development that would use stem cells:

  • Macular Degeneration—Repair a damaged retina.
  • Spinal Cord Injury/Stroke—Repair nerve tissue.
  • Burns—Repair skin tissue.
  • Congestive Heart Failure—Repair damaged heart tissue.
  • Diabetes—Replace or increase the pancreatic tissue that makes insulin.
  • Arthritis—Repair damaged cartilage.
  • Autoimmune diseases (Lupus, Multiple Sclerosis) —Destroy the immune system that is attacking its own body and replace or “reset” it with a new immune system derived from one’s own stem cells.
  • Leukemias—Destroy the cancerous blood cells and replace them with new stem cell derived blood cells.
  • New organs—Replace diseased, damaged, or cancer-ridden organs, such as the kidney, liver, or pancreas, with organs derived from the patient’s own stem cells, grown in a lab, and transplanted surgically, without the need of anti-rejection drugs.

As you can see, there is a very long list of diseases and ailments that may result in effective treatments with stem cells. I am very optimistic that within a decade, remedies for many of these ailments will be commonly available. However, learning how to make stem cells that are expertly specialized into specific tissue types, learning how to turn stems cells on and then turning them off at the necessary time (once the job is finished), and learning how to “teach” the stem cells where and how to make repairs will take time.

I am not the only one who is excited about the possibilities. That is why hundreds of stem cell clinics have sprung up across the country, trying to get in on the excitement. But do the claims of any of these clinics align with reality? Which ones are legitimate? I know that there are many clinics offering stem cell treatments for various ailments, so let’s now look at some of the treatments that are available today—ones that have evidence of actually helping, as well as realistic expectations. Let’s also look at some of the possible complications, to help us make informed decisions.

First, the risks and complications

  • Introduction of infection—For example, bacteria living on the skin can enter a joint space from a simple injection, resulting in destruction of the joint, even under the cleanest of conditions.
  • Stems cells moving from their introduction site and not going where they are intended or not staying contained to the specific area of treatment—One study involving pigs treated with stem cells injected into areas of a damaged heart after a heart attack showed near complete return of function, but then the new heart tissue kept growing, eventually filling the heart’s pumping chamber, which caused all the pigs to die.
  • Stem cells changing into unexpected or inappropriate cell types—Stem cells used for a facial cosmetic effect have actually turned to bone.2
  • Growth of tumors—There are documented cases of different tumors, including brain and kidney tumors that have developed after patients were treated for stroke and kidney failure using stem cells.
  • Failure to work as expected—There are documented cases of people with macular degeneration, who were treated with stem cells injected into the eye, that have resulted in blindness.
  • Stem cells can’t be withdrawn—Unlike medicines such as a pill or an injection, if something goes wrong, one can’t just withhold the next dose. Once stem cells are introduced, they can’t be taken back. The course that has been set will continue.

The rates of complications are hard to know, since there are no reporting requirements when performed outside of formal clinical investigations.

Next, the known benefits

The FDA (the governmental Food and Drug Administration that is tasked with health safety) has approved stem cell treatments for dozens of blood cancers (leukemias) and blood diseases using umbilical cord stem cells. Though not FDA approved, studies have shown some benefit for using stem cells for orthopedic applications, particularly arthritis of the knees. (Using stem cells for such orthopedic uses, without the need to stimulate them to become cartilage cells beforehand, appears to be the exception to the rule. Remember most stem cells need to be specialized before being used.) That’s it! Aside from this, most other uses for stem cells should only be considered either highly experimental or highly suspect of exaggerated benefits. Could there be other beneficial treatments that are not FDA approved? Perhaps, but it’s important to realize that the claims have often far outpaced the science.

So how is one to know? Here are some things to consider when choosing providers of stem cell treatments, as well as red flags, to tell you if there are better places to go for your health care. (These points are also true for just about any other treatment):

  1. Informed consent—Every medical treatment has risks and benefits. These should be routinely discussed with you beforehand, without you needing to ask. Any practitioner who claims there are no risks, only benefits, either is not sufficiently knowledgeable or is not sufficiently honest!
  2. Can they handle the complications? —Joint injections can sometimes result in infection. These can be severe infections that can potentially destroy the joint. Such complications are not just simply treated with antibiotics, but with surgery. These stem cell treatments are better handled by an orthopedic surgeon or practitioner that has a close relationship with one, if complications should arise. Likewise, treatments involving nerves should be done by neurologists or neurosurgeons.
  3. Is the clinic adequately equipped? —Stem cells need to be handled appropriately. The transport of umbilical stem cells and improper thawing from the supplier can drastically reduce numbers, which may have a great deal to do with determining the success of the procedure. Additionally, these cells may be in a state of “shock,” unless they are appropriately re-cultured after being thawed. This allows them to re-enter a desirable growth phase again.3 This may mean having a specialized lab and microbiologist on staff to properly grow and care for the stem cells, ensuring good quality control. This usually requires a university setting, not just a small clinic or office that has a nurse to thaw the stem cells after receiving them from an overnight delivery service. Glitzy web sites, colorful brochures, and informational dinners are not enough.
  4. Guinea pigs and rats are “experimented on,” people go through “clinical trials.” —Please avoid any practitioner who says they are doing experiments. Clinical trials involving people, which have the oversight of ethics boards, only occur after experiments on animals have shown low risk of harm, and a good chance of success. If a treatment is very effective, the FDA has suggested that as few as 42 participants can demonstrate adequate safety to grant approval. This is not an outrageously high threshold to overcome. Additionally, patients involved in clinical trials are usually only expected to cover minimal costs, if any. Practitioners who “experiment” on people rarely do it for free.4
  5. Realistic claims. —Does your practitioner claim 100 percent success? If so, it is better to run away (if your knees will allow you to) than to simply walk away! Knee treatments, for example, may only delay knee replacements for many people. Some may avoid surgery, but certainly not all. Do not expect a cure. Also, do they make claims well outside of what is commonly recognized? “Cures” claimed for Alzheimers, Parkinson’s, or other ailments that are not FDA approved? I cannot totally exclude the possibility that such treatments may exist at some future time. However, these practitioners should be able to point to (and provide to you) published studies. If there is a miraculous cure, the world should be able to benefit from it, and he or she should be able to patent it, so as to reap the financial benefits of sharing their techniques and discoveries with the rest of the world. By doing so, it is independently tested and verified. Anyone who has a “secret” cure, that they alone possess, should be avoided.
  1. Does it make sense? —By simply injecting stem cells (that have not been induced by a lab into their specialty state such as nerve cells, heart cells, etc.) into the bloodstream to treat things like nerve disorders, for example, does not make sense. Clinical trials of legitimate treatments first specialize the stem cells, then directly apply them to the affected area. For example, specific types of nerve cells are injected directly into specific locations of the brain, and heart cells are injected directly into the scarred tissue of the heart. Remember the indolent adult (the unspecialized stem cell)? You can’t expect to put them on a bus (inject them into a vein), send them into the big city (the body), without instructions on what to do (leaving them unspecialized), not knowing where to go (to somehow find the diseased part of the body) and then magically expect success.
  2. The hard sell. —Are you being told that or are you made to feel that you are “missing out” if you decline? Do the clinic advertisements have testimonial bylines, something to the effect of “Individual results may vary, and testimonials are not claimed to represent typical results and are not intended to represent or guarantee that anyone will achieve the same or similar results…”? As the old adage goes, if it’s too good to be true (especially if they actually tell you so), then it probably is. In these cases, consider the claims to be most likely somewhat exaggerated, and also consider working with someone who can give a more honest set of expectations.

I pray that God may grant you wisdom: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him –Jas 1:5.

Leo, ningependa kuendelea na pengine kukamilisha mjadala wetu kuhusu Tiba ya Kuzalisha Upya. Nataka kuzingatia hali ilivyo leo, na jinsi Wakristo wanavyoweza kupitia mkanganyiko wa matibabu tata. Kama unavyoweza kukumbuka, katika toleo lililopita la gazeti hili tulijadili kwamba Tiba ya Kuzalisha Upya ni jaribio la mwanadamu kuunda upya mifumo ya viungo vya mwili. Tulieleza jinsi tishu za fetasi zilivyojaribiwa kutumiwa kwa sababu ya kiwango chake cha chini cha kukataliwa na watu wanaozipokea. Kwa mtazamo wa kitabibu, hili lilikuwa tatizo kwa sababu, likitumika kwa kiwango kikubwa, lingehitaji fetasi nyingi zilizotolewa mimba. Baadaye, seli shina za kiinitete zilichunguzwa kwa kina. Hapa, viinitete, ambavyo ni binadamu waliotungwa mimba hivi karibuni katika hatua zao za mwanzo kabisa, hugawanywa (huk काटwa vipande) na seli shina hutolewa.

Fikiria seli shina kama watu wazima wavivu, ambao hawajakomaa, wanaoishi katika vyumba vya chini ya ardhi vya wazazi wao, bila mwelekeo, bila kujua wanataka kufanya nini maishani. Kwa kutiwa moyo na kupewa mwelekeo kidogo, hatimaye wanaweza kupata njia yao, wakigundua ujuzi maalumu na jukumu muhimu maishani. Vivyo hivyo, wanasayansi wamegundua njia za “kuandaa” seli hizi shina, “kuzitia moyo” ziwe aina maalumu za seli, kama vile seli za neva, moyo, damu, na zinazozalisha insulini. Kisha seli hizi zingekuzwa katika maabara, halafu zitumike kurekebisha au kuchukua nafasi ya tishu iliyo na ugonjwa au iliyojeruhiwa.

Hata hivyo, “kuchukua” seli shina kutoka kwa viinitete husababisha kuangamizwa kwake (kwa kiinitete). Bila shaka, hili ni tatizo kwa Wakristo, wakijua kwamba mojawapo ya mambo saba ambayo Bwana anasema ni chukizo ni …mikono imwagayo damu isiyo na hatia –Mith 6:17. Zaidi ya hayo, amri ya sita inasema, Usiue –Kut 20:13. Kwa kuwa jumuiya ya wanasayansi ilitambua pingamizi hizi, kulikuwa na shinikizo la kutafuta njia mbadala.

Mtume Paulo anasema, Jaribu halikuwapata ninyi, isipokuwa lililo kawaida ya wanadamu; ila Mungu ni mwaminifu; ambaye hatawaacha mjaribiwe kupita mwezavyo; lakini pamoja na lile jaribu atafanya na mlango wa kutokea, ili mweze kustahimili –1Kor 10:13. Maneno yake ni ya kweli leo kama yalivyokuwa miaka 2000 iliyopita. Ingawa Wakristo huugua magonjwa kama watu wasio Wakristo, tiba ya kisasa inaweza kuleta “jaribu” la matibabu na nafuu kutokana na ugonjwa au jeraha ambalo kwa kweli si la maadili. Lakini Mungu ni mwaminifu, na njia yake ya kutuokoa ina sehemu mbili. Kwanza kabisa, alimtoa Mwanawe ili kubeba mizigo yetu. Ni kwa Mganga huyu Mkuu ndipo tunapaswa kumgeukia kwanza sikuzote.

Katika suala la matibabu ya seli shina, iligunduliwa kwamba seli hizi shina ambazo hazijakomaa hazipatikani tu katika viinitete vya binadamu, bali pia hupatikana kwa watu wote, kuanzia watoto wachanga hadi watu wazima. Hii inaweza kuwa “njia ya kutokea” ya kimwili kwa watoto Wake waaminifu. Seli hizi shina ambazo hazijakomaa (ambazo kwa kawaida hupatikana kutoka kwenye tishu ya mafuta au uboho wa mgonjwa) zinaweza kukuzwa, kufanyiwa utamadunishaji, na kutumiwa vizuri kama seli shina za kiinitete. Inabainika kwamba “Seli Shina za Watu Wazima” zimekuwa na ufanisi zaidi kitabibu, kwa kuwa “zimeundwa mahsusi” kwa kila mtu, na kwa kuwa zinatoka katika mwili wa mtu huyo mwenyewe; kwa hiyo, tatizo la kukataliwa ni dogo sana.

Seli shina za kitovu cha uzazi pia zimeonekana kuwa na manufaa, hasa katika matibabu ya mifupa na gegedu. Kama vile kumekuwa na vikwazo vya kushinda katika kutumia seli shina za kiinitete, vivyo hivyo kuna matatizo katika kuendeleza matibabu kwa kutumia seli shina za watu wazima au za kitovu cha uzazi. Fikiria tena seli shina kama mtu mzima asiye na bidii na ambaye hajakomaa. Kumweka tu “karibu” na seremala stadi hakutamfanya kuwa seremala stadi ikiwa anachofanya ni kujiburudisha kwa simu yake ya mkononi. Seli shina, kama mwanafunzi wa ufundi, zinahitaji mafunzo na mwelekeo wa kina na uliolengwa ili ziwe wataalamu katika fani waliyoichagua. Kujifunza jinsi ya kuwasha “swichi” hizi huenda ni mojawapo ya changamoto kubwa zaidi. Wazo kuu hapa ni kwamba kuingiza tu seli shina ambazo “hazijaandaliwa” au “kufunzwa” katika tishu zilizoharibika au zenye ugonjwa hakutazifanya moja kwa moja “zijue” kuwa nini au jinsi ya kufanya kazi.

Vivyo hivyo, kumweka tu mwanafunzi mchanga wa ufundi wa elektroniki kwenye basi linaloelekea katika jiji ambalo gridi ya umeme imeharibika hakutarejesha umeme. Hapa ulinganifu ni kuweka seli shina katika ubongo wa mtu aliyepooza kutokana na kiharusi au aliyeumia katika ajali na kupooza miguu, kwa kutumaini kwamba seli shina “zitajua” la kufanya, na ni miunganisho ipi hususa ya kurekebisha ili kurejesha utendaji. Huenda hili lisifanye kazi kama ilivyotarajiwa. Haitakuwa na faida kutarajia mafanikio hadi matatizo haya pia yatatuliwe.

Kisha kuna tatizo linaloendelea la hawa vijana wenye hamu (seli shina) kujua wakati wa kusimama. Tatizo la tishu ya fetasi kugeuka kuwa uvimbe wa saratani pia ni tatizo linalopaswa kushughulikiwa katika seli shina. Kwa kuzingatia hili, kuna jambo moja la pekee: kwa ujumla haijulikani kwamba seli shina za kitovu cha uzazi hubadilika kuwa za saratani.1

Hii hapa orodha fupi ya matibabu yanayoendelezwa ambayo yangetumia seli shina:

  • Kuzorota kwa Makula—Kurekebisha retina iliyoharibika.
  • Jeraha la Uti wa Mgongo/Kiharusi—Kurekebisha tishu za neva.
  • Kuungua—Kurekebisha tishu za ngozi.
  • Upungufu wa Moyo wa Mshindo—Kurekebisha tishu za moyo zilizoharibika.
  • Kisukari—Kuchukua nafasi ya au kuongeza tishu ya kongosho inayotengeneza insulini.
  • Arthritis—Kurekebisha gegedu iliyoharibika.
  • Magonjwa ya kingamwili (Lupus, Ugonjwa wa Mishipa mingi ya Ubongo)—Kuharibu mfumo wa kinga unaoshambulia mwili wake wenyewe na kuubadilisha au “kuuweka upya” kwa mfumo mpya wa kinga uliotokana na seli shina za mtu mwenyewe.
  • Leukemia—Kuharibu seli za damu zenye saratani na kuzibadilisha kwa seli mpya za damu zilizotokana na seli shina.
  • Viungo vipya—Kuchukua nafasi ya viungo vyenye ugonjwa, vilivyoharibika, au vilivyoathiriwa na saratani, kama vile figo, ini, au kongosho, kwa viungo vilivyotokana na seli shina za mgonjwa mwenyewe, vilivyokuzwa maabara na kupandikizwa kwa upasuaji, bila kuhitaji dawa za kuzuia kukataliwa.

Kama unavyoona, kuna orodha ndefu sana ya magonjwa na maradhi ambayo yanaweza kupata matibabu yenye ufanisi kwa kutumia seli shina. Nina matumaini makubwa kwamba ndani ya muongo mmoja, tiba za maradhi mengi haya zitapatikana kwa kawaida. Hata hivyo, kujifunza jinsi ya kutengeneza seli shina zilizobobea kitaalamu katika aina mahususi za tishu, kujifunza jinsi ya kuwasha seli shina na kisha kuzizima wakati unaohitajika (mara kazi inapokamilika), na kujifunza jinsi ya “kuzifundisha” seli shina mahali na jinsi ya kufanya marekebisho kutachukua muda.

Mimi si mtu pekee ninayesisimuliwa na uwezekano huu. Ndiyo maana mamia ya kliniki za seli shina zimeanzishwa kote nchini, zikijaribu kunufaika na msisimko huu. Lakini madai ya kliniki hizi yanaendana na uhalisia? Ni zipi zilizo halali? Najua kuna kliniki nyingi zinazotoa matibabu ya seli shina kwa maradhi mbalimbali, kwa hiyo sasa tuangalie baadhi ya matibabu yanayopatikana leo—yale yenye ushahidi kwamba yanasaidia kweli, pamoja na matarajio ya kweli. Pia tuangalie baadhi ya matatizo yanayoweza kutokea, ili kutusaidia kufanya maamuzi yenye taarifa.

Kwanza, hatari na matatizo

  • Kuingiza maambukizi—Kwa mfano, bakteria wanaoishi kwenye ngozi wanaweza kuingia kwenye nafasi ya kiungo kutokana na sindano ya kawaida, na kusababisha kuharibika kwa kiungo, hata katika hali safi kabisa.
  • Seli shina kuhama kutoka mahali zilipoingizwa na kwenda mahali pasipokusudiwa au kutobaki kwenye eneo mahususi la matibabu—Utafiti mmoja uliohusisha nguruwe waliotibiwa kwa kudungwa seli shina katika maeneo ya moyo ulioharibika baada ya mshtuko wa moyo ulionyesha kurejea kwa utendaji karibu kabisa, lakini kisha tishu mpya ya moyo iliendelea kukua, hatimaye ikajaza chumba cha moyo kinachosukuma damu, na kusababisha nguruwe wote kufa.
  • Seli shina kubadilika na kuwa aina za seli zisizotarajiwa au zisizofaa—Seli shina zilizotumiwa kwa athari ya urembo wa uso kwa kweli ziligeuka kuwa mfupa.2
  • Kukua kwa uvimbe—Kuna visa vilivyoripotiwa vya uvimbe mbalimbali, kutia ndani uvimbe wa ubongo na figo, vilivyotokea baada ya wagonjwa kutibiwa kwa kiharusi na kushindwa kwa figo kwa kutumia seli shina.
  • Kushindwa kufanya kazi kama ilivyotarajiwa—Kuna visa vilivyoripotiwa vya watu wenye kuzorota kwa makula, waliotibiwa kwa kudungwa seli shina kwenye jicho, ambao matokeo yake walipofuka.
  • Seli shina haziwezi kuondolewa—Tofauti na dawa kama kidonge au sindano, jambo likiharibika, mtu hawezi tu kuzuia dozi inayofuata. Seli shina zikishaingizwa, haziwezi kurudishwa. Mchakato ulioanzishwa utaendelea.

Ni vigumu kujua viwango vya matatizo, kwa kuwa hakuna sharti la kuripoti yanapotokea nje ya tafiti rasmi za kitabibu.

Kisha, manufaa yanayojulikana

FDA (Utawala wa Chakula na Dawa wa serikali, unaosimamia usalama wa afya) imeidhinisha matibabu ya seli shina kwa makumi ya saratani za damu (leukemia) na magonjwa ya damu kwa kutumia seli shina za kitovu cha uzazi. Ingawa FDA haijaidhinisha, tafiti zimeonyesha manufaa fulani ya kutumia seli shina katika matibabu ya mifupa, hasa arthritis ya magoti. (Kutumia seli shina kwa matumizi hayo ya mifupa bila kuhitaji kuzichochea kwanza ziwe seli za gegedu, inaonekana kuwa jambo la pekee linalokiuka kanuni ya jumla. Kumbuka kwamba seli nyingi shina zinahitaji kubobea kabla ya kutumiwa.) Hayo tu! Kando na hili, matumizi mengine mengi ya seli shina yanapaswa kuchukuliwa kuwa ya majaribio makubwa au yenye uwezekano mkubwa wa madai ya manufaa yaliyotiwa chumvi. Je, kunaweza kuwa na matibabu mengine yenye manufaa ambayo FDA haijaidhinisha? Labda, lakini ni muhimu kutambua kwamba madai mara nyingi yamekwenda mbali zaidi kuliko sayansi.

Basi mtu atajuaje? Hapa kuna mambo ya kuzingatia unapochagua watoa huduma za matibabu ya seli shina, pamoja na ishara za hatari zinazoweza kukuonyesha kama kuna maeneo bora zaidi ya kupata huduma za afya. (Mambo haya pia ni ya kweli kwa karibu matibabu mengine yote):

  1. Ridhaa yenye taarifa—Kila matibabu yana hatari na manufaa. Haya yanapaswa kujadiliwa nawe mara kwa mara kabla ya matibabu, bila wewe kuhitaji kuuliza. Daktari yeyote anayesema hakuna hatari, kuna manufaa tu, ama hana ujuzi wa kutosha au si mwaminifu wa kutosha!
  2. Je, wanaweza kukabiliana na matatizo? —Sindano kwenye viungo wakati mwingine zinaweza kusababisha maambukizi. Haya yanaweza kuwa maambukizi makali yanayoweza kuharibu kiungo. Matatizo kama hayo hayatibiwi tu kwa viuavijasumu, bali kwa upasuaji. Matibabu haya ya seli shina ni bora yafanywe na daktari bingwa wa mifupa au mhudumu mwenye uhusiano wa karibu naye, endapo matatizo yatatokea. Vivyo hivyo, matibabu yanayohusu neva yanapaswa kufanywa na madaktari bingwa wa neva au madaktari bingwa wa upasuaji wa neva.
  3. Je, kliniki ina vifaa vinavyofaa? —Seli shina lazima zishughulikiwe ipasavyo. Usafirishaji wa seli shina za kitovu cha uzazi na kuyeyushwa vibaya baada ya kupokewa kutoka kwa msambazaji kunaweza kupunguza sana idadi yake, jambo ambalo linaweza kuathiri kwa kiasi kikubwa mafanikio ya utaratibu huo. Zaidi ya hayo, seli hizi zinaweza kuwa katika hali ya “mshtuko,” isipokuwa zikifanyiwa utamadunishaji upya ipasavyo baada ya kuyeyushwa. Hili huziruhusu kuingia tena katika awamu inayofaa ya ukuaji.3 Huenda hii ikahitaji maabara maalumu na mtaalamu wa biolojia ya viumbe vidogo kwenye wafanyakazi ili kukuza na kutunza seli shina ipasavyo, na kuhakikisha udhibiti bora wa ubora. Kwa kawaida hili huhitaji mazingira ya chuo kikuu, si kliniki ndogo tu au ofisi yenye muuguzi wa kuyeyusha seli shina baada ya kuzipokea kupitia huduma ya usafirishaji wa usiku kucha. Tovuti za kuvutia, vipeperushi vya rangi na chakula cha jioni cha kutoa taarifa havitoshi.
  4. Nguruwe wa majaribio na panya “hufanyiwa majaribio,” watu hushiriki katika “majaribio ya kitabibu.” —Tafadhali epuka mhudumu yeyote anayesema anafanya majaribio. Majaribio ya kitabibu yanayohusisha watu, ambayo husimamiwa na bodi za maadili, hufanyika tu baada ya majaribio kwa wanyama kuonyesha hatari ndogo ya madhara na uwezekano mzuri wa kufanikiwa. Ikiwa matibabu yana ufanisi mkubwa, FDA imedokeza kwamba washiriki 42 pekee wanaweza kutosha kuonyesha usalama wa kutosha ili kuidhinisha. Hiki si kizingiti kikubwa kupita kiasi kushinda. Zaidi ya hayo, wagonjwa wanaoshiriki katika majaribio ya kitabibu kwa kawaida hutazamiwa kulipia gharama ndogo tu, ikiwa zipo. Wahudumu wanaofanya “majaribio” kwa watu mara chache hufanya hivyo bila malipo.4
  5. Madai yenye uhalisia. —Je, mhudumu wako anadai mafanikio ya asilimia 100? Ikiwa ndivyo, ni bora ukimbie (ikiwa magoti yako yatakuruhusu) kuliko kuondoka kwa kutembea tu! Kwa mfano, matibabu ya magoti yanaweza kuchelewesha tu uhitaji wa kubadilisha magoti kwa watu wengi. Wengine wanaweza kuepuka upasuaji, lakini hakika si wote. Usitarajie tiba kamili. Pia, je, wanatoa madai yaliyo mbali sana na yale yanayotambuliwa kwa kawaida? “Tiba” wanazodai za Alzheimers, Parkinson, au maradhi mengine ambayo FDA haijaidhinisha? Siwezi kukataa kabisa uwezekano kwamba matibabu kama hayo yanaweza kuwepo wakati fulani ujao. Hata hivyo, wahudumu hawa wanapaswa kuweza kuelekeza kwenye tafiti zilizochapishwa (na kukupa nakala zake). Ikiwa kuna tiba ya kimiujiza, ulimwengu unapaswa kunufaika nayo, na mhudumu huyo anapaswa kuweza kuipatia hataza, ili kupata manufaa ya kifedha kwa kushiriki mbinu na uvumbuzi wake na ulimwengu wote. Kwa kufanya hivyo, tiba hiyo hupimwa na kuthibitishwa kwa kujitegemea. Mtu yeyote aliye na tiba ya “siri,” anayemiliki yeye pekee, anapaswa kuepukwa.
  1. Je, inaeleweka? —Kudunga tu seli shina (ambazo maabara haijazichochea zibobe katika hali maalumu kama seli za neva, seli za moyo, n.k.) kwenye mkondo wa damu ili kutibu mambo kama matatizo ya neva, kwa mfano, hakueleweki. Majaribio ya kitabibu ya matibabu halali kwanza huyabobeza seli shina, kisha huzitumia moja kwa moja kwenye eneo lililoathirika. Kwa mfano, aina mahususi za seli za neva hudungwa moja kwa moja katika sehemu mahususi za ubongo, na seli za moyo hudungwa moja kwa moja katika tishu zenye kovu za moyo. Mkumbuke yule mtu mzima mvivu (seli shina ambayo haijabobea)? Huwezi kutarajia kumweka kwenye basi (kumdunga kwenye mshipa), kumpeleka katika jiji kubwa (mwili), bila maelekezo ya la kufanya (kwa kumwacha hajabobea), bila kujua aende wapi (ili kwa namna fulani apate sehemu ya mwili yenye ugonjwa), kisha kutarajia mafanikio ya kimiujiza.
  2. Shinikizo la kuuza kwa nguvu. —Unaambiwa hivyo au unafanywa uhisi kwamba “unakosa fursa” ukikataa? Je, matangazo ya kliniki yana ushuhuda wenye maelezo ya mtoa ushuhuda, kama vile “Matokeo ya kila mtu yanaweza kutofautiana, na ushuhuda huu hauwakilishi matokeo ya kawaida wala haukusudiwi kuwakilisha au kuhakikisha kwamba mtu yeyote atapata matokeo yaleyale au yanayofanana…”? Kama msemo wa zamani usemavyo, ikiwa jambo linaonekana zuri mno kuwa kweli (hasa ikiwa wanakuambia hivyo), basi huenda ndivyo lilivyo. Katika hali hizi, chukulia madai hayo kuwa yana uwezekano mkubwa wa kuwa yametiwa chumvi kwa kiasi fulani, na pia fikiria kufanya kazi na mtu anayeweza kutoa matarajio ya uaminifu zaidi.

Ninaomba kwamba Mungu akupe hekima: Mtu wa kwenu akipungukiwa na hekima, na aombe dua kwa Mungu, awapaye wote, kwa ukarimu, wala hakemei; naye atapewa –Yak 1:5.

Dokezo Maalumu:

Baadhi ya wazazi wameonyesha nia ya kuwapeleka watoto wao Japani ili wapate chanjo huko, ikiwa hatutaweza kusafirisha chanjo hadi Marekani. Ikiwa kuna wasomaji wowote wa gazeti hili ambao pia wanapendezwa, tafadhali wasiliana na The Berean Voice, ili tuweze kupanga na kuratibu ipasavyo. Unaweza kupata maelezo ya mawasiliano ndani ya jalada la mbele la nakala yoyote ya gazeti la The Heartbeat of the Remnant.

2 https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/stem-cell-cosmetics/?redirect=1

My Help and My Deliverer

Psalm 40:1 I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry. 2 He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings. 3 And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD. 4 Blessed is that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies. 5 Many, O LORD my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered. 6 Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required. 7 Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me, 8 I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart. 9 I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest. 10 I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation. 11 Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me. 12 For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me. 13 Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me. 14 Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil. 15 Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha. 16 Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified. 17 But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

A glorious morning unfolds before me, perfect and peaceful, unmarred by failure. The sky is clear and blue. The horizon is a soft, blushing pink, enhanced by a misty fog. The distant hills and trees are shaded a dusky blue in the misty morning coolness. The morning is ringing with the warbling, twittering, chirping of birds. The grass glows with millions of dew droplets sparkling in the morning light. The pink horizon above the distant, dusky hills gradually fades into a glowing orange sphere that becomes brighter and brighter.

I stand in awe of God. My heart is thrilled at the beauty spread out before me. I am also thrilled at what God has done in my life, and the beauty He has created out of ashes.

I waited patiently for the Lord; and He inclined unto me, and heard my cry. He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings. God has brought me up out of the pit of despair and discouragement. He has set my feet upon the Rock, Jesus Christ, and He has established my goings. He knows the plans He has for me. His thoughts and His ways are much higher than mine.

He hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the Lord. I desire that God will be glorified through the work He has done and is continuing to do in my life. Many, O Lord, are Thy wonderful works which Thou hast done, and Thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto Thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.

I delight to do Thy will, O God: yea, Thy law is within my heart. It is truly my delight to do the will of God; to love Him with my whole heart, soul, strength, and mind; to obey His commandments from my heart.

I have not hid Thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared Thy faithfulness and Thy salvation: I have not concealed Thy lovingkindness and Thy truth from the great congregation. It is such a blessing to have deep and edifying conversations with my brothers and sisters in the Lord, and to share together what the Lord is doing in our lives. It is a great strengthening to my faith.

Withhold not Thy tender mercies from me, O Lord: let Thy lovingkindness and Thy truth continually preserve me. Temptations and hard tests are a very real thing in life; the struggle to keep my heart with a diligence, the battle against stubborn pride, and the urge to utter hasty words of frustration. Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me: O Lord, make haste to help me. Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

The sun has risen above the distant hills and the countryside is now glowing gloriously. The mist has faded into the woods and the distant dusky blue hills and trees have exchanged their robes for vivid shades of green intermixed with hints of red and brown. The sparkling droplets of dew are dazzling in the brilliant sunlight.

Let those that seek Thee rejoice and be glad in Thee: let such as love Thy salvation say continually, The Lord be magnified. I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: Thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.
